bla ngape tshogs /

da ra cha dkar chagasems tshegs 'os min gyi lci yang /da wagangs 'tsho'i snyan ngag〈ngo gdong bkrus pa〉yi dpyad pa/ (1)mi ser dkyus ma'i 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris la nye bar bcar ba/da wabase chang sha bo'i snyan ngag las 'phros pa'i gtam/ (12)snyan ngag pa'i‘‘bdag’’gi mthong tshul/da wagangs zhun gyi snyan ngag〈me la sgron mkhan〉dang〈rang la smras pa〉bklags rjes/ (27)rtog 'jug gi dpyod shes pa/ ༷ (38)dgongs don dang dgos don/ gtam brjod zur ba/ (44)bsam blo'i 'phel rim/da wanub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’skabs16pa'i steng gi kha brda gzhir byas pa/ chu (70)nyin tho rjes dran ma/da wasnyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring lags kyi sku gshegs pa'i mya ngan la/ (81 )lnga bzhi snying stobs dran rtog (92)— 1 ge

— sems lagyi'apho nyul/nga tsho'i‘‘shes yon can’’ga re red/da wanub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’steng nas gtam bshad pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/ (100)nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho sna zin spu zin/ (144)lam(mjug byang gi tshab tu) (180)

sems che sa 'os mi gyi lci yang /sems chegs 'os min gyi lci yang /da wagangs 'tsho'i snyan ngag〈ngo gdong bkrus pa〉yi dpyad pa/snyan rtsom 'dis 'jig rten steng na 'tsho dang 'tsho bzhin pa'i skyes bo thams cad de/ rab 'bring tha gsum dang rgan gzhon dar gsum tshang ma la cha rgyus yod cing 'dris lobs che ba'i spyir btang phal ba'i yang phal gyi don phran tshegs sam/ 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag gi spyod lam rnam bzhi'i khro/ da na mnyam 'jog mi byed cing snang dogs ye nas med pa'i ches nyam chung dang bag zhar gyur kyang / nges par bgyis dgos pa'i gra sgrig cig‘‘'dris kyang mi dpyod’’pa'i tshul du lus nas zhing ba phal ba'am mi ser dkyus ma ji bzhin grags med 'gul med dang / do snang gi yul du mi mthong rung nyin dkar gyi 'khor mtshams kun tu bskyar zlos su byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i sta gon gang gi sngon 'gro ste‘‘ngo gdong bkrus pa’’nyid red/ de la khen nas snyan rtsom nyid blos bslangs dang bkram ston byas 'dugasnyan rtsom 'dis zhogs par mal las langs pa'i mi sna'i brjod nga dang po‘‘nga’’nyid thog mar 'phrad pa'am brgyud dgos pa dang / yang ma‘6nam rgyun’’dang 'dra bar yang bskor bskyar bskor du byung dang 'byung — 1 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/bzhin pa'i ngo gdong bkrus pa'i skabs kyi spyod lam las mthong snang dag dang dran slong dag phreng rdog bzhin bstar la brgyus 'dug ngo gdong bkrus tshar nas‘‘mig zung yun gyis phye dus(mdun gyi ka to ra'i nang la(snag tsha lta bu'i khrus chu zhig 'khyil 'dug’’ces mig mdun gyi ka to ra'i nang gi nag shig shig dang tshil zhag 'khyil ler mngon pa'i mi gtsang ba‘‘snag tsha’’ltar du mthong bar mi rnams kyis‘‘nga’’zhes pa las rnyed pa'i‘‘rang bde’’la dran 'char brjod yod na/ ‘‘'di ltar(mi rnams kyis rang bde kho na'i slad du('jig rten gyi kha dog gang du bsgyur bzhin yod dam’’zhes sems tshegs kyi sa bon btab zin la/ mis rang lus kyi cha shas gang rung zhig la gtsang sbra tog tsam byas na yang don por song ba'i rgyab rtsa dang tshang rtsis byas pa'i gzhi rtsa/ ‘‘rang sems rang gis mi bslu ba’’zhes pa'i bag chags btsan pos rang nyid lta na me long dgos pa'i legs bshad cig wal gyis brtsengs byung bas rtsig ldebs kyi‘‘me long’’la kha gtad du 'greng nas zhib gzigs shig bya dgos song / de dang mnyam du rtsig ldebs kyi me long la mal shag gi gru zur gang rung na yod pa'i mal khri'i steng gi chung ma shar byung / de la'ang zhib lta zhig byas na kho mo'i gdong gi zhag gcig gi dri btsog gis kho bo 'jigs yer bar btang song bas/ ‘‘nam rgyun(phyi rol tu mthong ba'i bzhin ras dkar po(kho mos gzhan zhig la g.yar nas yong ba dang 'dra’’zhes dran slong — 2 —

semasache sa'osaminagyilciyang/ da wa byas par rang nyid dang rang nyid the ba'i nye 'khor gyi gzhan mi/ 'tsho sdod khor yug gi mthong chos sogs gang la bltas kyang rtog na/ ‘‘rang bde’’yi tshul 'chos rdzun ma tsam las ci yang mi mthong la sngar bas kyang bden dpang gi gnyen por bkod/ de bzhin du snyan ngag pas thun mong mthun chos re 'ga' bkod de klog pa por myong tshor u tshugs sbyin pa'i‘‘rigs 'dras 'geb pa’’yi nyams len spang nas/ sngar las kyang snyan ngag gi mdzes pa'am nyams stug por 'dzoms ched/ ngo snum byus/ bzhin tshur 'khor nas yong dus chung ma'i brang na khu sum mer gnyid la yur ba'i‘‘bu chung’’mthong snang du shar la/ de ni‘‘me tog lta bu'i 'jam sha’’dang‘‘lhug lhug dgod pa’’can tu snang bar rgyu mtshan gzhan gang gis kyang min te/ tag tag‘‘'jig rten du yong nas byabs khrus ma byas’’pas red/ 'di la brten nas‘‘bu chung 'di(pha ma gnyis dang 'dra bar nar son par(nga phangs sems shig gting nas skyes yong’’zhes pa dran slong byas pa'o/ /snyan rtsom 'dir snyan ngag pa'i dran slong byed stangs ni gra 'grig/ cing ru dpung bstar ba'i go rim bstar chags camyo/ nam mu tig phreng rnos can las/ sne mang rnyog 'dzing dang bsam ya na 'khrug long rang mnga' ba'i mtshams la rer nam mkha'i mthongs kyi chos dngos brjod pa dang mtshams la rer rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi chos dngos brjod pa lta bu'i mchongs ge 3 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/lding can(yārte.adz+ra)ni ma yin par/ tag tag khang khyim zhig las kyang mal shag gyan gcig gi khor yug dog po las ma 'da' ba dang de'i khrod kyi nga'i mthong snang brgyud nas 'gul chos nga dang 'gul med chung ma/bu phrug ste/ ‘‘mi’’gsum gyi dngos yod gnas tshod(mthong chos)brjod nas phyi'i brda 'phrin bstan pa dang / nang gi brda 'phrin nam snyan ngag pas bstan par 'dod pa'am brjod par 'dod pa'i dgongs don ni mi sna gsum gyi gnas tshod go bsdur la brten nas rtogs dgos par 'dod/lar snyan rtsom spyi'i cha nas bshad na/ kha g.yang sgrog pa'am nga ro sgrog pa lta bu'i che tshugs 'gying nyams kyi cha dang 'ud brjod zil shugs kyi sgro btags can ni ma yin par/ don dag ches nyag phra ba'am bye brag pa zhig brjod par bsam blo rlabs chen(tshig ngos)mi 'dzoms la/brtse dung gi mkha' dbugs kyang stug por mi snang / bsam yan gyi 'gyur bag ni de bas kyang ngo / /tag tag‘‘kha byang’’gi 'dam ga ji bzhin snyan rtsom hril bor zhi dul dang rnal ma/ nan tan/ zhib brjod tu snang na ches bab chags pa'o/ /de bzhin du snyan ngag gi kha byang dang rtsom gyi sgrig gzhi dgod stangs/ skad cha'i lhug brjod byed stangs/ tshig gi 'phal ga sdeb stangs/ bsam sbyor gyi nyams 'gyur mtshon stangs sogs kyi cha nas ha cang lhu 'grig la gra dag spus dag can tu snang na‘‘chu la chu bzhag dang me la me grogs’’kyi tshul du 'dug da dung skad cha'i — 4 —

sems chegs 'os mi gyi lci yang /spros brjod kyi thad nas ches cher 'phags pa ma yin rung rtsom byang dang kha 'phrod ngo 'phrod du song bas dang dod la gzhol ba/ dran slong byeng/ tshul yang rtog 'gyu rgod po can ma yin par gcig la gcig brten gyi rten cing 'brel ba'i pha ri tshu ri ltar grub yod na/ snyan rtsom 'di'i mdzes pa'am rgyan cha/ yang na rgyal kha'i tshul du brtsi chog pa ni rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi dngos 'bri ring lugs kyi skad cha g.yar nas bshad na‘‘ches bab chags can’’yin pa de red/snyan rtsom 'di'i mdzes pa dang rgyal kha gong nas glengs zin la da ni mi 'dang sa'am zhan cha re gnyis brjod pa la/ gcig snyan ngag grub tshul gyi cha nas/ lar rtsom rig cig yin na myong rtog can las rigs rtog dang ldan na mi 'os pa'am mi 'grig pas rtsom rig gi tog tu bsam pa'i snyan ngag ni de bas kyang ngo / /snyan ngag ni rigs rtog gi shed med pa dang don brjod kyi brlan mi mod pa/ lhug pa'i spros brjod ma mang na bzang bas go rim dang ldan pa zhig yin na de'i rtsa ba'i chos nyid dam 'byung byed kyi rgyu‘‘brtse dung’’dang 'gal yod pas chig skud ltar thur du spro ba can yin na mi 'grig la/ dbugs lgang lbos ba ltar yin na 'grig snyam/ des na/ snyan rtsom 'dir phyi skad cha'i sgrig sbyor gyi cha na rgyu 'bras gtan tshigs kyi go rim can du nges la/ bar snyan ngag gi rnam par rtog stangs dang dran slong byed tshul gyi cha nas kyang rgyu 'bras — 5 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/gtan tshigs kyi go rim can du 'dug nang dgongs don nyid snyan ngag gi mi sna gsum gyi dngos yod gnas tshod kyi go bsdur spros brjod la brten nas rtogs dgos pa'i cha nas kyang rgyu 'bras gtan tshigs kyi go rim can du lhang nger yod de/ gtam brjod dang po'i mi sna nga'i mthong sne las rnyed pa'i‘‘nga’’rang steng gi mi gtsang ba las‘‘'di ltar(mi rnams kyi rang bde kho na'i slad du('jig rten gyi kha dog gang du bsgyur bzhin yod dam’’dang / de nas nga'i chung ma'i mi gtsang ba las‘‘nam rgyun(phyi rol du mthong ba'i bzhin ras dkar po(kho mos gzhan zhig la g.yar nas yong ba dang 'dra’’zhes dang / de nas kyang bu phrug gi gtsang ma las‘‘bu chung 'di(pha ma gnyis dang 'dra bar nar son par(nga phangs sems shig gting nas skyes yong’’zhes skad cha'i sgrig sbyor dang dran slong byed tshul/ go bsdur gyi dmigs 'ben bcas skya rengs nyi shar ji bzhin rjen par rtogs yong / da dung tshig dum de dag bar gyi 'brel ba yang gting je zab nas je zab dang brjod par 'dod pa'i sems 'dun yang ci zhig yin pa je gsal nas je gsal red/ gnyis/ bsam blo'i bstan don gyi cha nas/ snyan rtsom 'dir snyan ngag pas ngo gdong bkrus skabs kyi mthong snang dang dran slong dag mi sna gsum gyi go bsdur la khen nas spros brjod byas 'dug la/ phyi'i brda 'phrin mi sna gsum gyi go bsdur ba la brten nas gsal 'don bya 'dod pa'i nang gi brda 'phrin te ge 6 —

sems che sa 'os min gyi lci yang /brjod bya'i bstan don ni 'khor ba'am 'jig rten la zhe log pa(lar snyan rtsom la brjod snying ngos 'dzin pa'i lta tshul ni tha shal ba dang thabs rdugs pa/ nor 'khrul can yin mod/ dgos mkho'i dbang gis re zhig de ltar bkod pa la dgongs 'jags 'tshal)dang yang na kha bde brjod bde'am bde mo 'byor mo byas te spros na/da lta'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyis bskyed pa'i 'tsho sdod kyi gnas bab la 'dod blo ma tshim pa'am yi mug skyes pa'i nyams snang mtshon pa dang /gzhan du na spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyis mi gshis 'khyog bsgyur byas pa la 'khang ra byas 'duga'adzam gling rtsom rig spyi'i 'phel phyogs la bltas nas bshad na/dngos po'i dpal yon rgyas drags pas bskyed pa'i spyi tshogs gnas bab kyi nyen kha la 'dod blo ma tshim pa'i yid chad dang sun 'byin/ mi gshis 'khyog bsgyur gyis brtse ba dang bral ba'i bsam sbyor ya ma brla ther 'don/ da dung spyi tshogs kyi sbag btsog dang rang byung khor yug gi skam rid sogs brjod bya sna tshogs kyis da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi skyon cha mtshang 'byin gyis dkar 'don bya ba dag ni brjod par 'os la de ltar yin kyang nges/ lhag par du nub gling par kho tsho'i 'tsho sdod kyi spyi tshogs/ gnas bab dang rtsom rig(spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul mtshon pa can yin cha nas)kha ngo 'phrod pas de ltar yin nges la/ brjod 'os pa zhig kyang rering / de la spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi btsan rdzong stug po dang bsam blo'i 'byung khungs — 7 —

sems 'i gyi 'pho sdo/la/kyi mtshan nyid rig pas mtshon pa'i rigs pa'i rgyab ljongs mthug po mnga' ba red/ de bas snyan ngag par yang bsam blo des shan zhugs pa ltar du snang yang kho'i snyan ngag gi mdzes pa lhur len stangs dang bsam blo'i bstan don gyi go rim gang la bltas kyang nub gling pas shan thebs par mi 'dod la/ tag tag rang cag gi rig gnas kyi nang snying dang bsam pa'i longs spyod kyi rgyags phye phun tshogs su rlom pa'i‘‘nang bstan’’gyi bskyed 'bras yin par 'dod/ rgyu mtshan ni snyan rtsom 'di'i ches mjug mtha'i skad cha des gsal kha bgyis 'dug la/ dgongs snying dmar rjen rjen tu gsal 'don byas 'dug nang bstan ltar na/‘‘sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib’’ces dang‘‘rang sems ye dag gam ka dag’’ces‘‘mi’’nyid 'jig rten can tu ma byas('jig rten du yong nas byabs khrus ma byas)pa'i bar glags der nyon mongs dug gsum gyi ngo bor mi snang bar smra/ de bas 'jig rten 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang zhe log skyes dgos pa'i gnad bstan pas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs de yang‘‘bcu drug lang tsho can gyi gzhon nur’’slong skrun byas yod pa red/ h+phu/ snon gyi tshul du bshad na/ ‘‘byis blo can’’ni nang bstan pa'i re snyeg gi dmigs 'dun red la/ nang bstan sbyong ba'i dmigs 'ben yang mthar gtugs na‘‘rang sems ka dag’’nyid slar gso bya phyir red/ nub gling pas ni 'jig rten sdug bsngal du — 8 —

sems che sa 'os mi gyi lci yang /mthong mod/ 'on kyang 'jig rten can tu ma byas na 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi gdod nyes 'dag byang bya thub par mi 'dod la/ 'jig rten 'jig dus sam bskal stong gi dus lha gong mas(༅lko)legs nyes kyi khrims gcod bya mi thub par 'dod/ de'i rkyen gyis mi nyid 'jig rten can du byas na da gzod rang gi mi tshe'i rin thang mngon 'gyur bya thub la/ mi bu'i rtsis thang lhur len bya thub par ngos 'dzin na/ ‘‘byis blo can’’la yag shos yin 'jog gi gnas su mi 'dzin par sdug shos min 'jog gi blo kha ma phye ba la nges bzung ste/ mi bus 'jig rten gyi sne mang rnyog 'dzing khrod nas rang nyid kyi yod tshad mngon dgos par 'dod pas/'jig rten/ gyi sdug bsngal sdug bsngal du mi bsam par gdong gtod thub pa'i dpa' gdeng yod/ nga tsho bod pa ni de las phyir bsnur dang bag/ 'khum(kun gzhi bag chags ngos kyi thun mong 'du shes)bya bzhin yod na nyen zon gyi yul lo/ /der brten cha 'jog cig byas te/ bdag la snyan rtsom 'dir bzo bcos sam gzhog gtub bya chog pa'i dbang cha yod na/ ches mjug mtha'i tshig dum dang brjod snying 'bab gzhi la yar bskul gyi cha med pas bcos na snyam/ n+ya/ba gling pa'i rtsom rig dang snyam ngag dgo/ gis spyi tshog/sa kyi snang tshul la brten nas rang si/ myo/nga ba zhi/ga brjod panu mi chog par/ da dung de la rang nyid kyi 'jig rten zhig blos bslangs byed pa red/ 'dir ma bab bshad dga'i tshal du gleng na/ khyod dang ra da 9 da

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/chung ma gnyis la dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi dri mas gos zin pas rang myong yod la der mthun gyi smra brjod kyi dbang cha'ang rtsod bral du yod pas ji ltar bsnyad na'ang chog 'on kyang‘‘byis pa’’de la sems 'dun dang spyod lam ci lta bu zhig 'byung rgyu yin pa la nga tshos da dung mi shes pa'am gab tshig cig yin pas/ pha mas de lta bu'i‘‘ma 'ongs lung bstan’’gyi 'gan 'khur lci mo'am sems tshegs ma bzhes na bsam/ de las byis pa nyid 'jig rten la gdong gtod thub pa'i‘‘mi bu’’yan gar ba zhig tu ji ltar bya rgyu la mno bsam bzhes na 'os snyam/ zhor du 'jar pan gyi deng rabs snyan ngag pa tha nus kha ba zhun tha ra'orjoyi gtam brjod cig mjug gtam gyi tshul du bkod na/ ‘‘mal khri'i yar zur na zla ba gsum las ma 'gor ba'i phru gu bsnyal yod/ kho'i gnyid tshul las nga la skyid tshad med cig gi snang ba sbyin/ 'di ni nga tsho'i bu phrug dang nga tsho'i tshe srog gi cha shas shig yin pas red/ ngas nged khyo shug zung las brgal ba'i tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun zhig rnyed la/ da dung nged gsum gyi yod pa(ོṣ+ṭha)des skyes pa gcig dang bud med gcig yang na bu chung gcig gi yod pa rkyang tsam mi ston par/ nga tsho dang 'dzam gling yongs gzhi gcig tu sbrel ba/ lo rgyus dang dus tshod kyi rgyun chad ma myong ba'i khrod du nga tsha'i mes po dang tsha bo/ yang na tshe srog yod tshad dang gzhi gcig r+sha/ ngaXmazlokha snas/ kha zlo ñtsā nāzlorno/'o/btāk+ṣiṃ cho/lhatsārdo smi /sbyi ṭ+wāṃrno rnye kūghārnyi rjirnyi sni sti/ k+ṣiṃzlo saṃn ngag mkhan dang 'khrab — 10 —

sems chegs 'os min gyi lci yang /tu 'brel bar bsam/ de bas khyim tshang ni nga tshos grub pa min par nga tshor khyim tshang de bstsal pa red/ nga tsho mi sna gsum ni mi'i thog ma yin la mtha' ma'ang yin/ khyim tshang zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di la rim bzhin don gyis stong ba'i dus 'dir/ ngas thog ma'i go don slar gso byed pa de 'gro ba mi'i rigs la yid ches byas chog pa'i rtsa ba'i rkang stegs byed 'dod yin/ de bzhin du gnyen sgrig gi khrod nas ngas 'gro ba mi kha4sa/ bla ru 'phags pa'i dngos po zhig tshor ba dang sbrags/ de ni rang nyid kyi ka rten byed nges/’’dusnyan rtsom klog /de'i 'grel ris/ngo sdidoram̐ ḍisdispopabye r+sāsnoshā spya k+ṇi — ci—r+sha6—caci——cicicicari—kyai jud 'jig3na zhashed car skuca'ajig rten can du ma byas pami gtsang ba gtsang bgo bsduragyis pa'i 'a thadagodabachag mi 'dod pa/('jig rten can du bya 'dod ra pa〉① oṃtso/ 〈zo/shu’ṣiṭhakācha74tsho.oṃstar+sā 〉(ko) ma4ner+sāne+esgolornye tram̐2002lholo2 9 8 11 da

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/mi ser dkyus ma'i 'cho ba'i brnyan ris la nye bar bcar ba/da wabase chang sha bo'i snyan ngag las 'phros pa'i gtam/lo 'di 'gar snyan ngag dang snyan deb mang po'i 'du 'god kyi yo lang rab tu rgyas bzhin 'dug 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nyams myong ngam myong ba las gzhibs pa'i myong rtog gi tshor shes shin tu rnon po dang bral ba'i rdo khog skam po can/ phyi don la gzhol ba'i zhib 'bri zhib rgyas 'tsham zhing snyan ngag gi khams stug por spyin pa'i dpe 'jog gi spros brjod bral ba'i tshig ris rkyang ba can/ dngos yod 'tsho ba las 'das pa'i phugs bsam gyi rdzong mthug ched gzugs 'das kyi smra brjod rngam shom gyis bstar yang don gyis skya sob sob kyi sprin pa can/ de dag gi dbang gis nga tsho'i yid ngor nar mar brtan chags su gyur pa'i snyan ngag yang don spyi'i sems 'gyu dang snang brnyan gyi dungs tshor rkyang du 'dug go lugs de'i rgyun 'byams kyis dngos yod 'tsho ba'i rang mdangs dang nye ba'i snyan rtsom de mur bag la zha nas mnyam 'jog gi yul min la bsam gzhig gi zhing min pa lta bur gyur/ de bzhin du mi ser dkyus ma dang 'brel ba'i snyan rtsom ni cung dkon po rang du gda'/ dga' 'os pa — 12 —

mi ser da sa ma'i 'cho ba'i brnyan ris la nye bar bcar ba/zhig la/ 2005lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb bzhi pa'i steng bse chang sha bo'i〈da lor/ lud rdzas kyi rin gong 'phar 'dug〉ces pa'i snyan rtsom zhig bkod 'dug par/ cung tshad ldan du 'gro ba'i snyan ngag gi khyad chos dag 'khyer nas tshad 'jal byas na brtse dung gi brlan tshor stug po dang bsam blo yi 'khor phyogs gting zab pa/ snyan ngag gi mdzes pa lhur len pa bcas gang thad nas mi ldang bar zhan por snang / yin yang /snyan ngag gi klog 'don dang dpyad gleng gi khrod thog ma'i gnas skabs su nges par du bsam dgos pa ni snyan ngag gi smra brjod des spyi tshogs rig gnas kyi brda 'phrin zhig ston pa dang spyi tshogs kyi gnad don zhig gdon pa'i babs shig kyang yod na/ snyan rtsom 'di gleng ba'i 'os mchis/snyan ngag 'di'i bstan bya ni gzhan gang yang ma yin par/ spyi tshogs kyi ches dma' rim mam 'og rim na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i dmangs phal ba ste zhing pa red/ kho la dbang cha med/ thob thang med/ kho ni dkyus ma /bab chags/ phal ba/ rang ga ba/ gyi na ba yin/snyan rtsom 'di la snyan ngag rang steng na rang chos su grub pa'i khyad chos te/ kab sbed kyi rang bzhin dang don mang rang bzhin/ rkyang skum sgrim lhod kyi rang bzhin rmosogs med la/ tha na snyan ngag gi rjongatshobyed de brtsams sgrung ngam lhug rtsom sogs kyi rjod byed dang mi 'dratshoba'i ‘snyan ngag rang gi skad cha’’yi tshad la'ang thon med/ yin yang ༈/ rtsom —— 13 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/thabs kyi thad nas‘‘slar mtshon’’gyi cha gtso bor bton yod de/ gcigakha par gyi kha brda ste go rim mgo rnga la do snang mi byed pa'i tshul la brten nas snyan ngag gi skad cha ma yin pa'i rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs dang bral ba'i 'tsho ba'i skad cha yi rang mdangs de lhur blangs pa/ gnyis/ 'tsho ba'i gtam brjod gyi na ba de las mi ser dkyus ma'i 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris shig bkram ston byas yod pas red/der‘‘deng dus yongs grags kyi bshad tshul ltar na/ srol rgyun gyi ngos na mdzes dpyod lta ba rnam pa gnyis su grub yod zer/ gcig ni nub gling pa'i ‘slar mtshon’ gyi mdzes dpyod dang / cig shos ni rgya nag gna' srol gyi ‘snyan ngag gi khams’ kyi mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba'o/ /snga ma nub gling par mtshon na/ kho tsho'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyab khongs thams cad na ches gsal ba'i 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris kyis khyab ste yod la/ snyan ngag kyang de dang de mtshungs yin par 'dod/ phyi ma rgya'i gna' srol snyan ngag la mtshon na/ 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris gsal zhing dngos don ji bzhin mtshon pa rtsom rig gi ngo bor ma grub par/ go sa gtso bor bzung zhing rgyud gcig tu 'brel zhing khyab pa ni snyan ngag gi khams 'di yin/ de ltar du bshad na/ bod kyi snyan ngag gi mdzes chos de tshig mdzes par byed pa'i tshig rgyan gyi steng na yod ces bshad chog gtso bo ni gzugs rgyan dpe rgyan sogs kyis brjod par bya ba gang de ches mtshar — 14 —

mi ser da sa ma'i 'tsho ba'i bar+sān ris la nye bar bcar ba/bo'am 'ud kyis brjod par bya ba zhig yin’’(bdud lha rgyal gyi〈'tshol rtog gi snying stobs〉2 129—130)zhes gsal ba ltar snyan rtsom 'dis kyang 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris mtshon pa la gzhol ci thub byas yod tsang dge mtshan 'di 'dra rnyed rgyu yod de/ gyon pa thed po/ za rgyu thug rkyang / khang leb skya bo las med pa'i dmangs skya chu ris can gyi 'tsho ba ngo ma dang de'i las dbang la thugs sems ches cher gzhol 'dug pa dang / lo dus zla tshes la nan tur gyis dmigs bsal bton yod par/ mchor gos gzab spros dang rgyas za rgyas 'thung gis 'tsho ba'i gzhan mi dang / rang gi rten sa rten yul sa zhing des 'tsho ba'i ma mtha'i dgos mkho yang ma nus par phyi 'grim gla rgyag gi ngal rtsol sdug po skyo pos lus sems nyis thad nas btsir gnon myong bzhin pa'i rang mi'i bab chags kyi gnas bab gnyis la‘‘bsdur dpyod’’kyi stong glegs chen po zhig sbyin 'dug da dung deng rabs kyi lag rtsal 'phrul chas‘‘kha par’’brgyud nas brtsams grub yod pa'i‘‘pha bu gnyis kyi kha brda'i snyan ngag’’de las dus rabs gsar pa'i bod kyi pha ma zhig gi sems 'dun dang sems pa'i 'khyer so zur tsam nges la/ 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris tha thor zhig kyang bcos min du mthong bas‘‘gdung sems’’la khad kyis bcar pa'i skyo ngal chem/ ngo zhis/ 'gog med du sbyin yong / kho bor mtshon na snyan rtsom 'di ches sku nga tshim pa zhig ma yin rung / de ltar dpyad yul gleng yu/la du 'dzin pa 'a — 15 d+ngha

sems la gyi 'a21 nyul/rgyu mtshan med pa ma yin te/ 'di ni bod 'bangs mi ser dkyus ma'i las dbang dang 'brel ba'i snyan ngag gyi na ba zhig yin pas red/'dis brjod bzhin pa ni tshe tshe rabs rabs su spyi tshogs kyi ches 'og rim na 'tsho zhing grags med 'gul med du bzhud pa'i dmangs phal ba khri ma 'bum dag yin pas red/mtshan nyid rig pas sne khrid de rtsom rig gi brjod gzhi yang che bris kyi‘‘mi bu’’las chung bris kyi‘‘mi bu’’la gzhol ba'i deng rabs phyi ma'i ring lugs kyi bstan pa dar ba'i dus 'dir/ nub gling pas gtso byas rgyal nang gi rtsom pa po(snyan ngag pa dang brtsams sgrung pa)tshang mas‘‘mi sger’’'di rtsom 'bri'i rkang stegs dang rmang rdor 'cha' bzhin yod par/ bod rang la'ang de'i shan zhugs kyi dbang gis‘‘mi sger’’gyi 'tsho ba mngon par mtshon pa'i lugs shig rgyun 'byams su 'gro bzhin 'dug lar rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi ngos nas 'di ni dga' 'os pa'i 'gros rim zhig red/brtsams sgrung gi thad nas/ 〈2001lo'i gtam rgyud〉lta bu/ rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir btang brtsams sgrung gi gtam rgyud ltar du byung rim gyi cha tshags dam por med par sil bur yod pa dang / skad cha brjod lugs la yang‘‘rang shed’’che drags pas dpe 'god lugs dang sems tshor brjod lugs lkog gyur yin pa/ ‘‘mi sger’’gyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa la rang nyid kyi dga' skyo chags sdang gi 'gyur ldog myur la rnam dbye ha cang da 16 da

mi ser da sa ma'i 'cho ba'i b.ran ris la nye bar bcar ba/gsal bas/ gzhan dag ltar rtsom pa po dang rtsom chos(spra.oṃ)kyi mi sna gnyis tha dad du dbyer rung ba bzhin‘‘bar thag’’gis chod pa ma yin par gnyis ka gzhi gcig tu 'dres nas kha kher 'ger rgyu med pa bcas so/ /snyan ngag gi thad nas/ ‘‘mi sger’’la rkang btsugs nas thon dang 'don bzhin pa'i‘‘snyan deb’’ni grong khyer gyi rlangs 'khor las kyang mang bar 'dug yin yang de dag gi gras su/ snyan ngag gi skad cha la bco sbyong gi sbyong brdar thob nas hrug gi rol rtsed tsam ma yin pa'i snyan ngag rang gi skad cha bshad mkhan can/ 'tsho ba'i myong rtog gi zab tshad mtshon thub pa can/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i blo sbyong yod pa can bcas ni nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon pas dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri lci mo'i 'du shes med la/ de las brdol ba'i‘‘gdung sems kyi na zug’’kyang lhag tu dko na/ de bas‘‘mi sger’’la rgyus lon gyi shes byas ma ldang bar ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi go 'dzol byung ba dang / ci yin 'di yin meng pa'i snyan deb‘‘skya min ser min’’mang po byung /de'i rkyen gyis gong nar+sā brjod zin pa ltar snyan rtsom 'di la snyan ngag tshad ldan zhig gi ngos nas gleng rin med rung / des spyi tshogs kyi gnad don zhig gi cha 'phrin nyid 'don sprod byas 'dug pa'i cha nas bsam yan gyi stong glegs chen po mnga' ste/ ‘‘a phas(phyogs gang du yod min mi shesatshopa'i gnas de'i kha par ang grangs ma mnan gong’’zhes — 17 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/pa'i spros brjod byed lugs kyis a pha de ni grangs ka tsam ngo chod pa'i yig rmongs pa zhig yin nges snyam la/ de dang bstun nas‘‘spyi lo2005lo'i zla3pa'i tshes9nyin gyi phyi dror’’zhes dus tshod la dmigs gtad kyis nan nan cag cag byed tshul la 'di ltar snyam ste/ dus rabs nyer gcig dang stong lo gsar pa'i so kha las gzur zin pa'i mtshams 'dir/ spyi tshogs kyi ches 'og rim na 'tsho ba'i mi ser dkyus ma'i dngos yod 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs kyi bla rim na 'tsho ba'i‘‘mi chen po’’dag gi 'tsho ba'i bar na‘‘dbye khyad’’ga 'dra yod dam/ de ltar zhib bsdur gyi sems 'gyu rab tu 'khrug na gdung sems kyi skyo ngal chen po bskyed/ de bzhin du dus rabs nyer gcig dang stong lo gsar pa zhes pa'i smyan byed kyi kha g.yang dag kyang stong bsam dang 'phrul snang gis bzhengs pa'i tha snyad 'ba' zhig red/ 〈2001lo'i gtam rgyud〉ces pa'i brtsams sgrung gi 'go slong ba'i gtam la 'di ltar bkod 'dug ste/‘‘ched las mkhas pa kha cig ltar na/ dus rabs gsar pa 'di'i dbu ni2001lo nas tshugs par 'dod/ gzhan cig gis de dang mi mthun pa'i tshig gi phreng ba spel nas dgag bzhag mdzad yod cing / da lo ni dus rabs gsar pa'i bgrang bya gnyis pa red zer/ gang ltar/ngas bltas na de dag kyang dgos med don gzhan kho na tsam du snang ste/rang nyid kyi lto ba'am snyan grags gang rung gi ched do’’zhes yod pa ltar a — 18 —

mi ser da sa ma'i 'cho ba'i brnyan ris la nye bar bcar ba/pha de la mtshon na sems 'dun ga 'dra snyezhig yod dam/ ‘‘ban de e(ban de('jigs byed kyi mtshams la bsdad yod(gsum pa'i bco lnga ni mtshams grol gyi dus yin pas(sbyin sreg la mar rgya ma lnga bcu yas mas dang('bru rgya ma brgyad brgya lhag dgos(de dag gi ched du(nga bla brang la 'gro rtsis yod’’ces pa ltar da dung ci zhig gi phyir du 'dur rgyug la brel zhing / des yod tshad bzlog thub pa'i kun gzhi bag chags shig gis‘‘snying stobs shig dang dad mos shig’’sus kyang tshor dka' bar drud nas yong dgos song / de ni a pha rang gis mi tshor la nye 'khor gyi mi dag/ gis kyang mi tshor/ gang ltar/ de ltar yin nges par bsam nas/ ji ltar yin pa la rigs 'ded dang rjes dpag gi the tshom bral ba'i a pha nyid sems tshegs la gtad nas dka' ngal gyis bzhud dgos byung / de ni ga/nga gis kyang min te/ pha mes yang mes nas mu nas mur bskyangs 'ong ba'i‘‘tshor bar dka' ba'i thogs reg gis stong ba'i stobs shugs’’shig yin pas so/ /‘‘phu bo e(phu bo bza' zla gnyi ga da lo mgo log na yod(dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu ma brkos na bzang mod kyang(deng sang gi mi la ji lta ra bshad na'ang go ba mi 'dug('on kyang(de la 'gro mkhan ni kho gnyis/ rkyang rkyang ma red’’ces pa'i kha brda'i babs las brtsams te/ dus rabs ga/ṭag rari pa'i 'jal shing de tshad thig tu bzung nas tshad 'jal na/ da/byar rtswa — 19 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/dgun 'bu rko ba ni dus rabs kyi dgongs pa ste/ khor yug srung skyong dang dkon nor rtswa chen la gces 'dzin sogs phyogs gang thad nas khrims 'gal lugs 'gal yin pas rgyun ldan gyi kha brda thung ngu 'dis ci zhig thag gcod dang gsal bshad byas yod dam/ 'di ni gzhan gyis skul slong dang btsan gnon byas pa ci yang min/ tag tag rang sems las lhun gyis thon pa'i skad cha gtsang ma red/ lar kho tshos kyang de'i nyes dmigs shes yod kyang da dung 'dur rgyug la brel par skabs don dang 'brel ba'i dpyad gzhi chen po zhig go/ gang ltar kyang / dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu sems mkhan ni snyan ngag pas bstan pa ltar/ ‘‘nga'i snyan ngag tu shong ba'i tshor ba zhig ma red’’ces zhib rgyas mthar chags su ma bkod par sems byung tsam gyis 'thus par byas pa'i gal gnad kyang rtogs nges/ 'jig rten 'dir nam yang bden don gyis phyug pa ni ches spyir btang / ches phal ba/ ches bab chags/ ches gyi na ba yin/ 'di la 'khyog brjod dang 'ud brjod mi 'gro bas sgyu rtsal gyi khrod du ches mtshon par dka' ba yin/ gal te/ bsam yan che zhing dkyus ma bab chags yin pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi blo sbyong mthug cing sger tshugs kyi blo rig mnga' ba/ 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi brtan zhing myong rtog gi tshor 'du zab pa'i rtsom pa pos da gzod mthar chags su mtshon thub pas so/ /‘‘na ning do tshigs su(mgo log gi dbyar rtswa sems mkhan ni(tag — 20 —

mi ser da sa ma'i 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris la nye bar bcar ba/tag sa 'og gi gser nag sems mkhan las mang’’zhes dpe 'jog spyi bam tsam las de'i snang tshul ngo ma ni da dung nga tsho dang ha cang kha thag ring bas/ nga tsho la skabs de'i gnas tshul dngos te bzo bcos dang rtog bzo ci yang ma byas pa'i 'tsho ba ngo ma'i brnyan ris de ji 'dra'i mkho che ang / de ltar nyam chung / 'khos chung / bab chags/ bden pa//don dngos dag ni rigs gzhung gi ched du rigs gzhung gnyer ba tshos mkhyen pa'i tshod min la/ sgyu rtsal gyi ched du sgyu rtsal gnyer ba'i stong bsam 'phrul snang ba tshos slong skrun bya thub pa'i yus med/sa zhing yod pas zhing pa tsho'i 'tsho bar don snying yod la/ sa zhing yod pas zhing pa tshor yid ches kyis brtas yod/ sa zhing ni kho tsho'i rten sa rten yul dang pha sa pha yul yi/ na/ gal te sa zhing med na kho tshor ci yang med pas rang gi mi tshe'i rin thang yang mngon 'gyur bya sa'i gnas med/ de bas/ rmon 'debs ni zhing pa tshor mtshon na/ 'o/ zhig gi don dag gal chen zhig yin/ 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag gi 'dur rgyug yod tshad kha zas lto rgyab kyi don red/ de bzhin du sa zhing ni mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud pa'i 'tsho rten nyag gcig red/ 'dis mi/ bu ji 'dra'i mang po zhig bskyangs yod ang / 'di'i slad du mi bu ji 'dra'i mang po zhi/ga sa la 'thim yod ang / sa/nga ltar kyang / sa cingani yod tshad red / rmon 'debs kyi nyer mkho'i yo chas dang pūd rdzas 'a — 21 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/sogs sa slog rdo slog gi skya ther ther gyi sa rdul gyi ngo bor snang rung 'dzem med dogs med kyis hur brtson la gzhol na/ myu gu rgyas nas 'bras bzang rag pa'i ched du‘‘lud rdzas’’mi nyo thabs med yin/ der lud rdzas kyi rin gong 'phar zin na/ ches na zug cig dang sdug bsngal zhig ci la min/ ‘‘lto ba mang po'i ched du(khyim bdag mang pos rdzong thog tu skad cha shab shub cig’’mi lab thabs med byung / de ni mi ser dkyus ma tsho'i rgyun ldan gyi kha brda red pas dri ma bral ba'i‘‘rang sems kyi skad cha’’yin nges/snyan rtsom 'di ni snyan ngag gi skad cha ma yin pa'i dmangs phal ba'i skad chas gtsor bzung yod cing / snyan ngag pa'i dungs sems mtshon phyir snyan ngag gis bcings pa'i skad chas spros pa ni phal ba'am zur rgyan du gyur yod la/ ‘‘kha par’’gyi smyan byed la brten nas grub pa'i rang ga ba yin la ma yin pa'i snyan ngag cig red/ 'dir snyan ngag pas brjod gzhir 'dem pa'i nang don dang / kha byang gi 'dam ga skad cha'i spros brjod bcas mang po na dmangs phal ba lta bu'i dkyus ma dang bab chags kyi dri bsung stug por 'thul gyin yod na/ 'di ni 'tsho ba'i dri ma dang kha dog dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag cig red/ de bzhin du khong gi snya na ngag〈(zi ling gi grogs po 'ga' dran pa〉yang de dang rigs 'drar 'dug de gnyis kar 'jam sha dang lhod cha/ zhi 'jam bcas kyi‘‘mo — 22 —

mi ser da sa ma'i 'cho ba'i banen ris la nye bar bcar ba/gshis’’kyi nyams shig thon yod pas a thang chad pa'i snang ba mi sbyin/gzhan〈rten 'brel zhu〉dang〈〈nyis stong lo'i zhu gsol〉lta bu la yid ches dang spobs pa/ brtan tshugs bcas kyi‘‘gsar rtags’’kyi nyams dang ldan pas ngar shugs slong ba'i rnam rtog bar med du ster/ de lta na'ang khong gi snyan ngag gi 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi dang myong rtog ni‘‘'tsho ba'i brnyan ris’’mtshon pa'i cha na 'dug snyam ste/ 〈〈zi ling gi grogs po 'ga' dran pa〉zhes pa'i zhar bkod kyi mjug tu‘‘tsha bo dbang chen(bdag gi tsha bo yin la(bod kyi byis pa zhig red(tsha bo dbang chen(snang tshul shugs kyi gnas tshul zhig ste(lo rgyus kyi gzugs brnyan nogs med cig kyang red’’ces pa ltar mi ser dkyus ma'i rgyud pa yin pa nam yang bsnyel bya min/ 'bangs mi ser tshos lo rgyus kyi rlabs rgyun khrod nas/ mi sger gyi tshe srog la rdog badzis dang / mnar gcod/ sdug bsngal/ mya ngan/pham kha gang mang nyos nas yong la/ kun spyod kyi thad nas kyang sdigs dmod dang / dma' 'bebs/ 'phya smod gang mang thebs nas sems tshegs nar mar myangs nas yong / 'di ni da gzod snyan ngag pas gdung sems bla lhag bcangs yul te/ ches nyam/ chung 'khos chung si/ tshe srog la do khur dang / tshe srog gi gzhi grub la ngos len brtsi 'jos byeng pa'o/ /de bas nam rgyun 'tshol rtog dang phyir rtog gsed 'grol bya dgos pa'i dmigs gzhi yang 'di yin pas/ da dung yang stong cha chen — 23 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/po zhig gi ngang na gnas yod/ 'di 'dra'i gnas bab la gzhigs te/nga tshos nyam chung ba'i mi ser dkyus ma'i dngos yod 'tsho gnas la mi bsam thabs med byung / ji ltar 'dra mnyam thon gyin med pa'i spyi tshogs khor yug gi khrod nas mi'i go sa gtan 'khel bya rgyu dang / ji ltar mi'i rtsis thang thag gcod bya rgyu/ ji ltar bdag nyid bor zin pa slar yang 'tshol bar bya rgyu/ ji ltar tshe srog la brtsi 'jog dang tshe srog la do khur bya ba'i 'du shes chags par bya rgyu/ 'di dag la re zhig bar thag gis chod na yang gang ltar mi bu la do khur bya rgyu ni deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi ches rtsa ba'i 'byung spus yin phyin/ nga tshos nges par du mi ser dkyus ma dang dmangs phal ba tsho'i tshe srog la brtsi 'jog dang /mi bu re re nas 'dra mnyam du blta thub rgyu/ mi bu re re nas 'tsho gnas la hur thag gis re snyeg byas chog pa'i dbang char brtsi 'jog bya rgyu gal/de ltar byas na/ phyogs gang ci'i tshad las brgal ba'i gnon shugs dang gdug tsub che zhing snying rje bral ba'i ljoritsho tshis des kho tsho'i tshe srog la nyob mdangs kyis khyab par mi byed par gson shugs kyis brtas par byed nges/ de bzhin du gshis rgyud dang 'byung spus kyi 'od snang yang mog por mi gtang bar lhan ner 'tsher nges/ rgya yig gi〈dpe klog〉(2004ro'i 'don thengs11pa'i shog ngos27par gsal)ces pa'i dus deb tu 'di ltar bkod 'dug ste/ nye sngon wu khu lan(6ṭ+wāṃ ༅)rgyal khab nas phag — 24 —

mi ser da sa ma'i 'cho ba'i bang ris la nye bar bcar ba/gson po khyu zhig rlangs 'khor la bzhag ste dus tshod drug cu lhag 'gor rjes h+pha ran si'i rgyal khongs la thon par/ rgyal khab des phyi 'gog gis nang du yong gi ma bcug rgyu mtshan ni/ srog chags kyi bde skyid la ma bsam pa ste/ yun ring 'grul bzhud kyi khrod dus tshod kyi thag gcod ltar ngal gso ma byas pa red zer/ 'di 'dra'i srog chags kyi bde skyid la bsam pa'i 'du shes ni nga tsho'i‘‘mar gyur sems can thams cad’’zer ba las ches cher chung drags nas 'gran bdo ba ye nas ma yin rung /de la rtsa khrims kyi thag gcod sngon du 'gro bas yo gal 'chos sa gtan nas mi 'gro ba red/ kho tsho'i de ni nga tsho ltar du/ kha nas sdig bshags kyi 'don chog gyer bzhin lag tu shan gri thogs te dmar gsod byed pa'i snang tshul dang 'dra ba ma red la gzhi mthun pa'i gnas kyang mi 'dug kho tshos de la rang gi srog lta bur gces 'dzin dang dam srung byed pas red/ de ni phyi'i zol tshul tsam ma yin par kha zhe gnyis med nas de ltar red/ da bar thun mong gis khas len zhing rgyal spyi'i thogre/ thag bcad par/ srog chags la rang dbang lnga dang ldan te/ ltogs skom thebs mi chog pa'i rang dbang / 'tsho ba skyid po rol ba'i rang dbang / rma/ khas zhed snang dang rims nad kyis mnar gcoja/ byarmos niri chog pa'i rang dbang / 'tsho ba la 'jigs skrag skul mi chog pa'i rang dbang / rang bi lhan skyes kyi gshis rgyud mngon chog pa'i rang dbang — 25 ——

semyo55 la gyi 'pho nyul/bcas so/ /de sla mo go bder bshad na/ srog chags de lta bu gso ba dang lag chags pa/ gsod pa'am bsha' ba'i go rim khrod sdug bsngal je nyung la gtong ci thub kyis brnyas dmod gang 'dod du byas mi chog par bstan/ de bas/ nga tsho'i mi ser dkyus ma dang dmangs phal ba tshor yang de 'dra'i cha rkyen ldan par byed mi thub rung / ches ma mtha' yang‘‘mi bu’’ru bltas nas‘‘'dra mnyam’’gyi 'du shes bskyed rgyu ni ji 'dra'i mkho che ang /

na nga pa'i‘‘bdag’’gi mthong chulasnyan ngag pa'i‘‘bdag’’gi mthong tshul/da wagangs zhun gyi snyan ngag〈me la sgron mkhan〉dang〈rang la smras pa〉bklags rjes/〈me la sgron mkhan〉1 snyan rtsom 'di'i 'go slong la‘‘nga 'bar bzhin yod cing(nga me la sgron mkhan de nga rang nyid yin’’zhes bkod nas rtsa ba'i gdangs dbyangs grub la 'chad 'gyur gyi sta gon yang byas 'dug pa dang / bar du rgyu mtshan dang 'phros bshad mthong tshor stug por byas 'dug/mjug tu bden cog cog gi ra sprod kyi rting gnon la yang bskyar ‘nga 'bar bzhin yod cing(nga me la sgron mkhan de nga rang nyid yin’’'es bkod par kho bos sbyor dngos rjes gsum ste sbyor ba 'go phyag 'tshal ba dang dngos gzhi bar gyi brjod pa/ rjes su bsngo smon 'debs pa'i b.ratshodar srol rgyun snyan ngag(chos pa'i snyan ngag)cig gi sgrom gzhi dran yong la/rang cag ston pa sangs rgyas kyis ji skad du/ bdag ni bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ / gzhan lta su zhi/ga mgon du gyur/ // bdag nyid kho na legs/ btul na/ / rnyed par dka' ba'i mgon rnyed gyur/ / zhes pa'i legaru bshad gser thur zhig kyang dran yong / 'di ni cha mi 'grig cing do mi mnyam pa'i dran 'phrul rigs shig yin shas che mod/ gang ltar 'di ni — 27 ge

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/snyan rtsom 'dis sbyin pa'i tshor ba thog ma red/2 ‘‘nga 'bar bzhin yod cing(nga me la sgron mkhan de nga rang nyid yin’’zhes mgo mjug tu res mos su 'byung ba la gcig grogs gcig tu 'gro zhing gcig rgyab gcig gis bsnon nas‘‘nga’’zhes pa las rnyed pa'i rang bkur dang nga rgyal/ rtsis thang yod tshul dang‘‘rang gis rang nyid ngos zin bgyis dang’’zer ba las thob pa'i man ngag gang gi gnad rtogs yod tshul ltar du snang rung / bar bcug spros brjod(yab mes kyi re ba/ pha ma'i 'khar rten/ na gzhon spun zla tsho'i nyams snang / bu phrug gi rmi lam)kyirgyu mtshan ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam zhing rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang 'dres pas bar srub khab mig 'gro sa tsam yang rnyed dka' ba la gzhigs na/‘‘nga’’las rnyed pa'i nga ltar snang tsam du zad la ches cher 'phags zin pa'i‘‘che bris kyi mi bu’’(oṃphotshirki) ru slong skrun byas yod stabs mkhas mdzangs gnyis ldan gyi‘‘thams cad mkhyen pa’’'am‘‘spyan stong can’’du mthong bas yid smon dang gong bkur gyi gnas su khas 'ches mod/don gyis kha phra lto ldir zhabs 'jong gi rdza bum zhig gi snang brnyan yid la wa ler 'char yong bas‘‘sger tshugs’’dang‘‘rang tshugs’’kyi zhabs zung brtam/ min yang rtogs nus /3 snyan ngag ni tshig gi rol rtsed dang tshig rgyan gyis spud che ba'i phyi don tshul 'chos de ma yin par rang sems dungs zhen gyi myong tshor zab — 28 —

snyan nga pa'i‘ bdag’’gi mthong chul/mo ches nying 'dus kyi tshig gam skad chas mtshon pa la/ snyan rtsom 'dir tshig ngos nas‘‘nyam re chung’’dang‘‘yid re phangs’’‘‘blo re pham’’zhes 'gyod gdung gi ngang tshul dang‘‘kye kye’’‘‘ka ye’’zhes thengs mang du brjod nas 'bod skul byed bzhin‘‘dungs zhen gyi rigs zhen’’che tshul zhig bstan yod rung don ngo mar nyis stong lo'i〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〉(tshig ngos rkyang ba)yi 'dra gzugs red lags/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉la rtsom rig sgyu rtsal rkyang ba'i ngos na gdeng 'jog gi dge mtshan med kyang dus rabs kyi 'phel phyogs dang lo rgyus kyi ngos/ gas ra gtod kyi ngos/ gzhon nu tshor snying stobs bstsol pa'i ngos/ da dung dbyangs rta'i 'gyur khugs la 'tsham pa'i gyer 'don gyi ngos bcas na dge mtshan gyi go sa mi dman pa zhig zin na/ khyod kyi de la ci zhig gi khyad rtags yod/4 snyan ngag pa nyi ma bzhin zla ba ltar a sngon mthongs dbyings nas bzhugs te dma' dog mo la gzigs kyin yod stabs/ thams cad rig 'a yod tshad gsal gyi ler rtogs/ 'das pa nges la ma 'ongs pa yang lhag tu gsal na/ khos rang nyid yo/da tshad kyi rtse mo'am bla ma 'i yang bla ma yin tshul gyis nga tsho la rang nyid kyi‘‘gnas thob’’ston bzhin 'dug khos nga tsho la skyon brjod byed pa las nga tsho dang 'dra ma/nyamyopu gyiru gnas 'dod med/ khos lhod g.yeng gi bsam tshul brje res khrod nga —— 39 —

(spuzugib yi 3) shun24 sdo/chub/tshor sems gso bya 'dod med la/ lhag tu nga tsho la blo 'byed kyi dra yol phye 'dod med/ khos yod tshad mkhyen zin pa dang nga tsho rmongs mun khrod gnas pas‘‘dpung ba mnyam gshib’’kyi bgo skal bral/5 snyan ngag ni ci zhig 'chad rgyu mi gtso bar ji ltar spro rgyu gtso bas rang gi mgrin pas rang nyid kyi smra brjod skyor dgos na/ snyan rtsom 'di la bye brag rang mtshan pa'i khyad rtags med par kun bzhed gcig mthun gyi thun mong 'dra chos can du yod tsang / ‘‘nga’’ni skyon kun bsal yon tan kun rdzogs kyi yod tshad blos gtong thub pa can yin la‘‘khyod’’(ngatsho dang gzhan mi)ni skyon kun 'dzoms yon tan kun spangs la mthong na/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i rang grol gyi lang tsho'i rbab chu dang co 'dri ba'i phugs bsam gyi gzhon nu'i lang tsho'i gom sgra mngon 'gyur bya ma thub pa'i nang snying rtogs la/ snyan ngag pa khyod(nga)kyis kyang nga tsho'i gnas bab ji bzhin du brjod tshul gyis lam bu gang du khrid par cha ma 'tshal/6 snyan ngag pas ltar snang spyi mtshan gyi‘‘nga’’tsam las cung 'grig cha rang dod pa'i‘‘bdag’’nyid ma rnyed pas‘‘me la sgron mkhan’’de yang sgam po spyang mdog gi kha g.yang 'bod skul du song la chab srid pa'i sgrog sbyong snyan zhur gyur song bas snyan ngag pa'i shes rtogs dang dpyod zhib kyi zab tshad ga re/〈rang la smras pa〉ge 3/) bhe

nga pa'i‘‘bad ’’ mthong tshul/1 mi bu yan gar ba re rer rang gi bsam tshod dang nus tshod cig nges can du bdog na/ a sngon mthongs dbyings su gzhan rten gyi zla grogs dang bral zhing / kher hreng hreng ngang gshog rtsal gyi skyen 'gyur mngon pa'i bya glag ji bzhin 'tsho ba dngos la zhugs nas spyi tshogs kyi rgya khar bzhag na da gzod rang gi ljid tshad ngo ma shes nges la/ ‘‘rang’’las rnyed pa'i mi bu zhig gi rin thang de yang bya glag cig gi 'dur rgyug ngang tshul las rtogs thub/2 dge chos kyis‘‘shing gi ka chen zhig mi lnga bcus drangs te lha khang de bzhengs bya ba sogs gtam dkyus mar bsam ste rtsis med du bzhag nas/ lcags kyi ka ba ri bong mjug mar btags te drangs pa'i lo rgyus sogs la ches yid 'phrog pa'i byis pa chung ngu'i gshis lugs te gong du 'phel ’’(〈dge chos gsung rtsom〉pod dang po'i2 185—186)ces gna' bo'i rgya gar gyi 'ud brjod dang sgro btags de'i dbang gis nga tshos‘‘stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la mnga' mdzad’’ces pa la rgyan gyi mdzes mthar bsam nas snyan ngag gi tog tu go na/ ‘‘khyod kyi ljid tshad rgya ma stong phrag yod’’dang‘‘khyod nyid gangs kyi rang mdangs yin’’‘‘lce ring bos go lar dkris gsum brgyab’’‘‘la/ chen pos 'jis/ rten kham du byed’’ces pa sogs kyang des bskyed pa'i 'bras rtags su nges/ der snyan ngag pas kyang brtag pa mtha' bzung dang dgag ches — 3 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/gis‘‘tshig gi rol rtsed’’du khas 'ches te/ 'tsho ba nam yang don dam khrod mthud dgos la/ bsam bkod nam yang lag len brgyud nas mngon dgos par 'dod pa ni mtho nam mkha' nas dma' dog mor bab pa'i‘‘mi bu’’zhig gi mthong thos myong gsum gyi rang mdangs dang nye/3 'jig rten 'khor ba'i bde sdug btang snyoms kyi rgya ma ci 'dra'i do mi mnyam zhing ya yo che na'ang blo mi 'khum/ bag mi tsha bar dran tshad lag len du bstar na rgyal kha ste/ de ni gzhan gyi zer sgros su chu sna gar khrid ltar 'brangs mi dgos par rang nyid la rang tshod kyi myong ba yod pas red/ de'i thog dpa' mi zhum/ sgyid mi lug par lag len mtha' 'khyol thub pa gzi brjid yin na/ 'khor ba'i bde sdug gi 'gran rtsod la dngos su zhugs pa yang rang nyid 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho ba'i bden dpang btsan po dang thob thang brjid po yin stabs/ sngar bas kyang gting rim la snyeg pa'i‘‘mi bu’’yi slong skrun red/4 gal te kha g.yang trem dang stong bsam tsam gyis rang gi dus tshod dang lang tsho/ 'tsho ba sogs don med du bskyur na mi tshe'i bshul lam la rjes bzhag gi ri mo bral bas phyir dran gyi brjed tho med la/gzhan ngom du ri ba zhig kyang stong na/ mi tshe'i rin thang dang thob thang zhes pa gang / tag tag dngos yod lag len khrod nas rang gis rang nyid mngon 'gyur bya dgos na/ rang nyid gdeng 'jog gi rgyal kha yang — 32 —

snyan nga pa'i‘‘bad ’’ mthong tshul/de na mchis la rang nyid ngos zin gyi me long yang de na bdog de bas dngos yod 'tsho ba ni bden dpang btsan po'i rgya mar mthong ba dang chabs cig mi mthun ldog phyogs nas‘‘mi bu’’yi slong skrun la rting gnon byas yod/5 mkhas dbang sar tharadunas‘‘mi'i gzhi grub ni ma gzhi nas snying bo med rung rang dbang gis kha gsab bya chog de bas khyod kyis rang nyid ngo bo ci lta bu'i mi zhig tu byed par rang gis gsar gtod byed dgos pas‘gzhi grub ni ngo bo las snga’’’(〈gzhi grub dang stong pa〉)zhes pa'i sdom tshig thal lo/ /de ltar dngos yod spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod nas rang gis rang la nyams sad dang phyir rtog gis bzo bcos byas na‘‘rang la gtsang sbra yag po’’bya thub pas rgyal kyang rung / pham yang bla/ da lta'i khyod ni khyod nyid ngo ma bo red/ kha g.yor sa/ khag dgal yul ci yang med/ dge yang nyes rung / rang nyid las le bda' byed yul bral bas so/ /rang ni rang nyid ngo mar bcos nas rang nyid kyi rin thang legs 'grub byung na/ 'di'i ngo bo ni rgyal kha yin/ da dung nying/ kyis rtogs pa'i rang 'gan de yang ches cher 'phags pa'i rtags su 'ches so/ /brtsamaṭā chosalhar+shablo zlob/ sdo/ rtsing nā‘sh+lauṅgis dzī spyu1905—1980)h+pha ran si'i rtsom mkhan dang mtshan nyid rig pa mkham — 33 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/'phros gtam/1 nga tshos rang nyid bsam dgos la mi bu yan gar ba re re nas 'greng tshugs su yong thub par brtson dgos/ de ma gtogs〈me la sgron mkhan〉ltar du‘‘bdag nyid’’bor ba'i shes yon can gyi ngang tshul 'changs nas/ rang nyid kyis yod tshad mkhyen zin pas mtho sa'i 'od 'khyims la bzhugs te gzhan la 'bod skul dang rgyang 'bod byas na/lo ngo nyi shu'i ring la 'phel rgyas kyi rgyal kha ma blangs par so na 'phel med du 'gul bzhin pa'i lang tsho'i gom sgra bzlog mi thub la/ de'i rmang 'ding sa'i sa gcog la yang ngos zin gsal po med pa dang chen po chen po zhig dgongs nas chung ba'i yang chung gi bye brag re re la do snang ma byas pa'i gnad kyang rtogs mi thub/ de bzhin du rang nyid mi bsam par khas 'ches pa'i sgam tshugasdori kyi lta spyod de'i mnam dri myags dri snom mi thub/ de dag la mtshon na/ ‘‘bdag’’ni rang nyid la dma' 'bebs thebs pa'i 'gag rdo dang rang nyid mi chung du lta ba'i than ltas su mthong bas red/ yin yang / da snga nga tshos kha phyir 'khor mi bya bar kha nang 'khor gyis rang gi dpyad zhib rang nyid la gtod dgos/ 〈rang la smras pa〉〉ltar du bdag gi ba yod pa'i‘‘nga’’dang bdag gi 'dzin pa yod pa'i‘‘rang’’la bcar ci thub kyis phyir rtog dang mno bsam bzhes na/— 34 —

nga pa'i‘‘bad ’’ mthong tshul/‘‘mi rang nyid nas 'go rtsom dgos’’zer ba ltar mi yan gar ba re re nas 'greng tshugs su 'gro thub la/ sger tshugs su langs thub pas〈rang la smras pa〉〉ni〈me la sgron mkhan〉〉las rnyed pa'i mi bu yan gar ba re re'i mi tshe mngon 'gyur bya thabs te/ ‘‘bdag ni mi'i mdun lam dang mi'i rig gnas/ mi'i 'byung spus/ mi'i 'tsho gnas sogs yongs rdzogs thag gcod byed red/’’(〈dogs slong snying stobs〉2 281) de bas/ bdag yod na mi tshe yod la/ mi tshe'i rin thang yod/ tha na mi bu rang rtsis can du'ang 'gyur thub pas so /2 snyan ngag ni btsan shed dang sha btsir khrag btsir gyis brjod pa ma yin par 'jam mnyen lhod grol gyi gsed 'grol can yin/ btsan brjod ni snyan ngag pas rtsom gyi rgyu cha legs sgrig byed dus chig rkyang ba'i mthong sne dang yang dag gi tshul gyis klog pa por kho'i mi chos dbye gcod dang rin thang langs phyogs/ dungs sems g.yo phyogs bcas thad kar‘‘shes brjod’’byed pa yin/ 'di lta bu'i snyan ngag gi phyi ngos la bltas na gsal rtogs dang phugs brtol yin rung don gyis skam rid du gyur pa'i kun spyod lugs bshad du gyur yod thog yid sems 'i/ba tshagasaci kyis mdzes par spud pa'i‘‘mdzes rtsom bslabatsho ta’’ ru'ang gyur yo da/ kun spyod lugs bshad kyis dngos po'i ngo bo de sla bcos dang sger gcodatshokyis 'di ltar dbye yod de/ bzang dang ngan/ ngo bo dang snang tshu' /— 35 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/bden lugs dang rdzun ma/ dge dang skyon no/ /'di ni rgyu gnyis kha gtad kyi bsam gzhig byed stangs dang nges shes 'dzin tshul red la/'dis mi rnams kyis phyi rol yul chos la ngos 'dzin byed dus go rim gyi 'brel ba bstan yod thog dngos po'i gcig gyur rang bzhin dang gtan 'jags rang bzhin/ 'gyur med rang bzhin bcas 'bur thon byas yod/ ldog ste dngos po'i 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dang bar khyad rang bzhin/ 'gul ba'i rang bzhin/ 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin gyi nus pa gnon ci thub dang sbed ci thub byas yod na/ 'dis go rim gyi 'brel ba ston pa'i sger gcod smra ba'i bsam gzhig de btsan gyis mngon yod/ gal te 'di 'dra'i u tshugs can gyi bsam gzhig byed stangs te rgyu gnyis kha gtad smra ba las brgal ma thub tshe/ nga tsho'i ngos 'dzin gyi nus pa rim bzhin je zhan yin pa ma gtogs de la 'pho 'gyur chen po gtan nas 'byung mi srid/ de bzhin tu snyan ngag ni ches sla ba'i kun spyod kyi 'dod bzhes su gyur na/ snyan ngag pas ci cha mi 'tshal bar drang bden dang dwangs gtsang / mthar thug gi do khur yod tshad rang nyid kyi phyogs su 'greng yod pa'i 'ud sgrog mthong tshor du byed/ phyi tshul nas snyan ngag 'di la‘‘gcig 'du rang bzhin’’ldan yod kyang don ngo mar de ni‘‘hrud sbrebs can’’gyi skya sob sob red/ de bas/ 'di ltar byas na snyan ngag gi sna mang rang bzhin dang klog pa por 'dra mnyam gyis gleng — 36 —

snyan ngag pa'i‘‘bdag’’ mthong tshul/mol byed pa'i 'os sbyor med brlag tu bzos zin la/ bya dngos rang steng na ma gzhi nas grub yod pa'i rnyog dra'i ngang tshul yang sbed par byas yod/ gsed 'grol ni bya dngos la sna mang can du lta ba rgyun 'khyongs kyis tha snyad kyi phyogs mang po'i sdeb sgrig la brten nas de nyid kyi nang rim na gnas pa'i ltos bcas mang po gsal ston dang mngon 'gyur la gzhol bar brtson thog klog pa po'i mno bsam dang dri ba/ rang dbang gi gsar gtod kyi dbang cha bcas la ram 'degs mthun rkyen skrun pa'o/ /

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/rtog 'jug gi dpyod shes pa /mi lo bdun brgya lhag gi yar sngon du yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po se chen hanadu gyis dgung lo bcu dgur son ma thag pa'i 'gro mgon 'phags pa la/ ‘‘khyed bod kyi yul du mi che ba su dang su byung / bu dpa' bo(phorgodapo)su byung / yon tan can su byung’’zhes dri ba gnang bar 'phags pas/ ‘‘nged bod la mi che ba chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum byung / bu dpa' bo mi la ras pa byung / yon tan can sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta byung’’zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas te the tshom med par lan btab/red ya// rje btsun mi la ras pa ni mi kha dang bdud rigs gang la'ang mi skrag pa'i rang sems snang ba glu ru 'dren nus pa'i nges don gyi dpa' bo ste/ sku tshe stod la chags sdang gi rus thon zhing la rgya yi dgra 'khon brlan pa'i ngan sngags mkhan zhig red la/ sku tshe bar du 'gyod bshags kyi sdig sbyong la mkhar brtsigs kyi las la gzhol ba'i snying stobs can zhig red/ sku tshe smad du rang sems rang la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i chos kyi dpa' bo bsgrun med cig tu gyur pa bcas la lugs gnyis rtsod 'gal med par bzhed pa red/thog dahā po/se chen rgyal po/ ( lho7sa 1215—1294)sog po'i rgyal rabs kyi rgyal thog lnga pa dang yon rgyal rabs kyi khri — 38 —

'ju daphyod sa pa/rje mi la ni bod kyi chos pa gang mang ltar du grags 'dod dang khe 'dod can gyi‘‘'dod sred pa’’sha stag cig min la/ ‘‘rang yang 'khor bar bying ba la/ /gzhan mgon byed pa ya re nga’’lta bu zhig kyang gtan nas ma red/ khong gi nye 'khor na 'di dag gnas sa ye nas med pa rus sbal gyi spu bzhin red/ dgun zla'i grang ngar ji ltar tsub rung ras rkyang gi na bza' la brten nas dben yul dang gnas nges med du zhabs kyis bcags myong / da dung las rung shin sbyangs kyi lus sems gnyis kyi bdag por rang nyid las gzhan ci yang med de/ thengs shig rang gi sring mos khong nyid dmar rjen gcer bur bzhugs pa la ltar ma bzod nas ngo gdong lag pas bkab pa la/ khong gis‘‘'jig rten pa rnams ngo tsha ba la mi tsha zhing mi tsha ba la tsha ba red’’ces gsungs nas phyi rol mi kha rna rgyab kyi rlung bzhin mdzad nas lus sems gnyis kyi skyabs mgon du rang nyid gyur cing / lhag par‘‘bdag nyid bdag gis rtogs pa'i’’dpa' bo red lags/‘‘dpa' bo’’zhes pa ni mtha' gcig tu g.yul 'thab la mdzangs shing 'jigs bsnyengs bral ba zhig la ngos 'dzin pa'i nges pa med na/dpa' bo la'ang dus kyi dbang gis tshad gzhi 'jog stangs mi 'dra bas/da skabs bod rang la mtshon na/ dpa' bo zhes pa ni bsam blo gsar pa de phyir sgrog byed thub pa'i snying stobs can zhig la go na phan par snyam/— ni9 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/de ltar lags na/ mi che ge mo zhig gis nga la‘‘da skabs bod kyi dpa' bo su red’’ces dri ba bton pa yin na/ bdag gis the tshom med par‘‘sku zhabs zhogs dung lags red’’ces lan gdab nges yin/'di thos pa tsam gyis mang mang gis nga la 'phya dgod kyi zur mda' 'phen bzhin‘‘blun po kha nag’’cig gam yang na‘‘zhogs dung gi rjes 'brangs pa’’red ces mi gleng ba'i nges pa ci la med/ khyod tshos ji ltar bshad na'ang chog te/ khyod tshor rang gi 'dod pa ji bzhin du brjod chog pa'i dbang cha yod par ngas nam yang brtsi 'jog byed pa yin/ de la h+pha ran si'i mkhas pa grags can h+phol theraduyis 'di skad du/‘‘khyod kyi lta tshul la nga rang 'thad pa min rung / khyod kyis rang lugs 'don pa'i dbang cha la ngas rang gi gces srog gis srung skyob byed nges yin’’zhes gsungs yod pa dang nga tshos da lta brtson len byed bzhin yod pa'ang‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’yin pas so/ /red ya/ khyed tshos sku zhabs nyid la‘‘ma rtogs log rtog gi bdud kyis brlan pa’’dang‘‘ha cang thal drags song’’da dung‘‘smyon pa'i smyo gtam kho na’’dang‘‘khe grags 'dod pa red’’sogs yin min bco brgyad bshad nas rang rang gi dran tshul brjod chog na/ ngas ci'i phyir de ltaramatshanañtsādadze+epathesgo/na(myo0pretram̐shārmits+tshaklonārgyunasnyedzildirgo/ṇ+ḍaṃ7rtsulhasgyu ñdzan+da gār+sha lbo shābyet+na bsam blo mkhan dang rtsom mkhan/— 40 — du

ga 'jug gi daphyod shesapa/‘‘dpa' bo'i cho lo’’bstsal na mi chog gam/ da skabs mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin pa rmang byas nas khyod kyi bshad chog la/ ngas kyang gleng chog pa ma sgrub rang grub yin na/ sgyu rtsal pa sman blas‘‘nga yang kha chung dbang chung yin rung / kha zhig grag na 'dod gi’’zer ba bzhin rang sems glu ru len pa'i skad ngag med kyang / smyug rtse'i gom 'gros 'degs nus phyir rang sems kyi 'khyer so tsam gleng ba yin/sku zhabs zhogs dung lags ni dus rabs gsar pa dang lo rabs gsar pa'i dkyogs mtshams su 'grengs pa'i bod mi rigs kyi dpa' bo zhig tu mdzub mo nang 'gug sgos bgrangs chog snyam/ khos da lta'i rang mi rigs kyi 'phel rgyas ha cang nyag phra ba la bsam nas// spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab de ci 'dra zhig yin pa la dkar nag gdong 'ded kyis dmar rjen du bton nas/ bltas na myong rgyu yod pa dang bsam na rtogs rgyu yod pa'i brtsams chos ljid po zhig nga tsho'i mig mdun du bkram pa red la/ mkhas pa mang mang gis bsam yod kyang rang rang gi snyan grags la gnod dogs nas phyir phyung thub kyin med pa'i‘‘mkhas pa'i yon tan khong du sbed’’pa'i ngang tshul yongs su dor nas sngon bslogs byas pa red/khe 'dod dang grags 'dod tsam la dmigs pa gtan nas ma yin par mi rigs la dungs zhen gyi dbang gis brdol ba'i zungs khrag gi mchod pa red de/ khong gis‘‘gal te bod mi rigs kyi 'phel rgyas dang 'tsho — 41 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/gnas la phan thogs phran bu re 'byung thub na/ nga rang nyid lo rgyus nyes can mi sna ru gyur kyang 'gyod pa spu tsam yang med’’ces bshad yod pas kyang nges shes gsal po 'drongs nus/gal te mang mang gis mgrin gcig tu sku zhabs la smyon pa'i gdong rtags las dpa' bo'i cho lo gzhar yang mi thob zer na/ kho bos 'dir mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas brjod phod pa zhig la/ mi la ras pa la'ang dpa' bo'i cho lo mi thob par smyon pa'i cho lo thob pa('dir rje mi lar skur ba 'debs pa ma yin par skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi ngos nas gleng ba yin)smra med yin pa khong gi rnam thar la ltos dang / gsal kha 'byed nges te khong gis 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag la snang dogs ye nas mi byed pas so/ /sku zhabs lags ni snying stobs kyi ded dpon dang bsam blo yi mdun skyod mkhan yin pas/ 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉kyis me shugs 'phur mda'itshotheg tshad 'khur nas bag la nyal ba'i bod yul 'di zang zing gi 'ur tsha se btang ba dang / tha na rang mal skyid par bsam pa'i 'phyi ba khong 'dzul la'ang rnam rig gi 'dri rtags 'phangs byung bas/lu'u zhun0gyi〈nga ro'i〉sgul shugs ni khyod kyi zur tsam la'ang mi do/'dir sku zhabs lags la re 'bod cig byed 'dod pa ni/'gatahā rgyumāṃwiginā /'añdzurno7 1881—1936)krung go'i rtsom rig mkhan dang bsam blo mkhan/ brtsams chos a— 42 ge

'ju daphyod sa pa/〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉'di 'jig rten 'dir skyes nas grogs med kher rkyang gi ldom po zhig tu mi gtong ba'i ched du/ de la sha nye dang 'brel ba'i bu rabs tsha rgyud gang mang lu gu brgyud du bstar bar zhu snying 'dod pa nyid do/ /da bar grags tshul zhig la kha yar grag la rgya nag gi mkhas dbang che ge mo dang kha mar grag la nub gling gi mkhas dbang che ge mo zhes lung drangs na tshang mas sdigs dmod byed yul du 'gyur bzhin pa'i rlung 'tshub cig ldang bzhin yod mod/ kho bos 'dir sku zhabs nyid la rgya nag gi mkhas pa lu'u zhun gyi gsung zhig mi 'dren thabs med yin pas khyod nyid mi dgyes pa mi mdzad par zhu/ 'di skad du‘‘don ngo mar 'jig rten 'dir lam rtsa ba nas med mod/ 'gro mi mang po byung na/de yang lam zhig tu gyur 'gro’’zhes gsungs pa ltar du khyod kyi 'di yang lam zhig tu 'gyur bar bod yul gyi da lta'i na gzhon gang mang gi re ltos nyag cig go/

sems khral gyi 'pho nyul/dgongs don dang dgos don/ gtam brjod zur ba/nye char〈rtsod pa'i rlabs phreng〉zhes pa'i ngur smrig pa'i zhing khams nas thon pa'i nang khul gyi sger gnyer dus deb cig nga tsho bod yul g.yang gi ra ba 'di'i yig ngo chod pa'i skyes bo rnams kyi gzigs mo'i longs spyod kyi gsos su bstar bzhin pa la/ ched du nga tsho slob chen pa'i rang dbang gi smra brjod dang rang dbang gi bsam blo(dmigs yul ni da lta'i bod spyi tshogs kyi ngan mtshang ther 'don dang rig gnas kyi snang tshul ngan pa dkar 'don gyis dgag sgrub byed pa'o)spro sa'i sa zhing gshin po〈shar dung ri〉dus deb la gzas pa red/ lar rig gnas kyi ngos nas brjod na/ brgal brtag gi rtsod pa rab tu bdo ba dang dgag sgrub kyi me stag rab tu mched pa ni dga' 'os pa'i don bya rmad byung zhig yin lags te/ kha mi tshang ba tshang bar byed pa/ 'thus shor ba la gun gsab gtong ba/ spang blang rnam gcod kyi rab dbye la bden pa bdar ba sogs snga rgol phyi rgol gang la'ang shin tu sman pa'i gsos su 'gro bas red/ yin yang /kun slong ma dag pa dang dgag bzhag spro tshul ma bzang na sngo zhing g.ya' dag pa'i dga' snang mdzes snang gi khor yug gtsang yangs shig 'byung mi thub par du smug lang long gi 'dam dri rdzob dri bro ba'i skyo po sdug po yi‘‘sdigs mo'i kha rtsod’’kho nar 'khums/— 44 —

dgongs do dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/spyi lo2005lo'i〈rtsod pa'i rlabs phreng〉gi 'don thengs gsum pa'i steng du/ ban shul dpal mkhar rgyal lags kyis bris pa'i〈‘‘rtog 'jug gi dpyod shes pa’’zhes pa'i lan du smras pa 'khrul sel 'od kyi zer ma〉zhes pa de ni/ kho bos bris pa'i〈rtog 'jug gi dpyod shes pa〉〉(〈shar dung ri〉'don thengs bcu drug pa'i steng 'khod) zhes par ched du gzas pa zhig red/ ban shul lags kyis kho bo'i kha byang de la tshig rgyan gyis spras pa'am yang na zhabs mchan tshig btags lhan thabs su bkod pa la/ji ltar kha byang las nang don mthong ba'i dpe bzhin‘‘'khrul sel’’gtos chen po zhig sngun la brjod 'dug phyir dang / ‘‘'od zer’’dwangs ma zhig gis mdun sa snang bar byas yod phyir/ ‘‘'khrul sel’’de'i don du dgongs don dang dgos don zhes pa'i dmigs pa ched bkar gyis 'god dgos byung la/ zhor du‘‘'od zer’’de la‘‘gtam brjod’’re 'ga' yang zur ba'i tshul du spro rgyu byung na/ de ltar rtsom las kha byang rnyed pa'i lugs su〈dgongs don dang dgos don/ gtam brjod zur ba〉gsong bor brjod pa lags/gcig ban shul lags kyi rtsom de ni nga rang nyid la mtshon na dga' ba'i gnas shig red/ rang rtsom de la de ltar rna ba blags mkhan dang bsam gzhig gtong mkhan yod thog skyon cha ther 'don la gzhol na rang re'i gshis su grub pa'i bzang cha la mngon par phyogs shing da 45 da

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/ngan cha la mig bsher tsam yang mi byed pa'i srol rgyun rgyud ngan de las ldog tshod du snang yang / khos skyon cha la mngon par phyogs shing bzang cha la mig bsher tsam yang med pa'i rtsom gshis kyi bab la bltas na sngar bzhin ris su chad pa'i rgyu ma khog 'dres su mthong / gang ltar kho bos ni snying thag pa nas bka' drin zhu gi yin/ yin na'ang / de la dga' ba tsam dang bka' drin zhu ba tsam gyis‘‘dpa' bo’’(kho bo'i rtsom de'i brjod bya la go)de la sdang ba'i nang don ye nas med/ des na/ dga' ba'i rgyu dang spro ba'i rkyen ni nga rang gi rtsom de'i rtsom gyi zil shugs dang rtsom nyams te/ ‘‘chab srid pa'i kha g.yang sgrog pa’’lta bu la khos nyams lon pa dang rgyus che bar rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyis brjod byung ba la 'brel ba zab mo mchis/ red de/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i rang grol gyi〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉nas bzung ste/ snyan ngag pa grog tshang brdol ba ltar byung la/ de dag gis kyang snyan ngag ni kha g.yang sgrog pa lta bu'i go lugs la 'byams pas snyan ngag sgyu rtsal gyi myong rtog gi zab tshad ga re/de ni snyan ngag pa kho na'i skyon du ma zad kyi/ dus rabs kyi 'gyur ba la'ang 'brel ba dam por gda'/ de bzhin du 'bol rtsom so ma dar bzhin pa'i nga tsho la mtshon na'ang / 'bri mkhan mang po med par nyung nyung byung ba dag gis kyang ched du rig gnas kyi mi gtsang ba ste/bltar mi bzod pa dang bsam mi bzod pa la kha gtad nas dgag sgrub — 46 —

da ngas don dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/kyi mda' mo 'phangs bas mang mang gi klad par tsag shar rgyug la snying khams su g.yo ba rab tu rgyas/ zhor du de dag la lad mo yis rang gi‘‘smra ba’’brjod mkhan yang der mthun gyis byung / mi tshang ma'i re 'dod du/ lam zhig yin na thog ma nyid nas gzhung che khod yangs su byung na bsam/ bya ba zhig yin na thabs lam gtsang ma'i sgo nas su la'ang mi gnod cing gang la'ang sman pa'i dgos 'dod du 'byung na re/gang ltar thog ma dang gdod ma nyid nas sam 'go rtsom dus nyid nas lam lhongs yangs po dang rang gzhan gang la'ang mi gnod pa'i gnas su ji 'anga'i brtson che ang / rim car ba'i lugs rmeg med du btang nas cig car ba'i srol la dga' mos kyi bsam yan ji 'dra'i gzhol che phya/nga /yin yang / don dag dngos la zhugs na/ sgrub thabs ni de las ldog phyogs kho nar 'gro bas de ni mi re gnyis kyi skyon du mi 'gro bar nga tsho 'gro ba mi'i rigs thun mong la snang ba'i‘‘zhan cha’’zhig tu zad/ sgrub thabs ni gnad bo che dang thabs dam pa lags na/ legs nyes la nyin mtshan dus drug tu bya ra dang mel tshe mkho ba yang mi'i mig zung gi dod du 'gro /der brten/ ‘‘zhan cha’’yod par mthong / mthong nas rtog rtog nas dpyod/ dpyod nas bshags/ bshags nas yo bsrang ba ni bla nas blar 'gro ba'i chos nyid du 'phrod na/ ‘‘zhan cha’’de mngon lkog gang rung nas gab sbed ma byas par de'i 'byung rkyen la rtog cing dpyod da 47 da

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/tshe/ zhan cha yod pa khas blangs thog rang gis rang la rang rtog cig kyang mi bya thabs med byung la/ ca tse gom tse'i go rim dkyus ma de yang mig rdzob kyi rkyen tu 'gro bar bsam nas mtha' gcig tu khas len med pa'i bcom chag skya nyil tu gtong ba'i bsam sbyor spel mi srid pas/ kho bos thog mar rang gi‘‘zhan cha’’de la gtsang bsher gyis ngos zin bgyis pa'o gnyis/ de dang chabs cig tu kho bos tshig re re dang 'bru re re la rtsod lan gyi brgal brtag gis khab gtsags 'big gtsags dang shig dang sro mang btsal btsal byed pa'i‘‘ring lugs’’gang gi zhib mo rnam 'thag gi rigs lam skyong mi 'dod la/ dngos po'i lhu lag re re nas so sor phral bzhin tha chung sde tshan gyi steng na dngos po gang de'i grib ma tsam yang med par ston bzhin lta ba gang de'i gnad rtogs tshul ston pa'i che tshugs sgam tshugs kyi 'gying nyams che mdog kha po yang byed mi 'dod/tag tag rtsom hril bo'am yongs khyab kyi steng nas thun mong spyi mthun gyi go ba mthar chags su lon par mi brtson par rang ngos nas go stobs rab rib bam phyogs res pa thob par 'bad 'bungs che na/ rtsom gang de'i skad cha spros brjod bya tshul dang de'i brjod bya'i dgongs don/ de ltar 'chad dgos pa'i dmigs bya'i dgos don bcas kyi steng nas go ba len lugs spro 'dod pas/ mi 'dod mi 'thad pa'i mgo bo g.yug — 48 —

da ngas do dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/mkhan la thog ma'i gtam gleng dang gsal 'debs kyi tshul du thal song /de la thog mar kho bos rtsom de rtsom dus kyi kun slong rnam par tshang ba ni da lta sngar bzhin ya yo med par kha mal na sor gnas kyis yod pa ma yin par/ rang gi rtsom gang de la 'or blta byed thengs re re dang da thengs ban shul gyi‘‘'khrul sel’’gyi rkyen pas myur du 'then sgam las phyir bton nas zhib lta byas na kun slong rab rib cig dang tsam po ba zhig da dung bags kyis mngon byung / de ni gzhan gang gis kyang min te/ rkyen dang rgyu la 'phrad pas so/ /der brten skabs de shed kyi kun slong nyid da thengs kyi kun slong tsam po bas rgyab snon pa'i go chod kyi tshul du smra ba la/skabs der ngas yid sems rnal mo dang zhib dag gis〈mi la'i mgur 'bum〉la mjal nas tshar la nye ba'i tshe na/ kho bo'i yid la glo bur du don dag cig ('char byung / de ni tag tag dge rgan che ge mo zhig gis slob khrid skabs su bshad pa'i zhor gtam red/ ‘‘zhor gtam’’de'i dgos dbang gis kho bos 'phral mar〈sa skya'i gdung rabs ngo mtshar bang mdzod〉btsal nas rags blta byed dgos song / red de/ dge rgan de'i‘‘zhor gtam’’don po rang du gnas yod de/ tshig dang 'bru re re nas kha 'phrod ngo 'phrod dang a 'grig cha 'grig rang ma yin dung /nang don dkyil snying la phog thug bzos mi 'dug phyir bdag gis kyang dpe ngos ltar ji bzhin ma bkod par zhor gtam de thal bar/ gtam — 49 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/nyung ba dang zor yang ba/ kha la 'khyer bde ba sogs dang / gzhan du na sa rgya mi gcod ched de 'dra'i‘‘stabs bde’’bkod pa ni tshig tshogs bskyung ba'i kun slong yin/ de nas kho bos rang rtsom na gsal ba'i dgung lo bcu dgu la son ma thag pa'i 'gro mgon 'phags pas sog po'i rgyal po la de ltar lan bskyon tshul la gzhigs nas gcig tu 'gro mgon gyis dgongs pa'i rje mi la ni ci lta bu yin pa la rus pa'i rgyan lags kyis mdzad pa'i〈mi la'i mgur 'bum〉la rang gi myong rol gzhi bcol nas/de de ltar yin pa la tshig nyung don 'dus kyis 'god zhor de la yin rkyen gyi khas len sgrub byed bkod pa lags/ gnyis su 'gro mgon gyis go bzhin pa'i‘‘dpa' bo’’de ci lta bu yin pa la skya rengs nyi gsal red la/sbrags te de'i pha rol gyi‘‘dgos don’’la yang mthong chung snang med du bskyur mi nyan par nges thog rig gnas khyab khongs gcig tu nges pa'i rus rgyud gcig pa dang rigs mthun pa la mngon par phyogs yod pa nges/grong tshig dmar rjen gyi skad dam tshang ma khong khro tog tsam slong ba'i rnam pa ga'/na du brjod na/ 'gro mgon khong yang rig gnas kyi phyogs zhen(chos lugs rig gnas)dbang du song yod pa rtogs nus/ rgyu mtshan ni 'gro mgon gyi‘‘dpa' bo’’des kho bor lo rgyus khrod kyi‘‘dpa' bo’’gzhan dag dran du bcug bod btsan po rgyal rabs skabs kyi dpa' mdzangs des gsum gyi skyen chen du ma dran/ blon chen mgar stong — 50 khe

da ngas don dang dgos don/ tam brjod zur ba/btsan dang de'i bu rabs tsha rgyud/ blon stag sgra klu kong la sogs red/de'i rkyen gyis‘‘dpa' bo'i go lugs’’la yang yul dus kyi chod pa gzhi byas mi rang rang gi dga' skyo chags sdang gis bcings yod pa'ang mi rtogs rang rtogs su 'gro na khas len min yang gsal po red lags/gsum du de 'dra'i sngon 'gro zhig mdun du btang zin na kho bos kyang‘‘dpa' bo’’la rang tshod kyi go ba gzhi byas de gnyis‘‘go bsdur’’la brten nas dgongs don rtogs dgos pa ni rtsom 'di'i mthar thug gi snying bo'o /kho bo'i‘‘go bsdur’’gyis lo rgyus su gyur zin pa'i dpa' bo dang kho bos 'dod pa'i dpa' bo gnyis la kun gzhi bag chags dang rig gnas sna gcig gi sems khams sgrig gzhi de gzhir bcas pa yin na/ bsdur dngos gtan nas mi 'dra la bsdur yul la cho lo stsol stangs/ cho lo stsol pa'i dgongs gzhi sogs ye nas mi mthun pa'i cha ka ya sdeb kyi ‘‘btsan sbyor’’zhig tu 'gro bar bsam/ yin yang / rig gnas sna mang gi brdab gsig las mched pa'i me stag ste/ mi ni ma gzhi nas 'dra mnyam yin zhes pa'i rig gnas gong thang gzhi byas pa'i mi ga'i/ gsar pa'i mig zung gi lta tshul la rgyab brten bcol na/ lo rgyus kyi dpa' bo de la cho lo bstsol mkhan de yang rig gnas(bod rang gi srol rgyun gyi rgo lugs ltar ma yin par da lta'i go lugs te/ mi rnams kyi spyod lam rnam bzhi dang 'brel — 51 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/ba'i za 'thung gos rgyan/ yul srol goms gshis/ cho ga lam lugs/ chos lugs/rtsom rig sgyu rtsal sogs kyi spyi 'dus ltar ro)tshan khag gcig gi mi sna yin pas/khos rang gi tshan khag gi rigs su gyur pa'i mi snar de ltar cho lo mtshan rtags gnang na/ nga tshos ci la rang tshod kyi smra brjod byas mi chog ang /kho bos de ltar cho lo bstsal pa la min rtags sdigs mo byed pa ma yin par yin nges pa'i khas len spros thog‘‘go sa’’gzhan zhig rtsod len byed 'dod pa yin/ bdag gis‘‘gnyis ka’’mi bu yin pa gzhir byas/ rang rang gi rig tshan gyi las gnas tsam ma 'dra ba ma gtogs/ mdor dril na gcig tu nges/ tshang ma mi bu dang mi bu 'dra mnyam yin pas so/ /tag tag lo rgyus kyi yul dus dang dus rabs mi 'dra ba rkyang du zad/da ni rtsom de 'bri dus kyi dgongs don dang dgos don yang zhor du gtam pa la/ dgongs don ni kho bos mi bu tshang ma rang rang gi rig tshan de'i phyogs zhen phyogs ris su mi 'gro ba dang zhor du mi re re'i las gnas ma 'dra na/ de'i che ba brjod tshul dang slob sbyong gi dmigs yul yang mi 'dra bas tshang mar rang rang gi dad zhen dad yul yod pas gnas lugs med pa ni ma yin/ yin yang / gnam gyis gar khyab la gnas lugs des khyab par 'dod pa ma gnang ang zhes pa zhu snying 'dod thog phan tshun la gzhan ldan rnam gcod mi bya bar rgyus lon dang bsres sbyor gyis 'os mthun gyi rig gan rig khor yug gtsang yangs shig dang — 52 —

da ngas don dang dgos don/ gtam brjod zur ba/dkyel yangs shig chags par re/ dgos don ni 'gro mgon gyis rang gi gdul bya rgyal po'i blo sems khul ba'i dgongs gzhi'i ched du dgos dbang gi don bya de ltar gsungs pa la dgos pa rlabs chen 'grub par gzhogs 'degs thob/ gal te‘‘rje mi la’’ma drangs par bod btsan po skabs kyi dpa' bo gzhan dag drangs pa yin na/ gdul bya 'dul thub min yang ci cha/ de dag gi mi tshe ni spyir btang srid thabs g.yu/la 'gyed rkyang du 'dug pas so/ /‘‘rje mi la’’la gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos yod pa ni mi tshe'i bshul lam la myong ba mi 'dra ba‘‘rim pa gsum’’tu 'dug rkyen yin/ de bas kho bos dgos dbang gi go bsdur rigs lam la brten nas rang dbang smra brjod brtson len dang rtag chad kyi rigs gnyis su dbye ba'i rgyu gnyis smra ba'i dbangatshodu mi 'gro bar/phyogs du ma dang sna sgo du ma nas bsam gzhig dang dbye zhib bya ba'i rig gnas dkyel yangs kyi gnas la slebs pa'i dgongs don la ram 'degs byed pa'o/ /gtam brjod zur ba/ (1)kha byang gi sdeb ka la rdo chag btsan sgrig dang zlos skyon byung ba/ bod mi rang gi skad dang yi ge tshad ldan dang mi mthun tshul lab bzhin dag ther byed dus/ da lta'i bod rang gi skad dang yi ge la thebs bzhin pa'i nyen kha tshabs chen te/ sa bsres rdo bsres dang ra 'dres lug 'dres kyis 'byung bzhin pa'i rgya ma bod dang ra bhe 53 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/ma lug gi skad cha phung gsum pa dang / 'gyur yig srog dben pa(tshig skyon don skyon nyis ldan can)yi snang tshul skyo po dang nyes bsags de yis 'go slong bzhin kho bo yang de'i khongs su gtogs la rigs su gyur par‘‘che bas chung khebs’’kyi tshul du rigs bsgre yod/ lar kho bo yang bod rang gi skad dang yi ge rig gnas la sha zhen rus zhen rang yod kyi/ tha na yig 'bru gcig ming tshig gcig nub na'ang 'gyod sems bla lhag rang skyes so/ /yin yang / de 'dra'i snang tshul 'byung bzhin pa la sa chung lung chung gi u tshugs che ba'i rang gshis kyis mig rgya chod pa'i rgyu mtshan mi rnyed pas 'dzam gling rig gnas spyi dang sgo du ma'i dus rabs kyi 'phel phyogs la bltas na/ sim 'dzul gyi 'jab rgol de yi gsang gnad rtogs la‘‘gdung sems’’las mched pa'i rtog dpyod kyi yo lang yang rab tu rgyas nges/ da lta'i 'dzam gling rig gnas la mtshon na/nub gling pa'i rig gnas stobs che ba dang dpung btsan pas gtso rgyugs rig gnas sam rig gnas gtso bor gyur yod la/ rgya nag la sogs shar phyogs pas mtshon pa'i rgyal khab gzhan dag gi rig gnas ni phal ba'i rig gnas red/ rig gnas kyi rin thang lta tshul dang gong thang gleng phyogs/ gyon gos cha lugs/ 'tsho ba'i rgyun spyod yo chas sogs mang po zhig nub gling pa'i de yin pas skad dang yi ge la'ang mi mngon mi shes pa'i dbyings nas sim 'dzul thebs bzhin yod la gas chag gtong da 54 da

da ngas don dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/bzhin yod/ de bzhin du rgya nag nang khul la mtshon na/ rgya'i rig gnas ni rig gnas gtso bor gyur yod la bod la sogs pa'i mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gnas ni rig gnas phal bar gyur yod pas‘‘sim 'dzul’’de'i yong rkyen la rgyus lon rta rnga tsam ni yod par bya dgos te/de ni tag tag tshan rtsal las thon pa'i cha 'phrin nam brda 'phrin gyi‘‘thon rdzas’’red/ des 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs so so'i kha rub dang bkag sdom gyi gnas bab lhing 'jags de gtor nas‘‘go la grong gseb can’’du btang zin na/ rig gnas kyi brdab gsig dza dragre/ rab tu che ba yang shes nges thog de la mkho ba ni phan tshun la 'brel 'dris dang rgyus lon yin pa 'dzam gling gi rigs so so'i mkhas pa dang ched mkhas pa tshos gzhi mthun du dgongs pa dang / zhor du thabs lam des phyogs phan tshun la phog thug med par rang rang gi khyad chos dam srung dang rgyun 'dzin dar spel du gtong bar sman mchog yin par smra ba red/ de bzhin du bod rang gi rig gnas la mtshon na yang da lta'i gnas bab la ngos zin gyis gtan 'khel bya dgos pa ni‘‘dus rabs kyi 'phel phyogs’’la bsam pa'i dmigs pa bshol du med pa lag/sa 'es 'phros gtam sna zin spu zin bgyis pa la dgongs 'jags 'tshal/ da ni phyir skabs bab la gzhol par bya ste/ rdo chag btsan sgrig ni ga'am/ gyi skad de bsgyur par 'dod bzhin snga phyi 'brel mi chags par smras na/bhe 55 —

dgongs don dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/rig gnas de dang kha 'phrod ngo 'phrod kyis‘‘thos bsam sgom’’la 'bad ci thub byas nas rang gi bden kha rang la sprod pa can ni ma yin par/rig gnas gzhan de zur lta dang zla bor 'god bzhin rang la rtog na/rang lus rang gis lta ba ltar min par rang gis mthong mi thub pa'i‘‘mthong bya’’mang po zhig mthong thub pas so/ /de bas/ sku zhabs nas bod kyi dngos yod 'tsho ba'am dmangs skya chu ris can gyi 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug ma bzod nas de'i yang snying ni rig gnas shig la rag las pa'i(mi'i gzhi grub ni rig gnas kyis grub pa'ogecong ge'i tshig)dgongs pa dang / mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas kyi gnas bab dang 'phel phyogs de zla bor g.yar nas rang steng la phyir rtog gis brtsams grub gnang na/ rnam par rtog yul ni bod kyi dngos yod 'tsho ba'i gnas bab dang dpyod par bya mkhan khong nyid kyis de ltar pir smyug gi kha nas mthong tshor stug por byas pa red/ de bas na kho bo'i kha byang de la tshad ma'i gzhung na spro bzhin pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i mtshan nyid khyer yong nas lci yang 'jal na rgya rdo dang rgya gzhong gnyis kar tshegs chen po byas byung la/ shig la sta re min pa'i nges pa'ang ci la med/ de bzhin du sla mo de dka' mo lkog gyur gyi nang don gtos chen dang ldan par byas nas go ba len donatshomed la/ de ltar tshegs lci bor gtong dgos don kyang chung / 〈dung dkar tshig mdzod〉〉las/ rtog dpyod ni sngar gyi gnas tshul dang da — 57 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/lta'i gnas tshul gnyis chabs cig tu dran nas brtag dpyad byas pa ste/de gnyis la bsam blo zhib tu btang ba'i don/ jirtog dpyod ces pa'i rtog ni mngon sum shes pa'i rjes su byung zhing yul gyi don spyi dang 'brel nas yul 'dzin pa'i shes pa zhig yin/ dpyod pa ni rang gi yul gyi khyad par zhig la dmigs nas spu ris ma 'dres par 'byed pa'i shes pa zhig yin/ (〈dung dkar tshig mdzod〉2 992)zhes pa ltar lags na gsal dag yin pas da dung sgam tshugs che tshugs kyi lung 'dren ring lugs kyi srol ka 'chang mi 'dod/ 'grel bshad 'di la yang gcig gcig gnyis gnyis kyis ma bab pa'i 'grel ba lhag ma ste bskyar 'grel yang 'grel gyi sil gtor bya mi 'dod pas rang rang gi 'ju stobs kyis nus par bya'o/ /de ltar na/ ‘‘rtog pa’’dang‘‘'jug pa’’yang bskyar zlos min pa los shes/ rtog pa ni yul 'dzin pa'i shes pa tsam dang 'jug pa ni shes pa tsam po de yul bye brag pa la dngos su zhugs pa'o/ /yin rgyu ni‘‘rtog zhugs’’zer dgos pa la rang re'i brda sprod gzhung gi chos nyid dang klog bde brjod bde'i phyir du‘‘zhugs’’kyi da lta ba‘‘'jug’’ces pa 'jug pa yin/ de bas‘‘rtog 'jug’’ces pa ngag nas brjod pa'i tshe sgra drag por yod pas rngam brjid cig dang zil shugs shig tshig rang steng na rang chas su thon yod stabs kha byang la bkod pa lags/ bod kyi skad dang brda sprod la cung tsam byang cha rang yod pa'i yig ngo chod pa zhig la — 58 —

da ngas don dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/mtshon na/ ming tshig 'di lta bu ni kha la gyer bde zhing ngag nas 'don bde ba/ rtags 'jug gi sgra gdangs drag zhan bar ma'i sdeb stangs dang mthun por song ba yin phyir khyod kyis ni ji ltar klog pa dang gang ltar bsam pa la kho bos ma nges so/ /da dung mu mthud du kyal ka'i tshul du mtha' dpyad na/ ngas 'dod bzhin pa'i‘‘rtog 'jug’’dang khyod kyis dgongs bzhin bkod pa'i dper brjod de ‘‘bzhad gad’’ dang‘‘mthon mthing’’gnyis ni ming tshig gi ngo bo dang grub lugs gtan nas mi 'dra ba so sor snang ste/ bzhad gad ni spyir‘‘bzhad bgad’’yin dgos pa la‘‘rgya dkar’’la‘‘rgya gar’’du song ba'i dpe ltar dang / bod rang gi ming tshig mthun sdeb kyi gshis su grub yod pa'i chos nyid‘‘ming mtha' 'dren lugs’’dang 'gal med pas so/ /khyod ltar na ming tshig 'di la yang tshig dang don gnyis thad nas zlos skyon du song yod par khas blangs yod rung‘‘ngag gi rgyun la chags nas dus yun nges can 'gor bas’’zhes dang / yang snyan tshig rtsom pa'i skabs su‘‘tshig gi mdzes nyams dang don gyi snying bo 'byin pa la bla lhag gi nus pa cher thon pa’’zhes brjod nas‘‘gu yangs’’gnang lugs la dpyad na/ dungs phyogs zhen phyogs kyi dbang du song nas‘‘skyon cha’’la mig bsher tsam yang byed mi thub par snyam zhor du tshig de gnyis kyi don yang go bzhin med nga/ 'dra ste/ a cang ku re yin/ mi go ba ga la srid/ thugs mnyam ma/ — 59 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/bzhag pa 'dra/ de la‘‘bzhad’’ni bgad kyi zhe sa yin pas de gnyis kyi don 'dra yang spyod yul mi 'dra thog tshig gi zlos skyon du'ang song med na gzhan nas 'gyur ba zhig ga la yinatshogyi/ min no/ /dper na bod skad la rgyun lugs su 'byung ba'i‘‘gsung bshad’’dang‘‘mjal 'phrad’’lta bu sogs mang bar‘‘gsung’’dang‘‘mjal’’ni zhe sa yin pas gong dang 'dra/zhe tshig ni bod rang la snga mo nas yod de/ yig rnying la‘‘rje bo’’dang‘‘mchid gsol’’sogs mang du 'byung bas rgan pa dang che ba la zhe sa sbyor ba ni bod rang gi thun min gyi khyad gshis su grub yod phyir/ gzhan gyi lad zlos byas pa'i‘‘mdzes ma dzes’’dang‘‘yag yag’’‘‘rtsod rtsod’’lta bu'i zlos skyon ni da gzod ma dag rgyun 'byams su song ba rkyang du zad/mthon mthing ni khyad chos ston pa'i ming tshig don mi 'dra ba gnyis kyis grub ste/ mthon ni mtho bo'i don yin la‘‘mthing’’ni kha dog ston pa'o/ /kho bos ni shog zad snag zad la ha cang 'dzem na rgyas bshad rgyas 'bri'i ngal ba 'dzin mi 'dod pas de'i phan chad kyi dpyad zhib phra zhing phra ba ni gong dang 'dra la zlos skyon du ma song ba yang gong dang 'dra na rigs bsgre bar bya/ de bas tha snyad 'di gnyis ni tshig gi sbyor lugs dang ngag gi 'don lugs gang gi cha nas kyang tshegs med yin na/ bltas na mig la mdzes shing klog na ngag la bde ba/ bsam na rtogs rgyu rang che na bod rang gi mu tig sum cu 'di'i sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes pa khyad — 60 —

da ngas don dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/ 'phags so/ /rtog 'jug ces pa ni bya tshig gnyis kyis grub pas gong gi de gnyis dang mi 'dra ba ni dus gsum gyi rab dbye yod pas red/'di lta bu'i tha snyad sdeb stangs la spyir btang da lta ba sbyor ba ni bod rang skad kyi dpe lugs te/ srung skyob dang 'tshol dpyod lta bu/ khyod ltar na de gnyis kyang bskyar zlos su 'gro shas che/ yin yang / nus pa dang zab tshad gtan nas 'dra ba ma red/ dper na/ chu rdzing gting zab cig la byis pa rol tu mi 'jug pa ni nyen kha 'gog pa'am srung ba dang /gal te stabs ma legs par byis pa zhig chu'i rol rtsed ma shes par de la 'thim na de las len pa ni skyob pa ste byis pa'i srog nyen las thar bar byed pa'o/ / da dung kha gsab cig byas na/ srung ni ma 'ongs sngon 'gog dang da ltar rgyun 'dzin/ skyob ni byung zin 'jig nyen las thar ched do/ / de bzhin du 'tshol dpyod las‘‘'tshol’’ni yul dngos la 'jug pa dang‘‘dpyod’’ni yul gyi shes pas brtag pa'o/ /zhib tu ni mi spro bar bya/gzhan du sngon chad zhig la/ rdo sbis dge bshes kyis rig pa'i dpa' bo dge chos kyis gangs can nags kyi seng ge la gangs seng zhes tshig sdud mdzad par bod kyi tshig sdud kyi chos nyid dang 'gal tshul dang //rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos gangs seng dngos su gzigs tshul sogs gsungs te tshig don nyis cha nas dgag pa bskyon(〈klu sgrub dgongs da 61 da

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/rgyan la che long du brtags pa mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro〉)par dgongs don dang dgos don ni re zhig bskyur zhog tag tag‘‘gangs seng’’gi tha snyad tsam la yang sha 'thag rus 'thag rang byas na mkhas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin rung / bod mi byings kyi ngag gi 'gug lugs dang glu yi len lugs la de 'dra'i thugs mnyam ma bzhag pa dang rtog dpyod kyi yul la ma dgongs pa 'dra bas‘‘tshig gi rol rtsed’’rkyang du zad/ gal te bod mi dmangs phal ba byings kyi skad cha'i bshad lugs dang ming gi bkol phyogs la thugs mnyam cung tsam bzhag yod tshe/ tha snyad de la skyon cha bral ba mi mkhyen rang mkhyen du 'gro bar 'dod la yang na rgyu mtshan gzhan pa yod na'ang thang / gang ltar kyang tshig sdud de ni gcig nas bod mi'i skad cha'i sbyor lugs dang mthun pa/ gnyis su brda sprod gzhung gi ming mtha' 'dren lugs dang mthun pa/ gsum du de ltar sdud na ngag la bde zhing yig zor yang ba sogs khyad chos du ma dang ldan par spro zhor gzhug phyogs nga tshos kyang de lta bu la mig dpe dang slob sbyong byas nas khyad chos 'don ci thub la rem dgos par bsam/ gzhan du na/ ming brda tha snyad dag mtha' gcig tu brda sprod lugs dang chos lugs gzhung don la phar la bstun ci thub byas na/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod bkol bzhin pa'i ming brda tha snyad gya nom zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / lhag tu gter yig dag na thon dang 'don bzhin pa'i bod — 62 —
