da ngas do dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/btsan po'i skabs kyi yi ge ste phyis byung mkhas pa'i pir rtses ma reg pa'i tha snyad khri ma 'bum zhig byung rgyal du gad snyigs blugs sgam du mi 'phen rang 'phen du 'gro bas ji 'dra'i phangs sems che ang zhes kyang thal lo/ /mdor na/ tha snyad gcig la don du ma dang tha snyad du ma la don gcig 'byung lugs ni nga tsho'i brda sprod gzhung na gsal po dag mo yin pas skabs don gyi bkol lugs la brtag cing dpyad bya che na/ deng skabs kyi tha snyad kyis mtshon par byas na skad cha'i gnas bab(kāskyo’ṭ+wāṃ )la ha cang dang dod bya dgos/ tag tag tshig rkyang ngos nas go ba mi len par tshig gong 'og dang 'brel ba/ rtsom yongs khyab kyi steng nas go lugs la 'byams dgos so/ /de ma gtogs deng skad kyi lugs su spros na sger sdom mam sger 'dzin dang / tshad ma tshad gzhung gi ming brda g.yar po zhus nas brjod na gzhan ldan rnam gcod nyag gcig byas pa yin pas de ni rang re'i blo rig 'phel ba'i bgegs su 'gro nyen che/(2)kho bo'i rtsom de'i brjod bya'i nang don skor la ban shul nas dag ther bgyis yod par/ nga rang nyid kyi bshad pa tsam po ba des rje mi la dpa' bor mi 'gro bar lung rdzong mthug po zhig drangs nas nga 'dra'i lo chung(kho rang nyid kyi mgrin ngag ltar na‘‘byis blo dri ma can’’)zhig gis 'khur na mi theg pa'i tshad du gtong mdog kha po yod red de/ ‘‘rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi dpung’’(kho'itshig g.yar)lta bu yod pas so/ /skabs 'dir — 63 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/kho bo la dran tshul gzhan zhig skyes byung / ci'i phyir nga tsho'i kha lta mig lta yi thad sor rngam zhing brjid pa'i‘‘rma chen sbom ra’’lta bu ma yin par/tag tag yul dus nyis char gyi bskal pa'i chod pa can de lta bu yin song ngam zhes pa rang gis rang la dogs 'dri'i tshul lo/ /nga rang nyid kyi lung khungs de ma dag par 'dod na/ 〈sa skya gdung rabs ngo mtshar bang mdzod〉kyi shog ngos151na gsal pas rgyab rtsa bcol yul de yin pas 'or 'dren gyi tshegs mi 'dzin par bya/ chabs cig nga rang lta rgya thos rgya chung tshul gyi‘‘dma' phab zur za’’zhig kyang rtsom shugs na lham mer 'tsher 'dug phyir/ gsal 'debs kyi gros shig bsdur na/ kho bos rang gi mig dang rang gi klad pas rus pa rgyan can gyi〈〈mi la'i mgur 'bum〉la bltas shing dpyad nas de ru slong skrun byas pa'i mi la'i snang brnyan nyid tshig nyung don 'dus kyis dgod pa lags/ de ma gtogs lung gtos chen drangs nas rang gi lta rgya mkhyen rgya che mdog kha po ston pa'i zol de kho bo'i gshis su chags med pas‘‘rang rtog’’gis brjod pa yin na/ mang mang gi sems khams dang mthun dka' la skyon cha yod pa'ang 'thad ldan du khas len zhor mi bu rang nyid ni dga' skyo chags sdang gi rnam par yod pa la'ang mthong chung snang chung mi bya bar mkhyen/gzhan kha pho che lugs dang rigs rtsal gyi kyal ka'i tshul du bshad par bya ba 'di yod de/ gal te khyod la〈rje zhabs dkar ba'i rnam thar〉tu — 64 —

da ngas don dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/bzhengs yod pa'i‘‘las dag snang can’’gyi yid ngor 'phos pa'i rje btsun mi la ras pa'i snang brnyan lta bu mkho na/ dus deb 'di bdag gi lag la 'byor dus dgong mo yin la/ de dus kho bos〈〈thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar〉〉la blta bzhin yod par khyod 'dra'i sha yi mig gis khyad mtshar gzugs med na/ lha dang lha mo sprin gyi 'du 'god ltar mthong ba'i mi bu la de na rgyags phye 'dzoms po rang mnga' ba'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha thol le bar 'phyur bzhin yod pas khom long re byung na der mjal rgyu ma brjed ang / de na thang stong rgyal pos lcags zam bzhengs pa thams cad‘‘las dag snang can’’gyi snang ngor ma gtogs ji bzhin du mjal mi thub/ tha na thang stong rgyal po la lcags zam bzhengs rgyu'i kun slong gi 'byung rkyen‘‘thengs shig thang stong nyid tshal gung thang nas lha sar 'byon pa'i lam bar lha gdong shan khar gru dpon la gla rngan gnang rgyu ma byung bas 'khyam po ldom po ltar du dbu la shan skya lan gsum gzhus te chu bskyur’’lta bu la yang dngos don gyi gtam dkyus ma'i tshul du mi 'god par 'ud brjod dang sgro btags kyis rab tu brgyan yod na/ kho bos ni dngos don dkyus ma dang rtog bzo'i dbye gsal ni rab tu khor na bzang zhes zhu ba lan brgyar zhu/ yin yang / kho bos ni de lta bu'i rnam thar ljags rtsom dag la mtha' gcig tu dgag pa ni ma yin par brtag dpyad bya rgyu ha cang che bar 'dod/ de dag na skabs de shed kyi bod kyi spyi — 6pya —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/tshogs 'tsho ba'i zur ngos mi 'dra ba du ma btu rgyu yod pa dang / bod mi'i sems khams te dmangs byings dang mkhas pa rnal 'byor pa'i nang sems kyi 'jig rten/ da dung spyod lam sogs mthong thub pas so/ /sum bha ye shes dpal 'byor gyi〈yi ge'i rnam bzhag rab gsal me long〉las/ ‘‘sum rtags sogs kyi snying nor dang / smra sgo mtshon cha ni dpang los brda sprod dang mi mthun pa'i skyon mang bas paṇ+ḍi tas ma mdzad ces gsungs mod kyang de smṛ tis mdzad par mkhas pa mang pos bzhed pa dang / de rgya gar gyi sgra gzhung dang ji bzhin mi mthun kyang bod kyi skad tsam la mthun phyir byas pa dang / de nyid 'phags yul gyi paṇa chen yin kyang bod du byon nas yun mi ring bas bod skad la cher ma byang ba'ang srid pas bod kyi dag yig sogs dang cung zad mi mthun pa gal te srid kyang nyes pa chung la/ gang ltar yang de'i brjod bya phal cher ni bod skad la nye bar mkho nges yin par 'dug’’ces gsong bor brjod yod pa ltar/ skyon yon gnyis ka sor bstan gyis ngos 'dzin legs par gnang ba ni rang re'i gnad du che/ de ma gtogs skyon mthong na yang mi smra ba'am rnam pa gzhan du bskor na/ nyes rgyu ni rang las gzhan ma yin/ de bzhin du nga tsho thun mong gi lugs de gzhir bzung na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas ni sangs rgyas gnyis pa yin tshul gyis 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum ste dus gsum nor med 'dzol med du — 66 —

da ngas don dang da sa don/ gtam brjod zur ba/gzigs pa'i mkhyen stobs mnga' bar slong skrun byas yo/da na/ 〈pad+ma bka' thang〉las/ mkhan slob kyis bod phrug blo rno ba kha lce bde ba la sgra bslabs par/ legs sbyar skad/ na mo dharmyu yaḥzhes pa mkhan slob kyis/ ma mo sbad ma yaḥzhes bsgyur nas bod phrug la bslab na/ des/chos la thag tham mo sbabs hu hiḥzhes log 'don byas par mkhan slob zung dang bod phrug tsho phan tshun la bltas nas ha cha dir rir 'phya dgod byas skad/ (〈pad+ma bka' thang〉2 403)'di las mngon pa ni sngon bod btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su legs sbyar gyi skad dang bod kyi skad la sgra gdangs mthun thabs ye nas med pa rtogs thub/ kha la blangs te ngag nas ci thon la 'bad na'ang lce'i mdud pa 'khrol dka' ba de tshegs med du shes nus thog mkhan slob zung gis kyang bod skad kyi sgra gdangs ji bzhin thon thub kyin med pa yang nges nus/ de bas/ kho bos ni nam rgyun lo rgyus deb ther dang gsung rtsom bstan bcos la mjal dus dngos yod 'tsho ba dang dngos yod don mthun gyi phyogs la rna ba krog krog dang mig zung rig rig byas pa yin gyi/ gzhan 'ud brjod dang 'khyog brjod kyi rigs la don dngos dang 'brel min dang 'phrod min la rig sgrim ma byas par dgongs don dang dgos don gyi thad nas bsam gzhig phul ba yin na/ rang la thob 'bras mi nyung ba yod la 'ju stobs kyang rang tshod kyis mnga' 'gro bas de dag kyang rgyu rkyen sna mang 'dzoms pa — 67 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/dang go rim nur 'gros can las glo bur rtogs gdeng thob pa'am glo bur mkhyen stobs can du nam yang yid rton 'phar mdog med pa'o/ /lha sa'i dmangs gzhas shig tu/ rang gis rang la bltas na/ /sku gzugs tsa ri'i smyug ma/ /rgya lam 'grul pas bltas na/ /lcang sdong gcus ril shig shig/ces pa ltar/ gzhan gyi mig zung dang gzhan gyi gnas bab de las rang la rtog cing gzhigs pa yin na rang skyon shig tsam po yang lhang la bud 'gro ba ma zad blo rig skyen 'gyur dang gra rgyas su 'gro ba'i bsdongs grogs so/ /( 3) ban shul gyis kho rang ni‘‘skya bo chos smra’’yin pas bden pa bdar nas zhib 'jug zhu snying 'dod pa'i slob gnyer pa zhig tu khas 'ches na/ rang gi‘‘go sa’’dang‘‘kha mal’’brtan po zhig la khen rjes kun slong gtsang ma zhig gi thag sner 'ju ci thub la rem pa'i nyams snang ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes la bsam shes sgam tshugs shig wal gyis ston bzhin pa'i snang ba'ang bcos min du ster/ bdag la‘‘byis blo dri ma can’’zhes dma' phab mthong chung gi zur za zhig bstan zhor/ ‘‘bar thag’’cig gis rab tu dbye 'dug kho bos ni rang la‘‘byis blo'i’’brgyud rim dngos brgyud myong ba khas len la der mthun gyi dran 'char ci yang byung ba la'ang khas len gyis de dag thams cad rmeg med du gtong 'dod gtan nas med/ skyon rung dge rung rang gi‘‘byas las’’yin — 68 —

da ngas don dang da sa don/ tam brjod zur ba/pas so/ /zhor du zur 'phros thung tsam byas na/ byis blo yi khyad chos ni rang nyid 'jig rten ngo ma zhig gi nang na 'tsho bzhin yod pas 'dzem dogs med par drang bo drang gzhag dang phyogs ris 'then 'khyer med par rang sems rang gis brjod kyi yod/ mi rgan pa dag gis rtse kha dgod kha'i yul du bsam nas‘‘rtsed spyad lo lo’’zhig tu 'dod pa nga tsho chung dus kyi rang gi myong bas grub/ de las ldog ste/ lag chags nas mi dar ma ru gyur na/ tha snyad kyi 'jig rten zhig gi nang na 'tsho bzhin yod pas spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi dang lam lugs gang mang zhig gis gcun bzhin yod stabs 'dzem dogs bla lhag bgyi nges pas dwangs gtsang gi byis blo de la dri mas rab tu bsgribs nas gnyom khur 'khos chung du 'dug la dga'/ de bas/ kho bos ni‘‘byis blo’’de lta bur‘‘bcar’’thub par brtson len byed bzhin yod/ de bzhin du khyod ltar du‘‘dri ma can’’yang khas len bya nges te nga tsho ni nyon mongs dug gsum gyis rab tu bcangs pa'i‘‘mi bu’’yin pas de dag la gdong gtod thub la 'gan yang khur thub par ma zad/ 'gyod bshags kyang bgyi nus pas so/ /‘‘dri ma can’’de ni dge chos kyi‘‘grub mthas blo ma bsgyur pa gcig kyang med par 'dod’’ces pa dang 'dra shas su 'gro snyam mod/ khyod ltar na‘‘grub mtha'’’zhes pa de yang dgol yul 'phyugs tshul dang nor tshul gyis dgag pa byed mdog tsha bo ston kyang / skabs 'dir chos gzhung tshad gzhung na spro bzhin pa'i‘‘grub mtha'’’de min par yid 'jags 'tshal/— 69 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/bsam blo'i 'phel rim/da wanub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’skabs16pa'i steng gi kha brda gzhir byas pa/spyi lo2004lo'i zla12pa'i tshes26nyin/dus rabs gnyis kyi bsnol mtshams/ stong lo gsar pa'i skya rengs kyi dus su mi bu zhig mtho sgang 'di'i‘‘gcong rong’’nas 'greng byung / khos mi bu rang gi blo skyed kyi spyan zung dang bsam blo yi pur gri thogs te brag 'phreng g.yang kha na 'phyan pa'i nga tsho'i gnas bab dang kha sho sna ral can gyi nga tsho'i skyid snang la thog ma'i bsam gzhig phul dus/gang gi zungs khrag nyid〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉bya ba'i‘‘kher rkyang’’zhig gi ngo bor bstems/ kher rkyang nyid mi yul gyi gru ga so sor 'grims dus dge chos zhes bya ba'i gnas skor pa zhig gi kher hreng gi 'gul skyod de/ grags med 'gul med dang lo rgyus khrod gsar rnyed bya dgos pa lta bu'i‘‘yun 'gyangs’’kyi rnam thar ma bskyangs par/ myur ba myur du/rdo thog ka bzhag thad ka thad sor g.yo skyom chen po byung song /〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉kyis bod kyi bsam blo'i cha dang chos lugs kyi cha/ lo rgyus kyi cha/ slob gso'i cha sogs mang po zhig brjod da 70 da

bsam blo'i 'phel rim/yod cing / mthar gtugs na rigs gnyis su bsdu chog ste/ gcig ni bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas sam chos lugs rig gnas la dgag sgrub kyi lta tshul bton 'dug cig shos ni bod kyi 'tsho gnas kyi gnad don bshad 'dug 'di ni ljags rtsom gang nyid kyi bsam gzhig gi 'jug yul dang kha gtod sa'i dmigs 'ben red/ 'di ni brtsams chos gang gis bshad 'dod pa'am brjod 'dod pa'i 'o ma dkrugs pa'i mar lo red/ 'di ni dpyod pa gang gi dpyad yul dang rgyang 'bod gang si/ 'bod yul red/ 'di ni bsam blo pa zhig gi rang sgros dang snying stobs mkhan zhig gi 'tshol snyeg red/ 'di ni bsam blo ni tshe srog la dang dod kyis mi gzhir sger tshugs ldan pa'i sems khams kyi 'du byed cig yin pas/ bsam blo pas rang nyid la khag theg dang rang nyid kyi skad cha'am smra brjod la yang khag theg byed dgos/ de min par smya sa smyo se/ rdza na rdzun ne/ khra la 'khrul les gang 'dod bshad na phan ci yang ma mchis/ yang gcig bshad na/bsam blo pas nam yang dngos yod 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs dngos la yid gzab mnyam 'jog byed kyin yod la/ de las kyang skyug bro bsungs dri mnam po'i ngan cha la smyug rtse'i mda' kha gtad yod phyir/ spyang po grum mdog ma bgyis par drang bo'i drang gtam gyis rang gi shes rab brjod pa red/— 71 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉de ltar mi yul la 'khyams pa na/ yar mar bco brgyad dang yin min gya gcig gi gleng brjod lung ba gang re 'khur nas lo 'khor bzhi tsam 'gyangs pa'i de ring gi nyin mor slar yang〈dogs slong snying stobs〉kyis mtshon pa'i〈bdag dpe tshogs〉sam mi bu drug gi bdag nyid can gyi dpe tshogs shig phreng du bstar byung / rta lcag gcig gis rta brgya dkrogs pa'i mi bu gcig nas mi bu drug gi snying stobs kyi 'phel rim la nga tshos thugs sems mi phyogs thu med byung /de dang sbrags te yang bskyar rang rang gi sems 'dun dron mo'am dmar rjen rjen gyi dran pa re mi mngon thu med byung / de bas kho bo'i yid ngogs na dran tshul lam bsam tshul thar thor zhig gsal la mi gsal gyis 'phyo bzhin yod stabs/ 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉nas〈dogs slong snying stobs〉bar gyi bsam blo'i 'phel rim la tshig gsum zhu bar 'dod do/ /shes yon can ni spyi tshogs rig gnas kyi thon skyed pa dang khyab sgrog pa yin pa'i cha nas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dgag sgrub pa dang phyir rtog pa yin pa'i ngos gcig dang / rig gnas gsar pa'i rgyang 'bod pa dang 'dzugs skrun pa ste ngos gnyis na mngon/ yin yang bod kyi mkhas dbang gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu tsho ni‘‘snga mas ma brjod pa la 'dir brjod med’’ces pa'i gzhung lam bde mor zhugs nas/ tshe tshe rabs — 72 —

bsam blo'i 'phel rim/rabs su zhabs kyi chu zheng thams cad a 'grig cha 'grig yin pa'i‘‘lham 'bol’’gyi me long ma nyid che che rdzig rdzig gi 'gying 'gros na 'tsher bas ji skad du/ srog gi dbang bos ma bzung ba'i/ /bem po mdzes kyang su la mkho/ /rgyal po'i rgyan ni mdzes gyur kyang / /yon tan med na skyes bus gleng / /zhes pa ltar/ jo bo rje'i〈bstod pa sum cu pa〉nas nye rabs kyi mar nang a khu dam chos rgya mtsho'i〈bstod pa 'jigs bral ngag gi snye ma〉〉bar gyi‘‘bstod tshogs’’dang / rje rin po che'i〈byang chub lam rim〉nas tshe tan zhabs drung bar gyi‘‘lam rim’’gzhung 'jug sogs snang yul gang la mjal yang‘‘bka' 'grel bka' mchan bka' gleng’’gi yul las 'das med la/ nyid kyis‘‘brtsams’’bya ba'i dod khul tsam las don dngos na de ltar min par‘‘'grel’’bya ba'i chos nyid mngon du bstar yod pas thugs kyi gzhol phyogs dang ljags kyi g.yo phyogs tshang ma‘‘ne tso'i ma ṇi’’dang dbyer ma mchis/ 'di ni spyi ldog gi dbang du byas pa'o/ /rang ldog nas bshad na〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉ni brjod bya'i nang don dang rjod byed tshig gi cha sogs gang thad nas khyad rtags shig mchis pas〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉lta bu'i‘‘gtan tshigs’’mi ldan yang‘‘phan nus’’de dang rkya gcig tu 'thab yod/ mi'i mig dbang ni nang bcud sems can gyi yid kyi 'dzin sgo dang phyi snod 'jig rten gyi gzung sgo yin pas rin chen nang gi dkon mchog lta bu yin no/ /de bas brtsams chos gang — 73 —

sems khral gyi 'pho nyul/nyid kyi‘‘kha byang’’ni de'i mig dbang gi dod du snang bas nga tsho'i gzigs phyogs kyi mda' mo yang de la 'phen par byed nges la/ kha byang la brten nas myong rol byed min gyi gsal kha yang 'byed nges/ yang gcig bshad na/ kha byang ni rtsom la blta ba'i mig zung yin la rtsom pa pos de la mno bsam zab mo bzhes dgos te/ des rtsom pa po'i nang sems kyi 'du byed de/ bsam blo dang phugs bsam gyi dmigs gzhi zhig mtshon pas red/ 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉ces pa'i brtsams chos de'i nang gi〈'phag 'tshag gi nga ro〉dang〈bag chags dong sprug〉bcas kyis mtshon pa'i kha byang re re la gzigs dang / ‘‘khyod dang nga kho’’zhes pa'i nga tsho mi bu dag gi sems pa de ci lta bu zhig byed dam/blong blong bo/ 'jig yer yer/ the tshom tshom zhig snyam bzhin ngag nas bcos min du‘‘a kha kha’’shor ba zhig e yin nam/ der ni khag mi 'dug ste/ de ni rtsom pa po'i mtshar 'dzin las 'khrungs pa'i dogs slong gi snying stobs red pas gnad la 'phigs pa/ don dang 'byor ba/gnyid slong rmongs dkrogs kyi nus pa thon 'dug de ni bsam blo pa'i dungs zhen gyi zhe 'khon las 'khrungs pa'i snying stobs red pas drag po dang ldan pa/ hol rgyug dang ldan pa/ zhe tsub dang ldan pa'i kun slong gtsang ma zhig mngon 'dug de las bsam blo pa zhig gi khyad rtags kyi mi gshis mngon par gsal te/ dogs slong gi blo spobs mtho ba/— 74 —

bsam blo'i 'phel rim/dpyod shes kyi rigs rtog mnga' ba/ smra brjod kyi rang dbang ldan pa/bsam gzhig gi mdung kha rno ba sogs brtsams chos dngos la mjal na mthong bas 'dir re re bzhin brjod pa'i ngal ba mi 'dzin par bya/〈dogs slong snying stobs〉khrod kyi〈skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa〉dang〈yon tan pa dang shes yon can gleng ba〉〈kun spyod gleng slong ba〉sogs kha byang gang la bltas kyang〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉khrod kyi kha byang gi khyad chos dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du snang ste/ zhi ba dang ldan pa/gzab nan dang ldan pa/ lhod yangs dang ldan pa/ bag yo/da dang ldan pas nga tsho la sbyin pa'i tshor snang yang zhe dngangs dngangs dang 'jig yer yer/ skyi g.ya' g.ya' ni ma yin par ha cang rgyun ldan zhig tu mngon/ de ni kha la byang byang ba/ rna la gshags gshags pa/ mig la lobs lobs pa sems la nges nges pa zhig gi nyams snang ste/ kha byang dang sbrags te brtsams chos dngos la myong rol byed na yang mkhas dbang rang grol gyi‘‘rnyed par dka' ba'i lo rgyus kyi bem po'i lus la/dus dang mthun pa'i srog gi dbang bo ma zhugs na/ yar rgyas kyi 'phar rtsa lding mi srid la/ mdun skyod kyi gom pa ni de bas kyang ngo’’zhes pa'i zhal mchid cig yid la wa ler 'char yong / dper na/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa zhes pa'i rtsom la mtshon na/ thog mar skyes bu gsum gyi dbye ba nas skyes bu gsu/ma gyi khyad par/ skyes bu gsum gyi — 75 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/lam gyi rim pa/ skyes bu gsum gyi slob pa'i rim pa/ skyes bu che chung dpe'i sgo nas ston pa/ mtha' mar skyes bu gsum du dbye ba'i dgos pa bcas re re bzhin 'ol tshod rmongs tshod tsam min par kha gsal zhing gnad du things la/ rigs pa'i sgrub byed/ lung gi rgyab rten/dpe'i gsal byed bcas rigs gzhung gi cha rkyen dag mngon du bstar yod pas/ nang khong 'dzoms po dang zhib brjod nan mo'i cha de 'dra mi ldan rung tshan khag dbye sgo'i byed thabs la lhongs su 'bad 'dug de bzhin du〈yon tan pa dang shes yon can gleng ba〉zhes pa'i rtsom la yang thog mar yon tan pa'i skor gyi ngo sprod nyung ngu / de nas shes yon can gyi skor gleng ba la shes yon can dang shes yon can rnal ma'i mtshan nyid bshad pa dang / sgra yangs 'jug gi shīs yon can gyi dbye ba bshad pa/sgra dog 'jug gi shes yon can rnal ma'i mtshan zur re re nas bshad pa bcas rigs chen po gsum du dgar 'dug la/ gsum pa la yang rang rkya thub pa'i 'greng tshugs/ spyi gzhung do khur rang bzhin/ dogs slong dang dgag sgrub snying stobs/ rgyu 'bras blo mig spyi tshogs la 'jug pa'i hur brtson bcas khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can du byas yod par bem po gzugs phung tsam min par dbang bo sna lnga tshang ba'i mi gzhi gsar pa zhig bzhengs 'dug 〈kun spyod gleng slong ba〉lta bur mtshon na yang kun spyod kyi go don dang kun spyod kyi dbye ba/ rtsa — 76 —

bsam blo'i 'phel rim/ba'i kun spyod gshis rgyud bzhi ste blo stobs brtan brling / rang gcun rang sdom/ drang bo drang gzhag gzab nan dpyod ldan bcas so so nas zhib cha 'don ci thub byas yod stabs/ brtsams chos snga phyi gnyis ka'i mi 'dra ba'i cha de ru snang la rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i 'phel rim gyi cha'ang de na mngon/ 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉kyi bsam blo la hol rgyug rtsing rag gi cha dang / 〈dogs slong snying stobs〉kyi bsam blo la dal lhod zhib dpyad kyi cha dang ldan pas gnyis ka'i thun min no/ /thun mong gi cha ni brtsams chos snga phyi gnyis kar snang ba'i〈mi'i bshad stangs shig las〉zhes pa'i kha byang dang de 'brel gyi nang don slob gso'i skor gyi rgyun mthud nyid red/ rtsom pa pos‘‘slob gso’’la thog mtha' bar gsum du gtsigs 'dzin dang dmigs bsal gyi khyad dbang zhig sbyin pa la dmigs yul gal chen zhig yod par 'khums/ slob gso ni mi rigs 'jig nyen las bzlog pa'i thabs mchog dang mi rigs slar gson byed pa'i gshin sa yin par rnyed nas‘‘dge rgan—slob gso—slob ma’’bar gyi rten 'brel la dang dod zhib brjod byas yod par brtsams chos dngos la mjal na gsal kha bgyis pas ma bab pa'i 'gan khur mi len par bya'o/ /〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉nyid rta bo gshog thogs dang 'dra bar rgyug lam na 'tsher skad lhang lhang du bgrod pa'i tshe/ dri ba'i lcags sgrog — 77 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/gi rgya rnyi rab dang rim pa btsugs par‘‘khyod kyis gang zhig gtor shul nas ci zhig tshab la 'jog’’ces pa'i dri ba dag gi lan things po yang〈dogs slong snying stobs〉na rdza chu bsil ma bzhin lhog lhog tu 'phyur bar gda' bas bkres skom gyi mid pa bsing ba'i btung bya mchog go/yang gcig bshad na/ dri ba de gdon mkhan gyis‘‘rtsom rig’’nyid nyer spyod lag rtsal tshan rig gi khongs su bgrang yod las che/ des thad ka thad sor spyi tshogs la lag rtsal dang byed nus kyi dgos mkho skong thub par snyam gyi 'dug yin yang / rtsom rig ni spyi rjogs tshan rig gi khongs su gtogs la des spyi tshogs la rig gnas dang shes bya'i dgos mkho skong ba las/ nyer spyod lag rtsal tshan rig ltar du khang rnying gang zhig bshig shul nas khang gsar ci zhig 'dzugs thub pa bzhin mig mthong lag zin du rdog rdog cig ston par mi nus pas de 'dra'i dbye ba khor na bzang /〈〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉dang〈dogs slong snying stobs〉gnyis ni char ba chu grogs dang nyi ma me grogs su 'gro ba las ra khyi mnyam 'grogs lta bu min no/ /ming brda g.yar nas bshad na snga mas‘‘sdug bsngal bden pa dang kun 'byung bden pa’’ste sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo dang bcas pa'i 'byung rgyu la ngos zin byed par bskul yod pa dang / phyi mas‘‘'gog bden dang lam bden’’te thar lam bstan yod snyam zhor 'di ni blo rtsing — 78 —

bsam blo'i 'phel rim/bo'i dbang shed che ba'ang rtogs dgos so/ /shes rtogs smra ba'i(slokālnga1྅)ngos nas brjod na/ snga ma ni gnad don mthong mkhan dang gnad don 'don mkhan yin la/ phyi ma ni gnad don la dbye zhib byed mkhan dang thag gcod mkhan yin/ da dung rig gzhung gi thad nas bshad na/snga ma ni thog ma'i gleng slong ba dang lam gding ba'i 'bod skul dang /phyi ma ni gzhung lugs kyi phyi mo'am sta gon mdzad yod par snyam/ mdor na brtsams chos gnyis ni rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i mtshon stobs chen mo gnyis te/ drag po nas zhi ba'am na gzhon nas rgan pa lta bu'i bsam blo gting je zab tu song ba'i 'phel rim mngon par mtshon 'dugabasam blo pa zhig yin phyin ma mtha'i cha rkyen ni shes yon can zhig yin dgos te/ de la yang〈dogs slong snying stobs〉su bsam blo'i rang bzhin ldan pa dang / dkyel yangs khog rgya yod pa/ 'byung spus rang bzhin legs pa/ dpyod shes rigs rtog mnga' ba/ dgag sgrub snying stobs che ba/ dogs slong blo spobs mtho ba/ rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal ba bcas khyad chos bdun dang ldan na‘‘shes yon can rnal ma’’ru bgrangs yod par de ni ha cang dka' tshod du gda'/ 'on kyang des rtsom nga po'i re snyeg phugs 'dun dang 'tshol rtog dgongs gzhi zhig bstan yod pas ci zhig skyon te mi skyon no/ / nub phyogs kyi gna' bo'i ke ri se'i — 79 —

nyi tho rjes dran ma/nyin tho rjes dran ma/da wasnyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring lags kyi sku gshegs pa'i mya ngan la/thos pa'i dus/ dus chod/ 2004 10 24nyin/sa gnas/ slob grwa'i tshoms chen/rang slob gling gi2001lo'i dngos gzhi 'dzin grwa'i slob ma gnyis kyi rtsa 'dzugs 'og nyin de'i dgong mo'i dus tshod19 30steng‘‘skabs dang po'i slob ra'i glu pa grags can gyi 'khrab ston’’zhes pa'i rig rtsal spro tshogs 'tshogs/ de la rang slob grwa'i glu pa grags can dag dang /ched du gdan drangs pa'i deng rabs bod kyi na gzhon rdung len pa mgon po don grub/ gzhan gtsos dge 'os ched sbyong slob grwa'i glu pa zhig sogs mang ngo /‘‘glu gar gyi rgya mtsho’’ni mtho sgang na 'tsho ba'i bod pa tshang bi// thun min gyi khyad chos yin la/ da dung gra nyams zur chag ma byung bar mutshonas mur rgyun spel byas dang byed bzhin gda'/ji 'dra'i snyan mo rang red la/ ji 'dra'i gzi stobs ni 'bar — 81 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/lnga bzhi snying stobs dran rtog‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’ni mi lo gya brgyad kyi yar sngon du byung ba'i khrom skor gyi sbyor ba zhig red/ de ni na gzhon tshos sne khrid de bdag dbang brtson len dang gzur med kyi 'gan 'khri lhur blangs pa'i drang bden gyi sbyor ba zhig red/ de ni gdug rtsub u tshugs kyi drag spyod ring du spangs te dkyel yangs zhi bde'i lam bur 'jug pa'i gom 'gros red/ der chab srid kyi ngos dang rig gnas kyi ngos thad na dge mi dman pa brjod rgyu yod rung gang ltar nga tsho'i blang byar 'os pa ni rig gnas pa'i sde'i na gzhon tsho'i snying stobs dang stobs shugs red/ de las kyang rig gnas snying stobs kyi ngos nas‘‘mang gtso’’dang‘‘tshan rig’’gi kha g.yang nyid brtol te dgongs don mthar thug la bsnyegs na/rtogs sad dang dogs slong dang dgag sgrub dag‘‘blo 'byed’’kyi srad bur brgyus nas‘‘mi'i rtogs pa sad pa’’dang‘‘sger gshis bcings 'grol’’gyi ched red/'das song la phyir rtog byed pa ni yon tan kho na dran pa'i tshul gyis sgo gsum gus pas yid smon dang rjes su yi rang byed pa can ma yin/de ni yid gzab nan tur dang dogs zon cag zon gyis gtsang bsher — 92 ge

shādzi jib rngub rngubabasko 55cad bkabagyis te legs nyes skyon yon gyi gnad mthong bzhin dmigs pa car por mi gtong ba'i gong bkur dang rjes su yi rang byed pa'o/ /rgya'i yon tan pa wang yon hwa⑦nas‘‘lnga bzhi'i rig gnas snying stobs’’la phyir rtog 'di ltar byas 'dug ste/ gcig lnga bzhi'i rig gnas snying stobs kyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig ni‘‘chos skad(gna' yig)dang phal skad bar gyi rtsod pa'am’’yang na‘‘gsar rnying gi rtsod pa’’kho na tsam ma yin par/ lo 'di 'gar rim gyis do snang byed kyin pa'i‘‘sger tshugs kyi bsam blo dang rang dbang gi snying stobs’’red/ gnyis/ lnga bzhi'i rig gnas kyi bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun de rig gnas gnyer mkhan gyi ngos na yun ring gtso rgyugs che zhing kha lobs su song ba'i‘‘mang gtso’’dang‘‘tshan rig’’gnyis kar gdong gtugs pa la dog pa 'phyang byar rigs/ gsum/ lnga bzhi'i dus skabs kyi bsam blo'i grub 'bras gtso bo ni sger gshis bcings 'grol gyi phyogs na yod pas 'di ni‘‘mi'i rtog pa sad pa'i’’dus rabs shig red/ bzhi/ lnga bzhi'i dus su dar bzhin pa'i tha mal ba'i 'phel 'gyur smra ba dang myur skyod ring lugs/ khe phan ring lugs/rang shed kyi kun spyod bcas lta tshul bzhi ni rig gnas gsar 'dzugs la mi phan pa'i shugs rkyen ngan rengs dag red/ lnga/ lnga bzhi ni srol rgyun lasdi gshaṃ d+dha〉 trīsna slo 'a/du8rwarke4thu 1920—)krung go'i deng rabs kyi mkhas pa/ brtsams chos 〈srol rgyun dang srol — 93 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/rgyun la dgag pa red mod/ cha yongs su nas dgag pa min/ drugalnga bzhi'i dus su rang rigs kyi gzhung lugs grags can du mar dkar 'don zhib 'jug byas yod par rjes rabs pa tshos do snang du mthong /zhes yod tshad la bskyar du gdeng 'jog byed pa'am lo rgyus khrod bor zin pa'am snang med car bzhag gi mi sna grags can dang rig gnas kyi snying stobs dag do khur zhe bskyed kyis btsal 'tshol gsar rnyed byas dang byed bzhin yod/rig gnas dang 'brel ba'i na gzhon tsho'i snying stobs gleng na/thad kar dran pa ni gzhon nu rnams dang co 'dri ba'i‘‘lang tsho'i rbab chu’’red la/ de 'brel gyis‘‘rang grol’’zhes pa'i skyes chen zhig kyang dran slong bya dgos song / khong ni mi yul 'dir dgung lo sum cu lhag tsam las ma bzhugs kyang ljags rtsom gyi kha grangs dang po ti'i grangs tshad la gzhigs na ha las dgos pa'i mi bu khyad par ba zhig red/ de 'dra'i mi bu yon tan can dang rnam dpyod can/ blo spobs can/ gsar gtod can ni gzhan gang la'ang 'tshol du med/ yin na'ang mi tshe'i mtha' ma'i lam bu de'i 'dam gar kho bos ji ltar bsam yang yid sems rab tu 'khrugs/ rang rigs la zhen pa zab drags pa dang dungs pa rgod drags pas yin nam/ yang na phugs bsam gyi 'dun pas bskul nas sgyu rtsal brtsams chos kyi blo 'byed la re bzhag che drags pas yin/— 94 —

lnga ba snying bas dran g.yang na〈〈lcebs gzhung〉du/ lcebs pa la rigs gsum phyes te/ rang don dang gzhan phan/ zing 'khrug gi lcebs pa bcas gsum las/khong nyid kyi gshegs tshul ni dang po'i khyad chos ldan la gnyis pa dang nye bar yod/ (〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉2 157)ces bkod pa ltar 'di gsum po‘‘kha chems yi ge’’las rnyed pa'i kun slong tsam du zad par/ lar rigs gang la gtogs na'ang gu yangs dang bzod gsol gyi gnas su khas 'ches mod/ 〈phyi rgyal gyi rtsom rig mkhan gyi gtam rgyud〉ces par h+pha ran si'i pal za khiduni chung dus nas slob grwar bskyal pas ma yum gyi brtse ba myong ma thub/ slob zhor du dge rgan zur bsten byas nas dpe cha mang por lta klog thub cing slob mthar phyin rjes pha ma'i re ba ltar khrims rtsod pa'i bya ba gnyer bar rang gi rang dbang 'dod blo(zikhyeṣ+ṭha.oṃ)btsan po'i dbang gis khyim mi dang rtsod gleng bgyis mthar rgyan skugs kyis rtsom 'bri'i las su zhugs shing / pha ma gnyen nye dang bral nas rang dbang las gnyer gyi 'tsho bar rol/ tshags par sgrub pa dang dpar khang 'dzugs pa sogs las rigs gang zhig gnyer na'ang pham kha zam ma chad par nyos skad/de ltar phyi'i spyi tshogs kyi gnang pa'i khor yug ji ltar gdug rtsub che gyi spro /phre/〉soṅgirmi shāt+t+waṃg/ (5 2'i2 0 3lo༈skyim 1799—1850)h+pha ran si'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chosardomi ru la — 95 —

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/zhing snying rje bral na'ang rtsom mkhan gyi nang sems pa'i 'jig rten nyid de ltar rgya cher dang phun tshogs su 'gro/ khong gi〈mi yul gyi spro gar〉zhes par lar brtsams sgrung brgya dang bzhi bcu 'bri rgyu'i 'char bkod yod par dgu bcu go drug las ma grub/ gzhan brtsams sgrung ma yin pa'i bcoms chos mang po yang ci rigs su mdzad/ de dag ni rang lo sum cu yas mas nas 'bri 'go brtsams shing mi tshe'i mtha' ma'i bar du rgyun bskyangs pa red/ khong la 'tsho bas ku re ci 'dra rtse na yang rang gi rtsom 'bri'i las rgyun chad ma myong / khong la khor yug gis ji ltar the gtogs byas na'ang rang dbang 'dod blo'i me ri nam yang bcil ma myong /khong ni de ltar mi yul gyi bskal bar gnas shing ji srid du g.yung drung la bkod/ gal te rang grol yang de ltar ma bzhud par‘‘rang dbang 'dod blo’’la ngos zin rnyed yod rgyu na/ gal te 'tsho ba'i gdug rtsub dang mi kha'i sdigs dmod las 'khrungs pa'i gdung sems rab tu 'ching thub rgyu na/ gal te bdag gi shes pa de ches bris kyi mi dang mi rigs thun mong gi bdag las 'gongs te rang shed btsan po'i bdag nyid la gzigs thub rgyu na/ spyir rang gis mi nus pa'am mi bzod pa'i lam bu'am las gnyer de gzhan la bsgrub tu 'jug pa'am 'gel ba dang /de las kyang mi yul dang bral zin gyi skyes chen tshor khag dkri ba ni rang nyid phyi bshol dang gab sbed du 'gro bas nam zhar gu yangs gtong mi — 96 —

lnga ba nga bas dran 'os/ yin yang / kho bos ni rang grol lags phyi ma'i yul nas 'dug bzod mi bde ba zhig tu gtong mdog kha po ma yin par khong gnyis kyi go bsdur las blo sna re bskyed na bsam/skyes bu rnam dpyod can zhig de ltar rang lo so gnyis te rtsom 'bri'i me ri rab tu 'phyur sgang du mi yul dang gtan bral byung / rang dbang 'dod blos phyur bur gtams pa'i skyes bu sgal tshigs can zhig de ltar rang lo sum cu yas mas nas rtsom 'bri'i las gnyer nas mtshan snyan bskal bar srid/ gang ltar/ khong gnyis kyi mi gshis dang bskyed 'bras de dag kyang mthar gtugs na rig gnas la rag las shing /rig gnas kyi gong thang gcod phyogs des 'jig rten gyi 'tsho gnas la 'dzin pa'i sems khams grub pa yin pas/ mi bu snying stobs can dang /mi bu rtsis thang can/ mi bu sgal tshigs can/ khong tsho nam yang lo rgyus kyi khong gseng dang rig gnas kyi khyab khongs nas nga tshos 'tshol snyeg bya dgos/da lta'i shod rgyun du/ bod kyi rig gnas(nang bstan gtso)ni nang sems kyi bde ba gnyer pa'i zhi bde'i rig gnas dang phyi gling pa'i rig gnas ni phyi dngos po'i dpal 'byor gnyer ba'i zang zing gi rig gnas red ces brjod pa ni yid sems btang snyoms su ma gnas pa'i bshad yan tsam du nges snyam/ rig gnas la tag tag nang sems dang phyi 'i — 97 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/longs spyod rig gnas su dbye ba ni bshad srol rnying pa zhig gam blo zhib bur brdar ma myong ba'i rig lam dbye gcod yin pas/ da lta da dung yang de ltar du zad na rang rigs kyi rig gnas der yang blo rtsing rags kyi sla bcos su song bar snyam/ tha'e wan gyi mkhas pa grags can we kreng thungadhigis〈krung go'i rig gnas spyi bshad〉du/ krung phyi'i rig gnas kyi khyad par 'di ltar bstan yod de/krung go'i rig gnas/ 1 yul can gtso/ 2 kun spyod kyi sems/3 kun spyod kyi rig gnas/ 4 thad tshor gtso/ 5 sems kyi nyams rtog gtso/ 6 sgor la 'phags pa/ 7 rig gnas kyi srol gtso/nub gling gi rig gnas/ 1 phyi yul gtso/ 2 shes 'dzin gyi sems/3 tshan rig gi rig gnas/ 4 blo rig gtso/ 5 mthong snang grub 'bras gtso/ 6 nar la dpyod pa/ 7 rig gnas kyi rab dbye gtso/zhes phyogs bdun gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi rig gnas la zhib bsdur mdzad yod par nga tshos kyang de dang cha yongs su tshang ba nas 'dra bshus byed dgos zer ba ma yin par/ de dang rigs bsgre nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas gleng na yang spyi bshad bam bshad tsam gyi che sa mi bzung bar bye brag chung sa nas gtsang bsher nan tur bgyis nas dkar dpyadahārjodakānāt+nathung/brtsa/oṃsh+lau9 1lha39—)rmidā nā'i deng zlobs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan dang / chab srid —— — 98 ———/ sa/ sa kru/ngapa khur nga thabazu/ lha/ba/ ba/tha 'odirnga1ba/

thegazu bsko chub 3) /na21 sdo/95/nga cho'i‘‘shes yon can’’ga re ded/da wanub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi rang mos gleng stegs steng nas gtam bshad pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/spyi lo2006lo'i zla10pa'i tshes24nyin/mgo 'dzin pa'i gtam/ kho'i ming la pad+ma dbang rgyal zer/ kho2000lor slob grwa 'dir yong nas rang re'i slob gling gi slob gnyer la zhugs zig2004lor phyir rang re'i slob gling gi zhib 'jug slob ma la rgyugs 'phrod nas da lta lo rim gsum pa la slebs yod/ spyir rang mos gleng stegs 'di yang rkyen du ma'i dbang gis 'tshogs rgyu dka' mo zhig red mod/ nga cho chogs mi chos hrar brtson dang bsral len byas par brten/ chogs thengs rab dang rim pa spel/da thengs nga tshos kho rang gleng stegs steng yong nas gtam bshad pa'i re ba zhus pa na/khos kyang khengs skyung la sogs pa'i mi 'dod pa'i rnam pa spangs nas/ do dgong nga tsho dang mnyam 'dzoms byung / kho'i gleng bya gtso bo ni nga cho'i shes yon can’ga re red ces pa de red/ do dgong khong gis gleng slong ba tsam las mang po mi bshad pas/ slob grogs tshos kha byang dang 'brel ba'i dri ba mang po bton na/khong gis kyang skabs thob kyi dri ba dang 'brel nas 'phros bshad mang po bya nges/da dngos su 'go rtsom rgyu byed/ (thal mo rdeb sgra)— 100—

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ga re red/ya/ ‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’kyi mgo 'dzin pas kyang gong nas bshad dang thal/ drang mor bshad na/ ‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’'tshogs rgyur yang dka' khag che gi yin yang / dka' khag mang po zhig brgyud nas da lta tshad 'di 'dra zhig la thon dang zig gleng stegs 'di'i 'go 'dzugs mkhan nga tsho red/ 2000lo'i rtsom rig 'dzin grwas kyang 'di'i thad la gtso shugs bton yod/ 2002lor 'go btsugs nas da snga'i bar du lo ngo lnga'i lo rgyus yod ni red/ 'di chung chung zhig red zer na ha cang chung chung zhig yin ni red/ chung chung zhig ma red zer na chen po zhig yin ni red/ de 'dra'i go rim gyi bar nas gleng stegs 'di lag chags nas lo lnga la bud dang zig lo ngo lngar son pa'i khrod nas nga rang nyid ni gleng stegs la dngos su 'brel ba yod pa'i mi sna zhig yin/ 'di brgyud nas nga rang nyid yang byis pa zhig nas gsar bu zhig tu btang / bsam shes min pa can zhig nas bsam shes can zhig tu btang ba'i brgyud rim yod pas/ nga rang nyid la mtshon na gleng stegs 'di bka' drin shin tu che/ 'di 'dra'i gleng stegs 'tshogs pa'i mkha' dbugs 'dzoms po zhig gi ngang nas slob ma mang po zhig la blo bskyed zer na'ang chog shes bya'i khyab rgya zer na'ang chog dpe cha lta klog gi nus pa zer na'ang chog bsam blo gtong stangs zer na'ang chog ci dang gang gi phyogs nas dge phan mi dman — 101 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/pa dang rgya mang ba bskyed yod/nga rang gis da thengs tag tag‘‘nga tsho'i ‘shes yon can’ ga re red’’ces pa'i kha byang 'di 'dra zhig 'dem dgos rkyen ci yin zer na/‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa'i brjod gzhi(khyosgro)'di'i thad la nub gling pa dang rgya nag pas snga mo nas gnad don gal chen zhig tu mthong ste/der dpyad pa btang nas dpyad 'bras kyang mi nyung ba blangs 'dugabod rang la mtshon na/ da so ma gnad don du shes nas zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i myu gu 'bus 'go tsam dang da so ma gom pa dang po spos pa tsam red ces pa dang gcig deng rabs kyi don snying ldan pa'i‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa 'di gleng ba la bod rang nyid la de'i thad kyi rkang rten 'cha' sa dang gzhi 'dzugs sa gang zhig yin pa/ de dag la cha rkyen ci zhig 'dzoms pa dang khyad chos gang zhig ldan tshul dang gnyis so/ /de bzhin du kha byang la dri ba zhig gi tshul du bkod nas de ltar 'dogs dgos don yang ci yin zer na/ gcig nas nga rang nyid kyis do dgong‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa'i gnad don 'di thag gi gcod rgyu zer nas de'i go don gtan la phab pa dang tshad gzhi nges gtan byed rgyu'i 'dun pa med par/de'i thad la rang nyid kyi dran phyogs dang bsam blo gtong stangs tsam gleng rgyu yin/ gnyis su nga rang nyid the ba'i 'dir 'dzoms kyi slob grogs tshang ma yang‘‘shes yon can’’zhig min rung thos pa don gnyer gyi cha nas ge 102 —

nga tsho'i‘‘shes yon can’’ga re red/de dang 'brel thag ches nye ba dang / gzhan bshad mkhan dang nyan mkhan nyis cha nas dran tshul lhugs por brjod chog pa dmigs yul du bzung yod/ de bas/ khyod tshos kyang 'dzem dogs spang nas/ dri ba bton na'ang chog yang na rang rang gi lta tshul brjod na'ang chogagang ltar tshang mas mnyam gleng byed pa'i‘‘bgro gleng’’gi rnam pa yo/da rgyu ni nga'i mthar thug gi re ba yin/'o ya/ de ltar bshad nas yong na/ bshad bya ci 'i/ga yin pa la/tshang mas mi shes rgyu med gi kha byang la〈nga tsho'i 6shes yon can’ ga re red〉zer ba dang de'i nang gi tha snyad dam ming brda gtso bo yang‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa de red/ ‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa 'di bshad dgos song na / thog mar brda chad de ji ltar byung ba dang 'byung khungs gang yin pa/ lo rgyus rgyab ljongs/ de ci lta bu zhig tu ngos 'dzin bzhin yod pa bcas la rgyus lon byed dgos gi nga rang nyid kyis 'brel yod dpe cha dang brtsams chos la bltas pa mang po mi bshad par nyung nyung sgos bshad na/ brda chad de nub gling gi rig gnas dang 'brel ba can zhig red/ yong khungs sam mched khungs kyi cha nas sna sgo gnyis na yoja de/ gcig ni u ru su'i yi ge nas byung zhing dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i skabs red/ de dus kyi u ru su'i shes yo/na can tshang ma ci lta bu zhig red zer na/ tshang ma spyi tshogs kyi mtho rim mi sna red/ rig gam/sa khe 103 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/shes bya ldan pa/ slob gso myangs zin pa/ slob gso de yang nub gling gi slob gso yin pas/ rig gnas shes bya'i rgyab ljongs kyang nub gling gi de red/ kho tshos ci zhig byas pa red zer na/ nub gling gi rig gnas shes bya'i mig zung de spyad nas phyir rjes lus yin pa'i rang gi rgyal khab kyi sger gcod lam lugs dang / spyi tshogs kyi skyug bro ba dang lugs mthun min pa dag la kha gtad nas/ de'i ngan phyogs dang skyon mtshang gi cha la ther 'don dang dgag sgrub byas pa red/ kho tsho tshang ma la dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi gtso rgyugs tshul lugs sam sgrig srol las ring du gyes pa'i 'du shes dang rgyab 'gal ngo log gi 'du shes ldan pa ma zad/dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs rab tu che ba dang / kun spyod dgag sgrub kyi 'du shes kyang rab tu zab pa'i sde'am ru dpung zhig red/ khong tsho ni spyi tshogs kyi las gnas mi 'dra zhing thob thang yang mi 'dra ba'i rim pa so so nas byung ba can zhig yin te/ 'ga' zhig ni dge rgan dang / la la ni dmag dpon/ kha shas ni bya ba'i las gnas ci yang med pa'ang 'dug gang ltar snying stobs 'dzin lugs kyi ngos na khong tsho la gzhi mthun gyi cha yod pas/ de dag ni snying stobs sam sems kha mthun phyogs gcig pa'i ru sde zhig red/cig shos ni h+pha ran si rgyal khab red/ de yang dus rabs bcu dgu par 'khel yod/ skabs der h+pha ran si rgyal khab la don rkyen zhig — 104 —

nga cho'i‘ sa yon can’’ re red/byung zig de la‘‘ti le h+phu si don rkyen’’zer/ ‘‘ti le h+phu si’’(stsartsaskyaglo)zhes pa ni dmag dpon gyi thob thang yod pa'i mi zhig red/ kho la ngan g.yo/ brnyas dmod thebs song / thebs dgos rkyen yang rgyu mtshan gzhan gang yang ma yin par/ tag tag ya hu dā pa yin rkyen red/don rkyen de ni spyi lo1894lor byung / de byung rjes kyi lo ngo bzhi pa ste/spyi lo1898lo'i zla1pa'i tshes23nyin〈shes yon can gyi bsgrags gtam〉zhes pa'i rtsom zhig spel zig de'i gras su h+pha ran si'i ming du grags pa'i rig gnas pa zo la'adhidang u kodusogs 'dug kho tshos rang nyid la mnga' ba'i drang bden gyi 'du shes dang spyi tshogs kyi rgyu 'bras blo mig gi cha nas dmag dpon de la rgyab skyor gyis 'gan 'khri dang du blangs pa red/ 'gan 'khri ni spyi tshogs kyi drang gzhag la rgyab skyor dang / drang gzhag min pa la dgag sgrub gtong rgyu de'o/ /khong tsho ni mi ci 'dra zhig red zer na/ slob gso thob yod pa ma zad/ rig gnas kyi chu tshad nges can yod thog dgag sgrub kyi 'du shes dang spyi tshogs kyi rgyu 'bras blo mig dang ldan pa'i tshogs pa zhig red/ khong tsho'i gras su gtso bo ni rig gnas pa dang rtsom mkhan sogs rang dbang gi las don ched gnyer 'dug() zo la'/(stusnu03 11 1840—1902)h+pha ran si'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chos(myu gu 'bus pa〉soganu sogs hāduga.uko(myo5jitha0 lko 1802—1885)h+pha ran si'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chos ya nga ba'i 'jis chan bhe 105 —

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/pa mang po 'dug de dag kyang snying stobs 'dzin lugs kyi ngos na gzhi mthun du yod la nyin rgyun kha'o h+phe khang nas spyi tshogs dang chab srid thad kyi gnad don la bgro gleng byed bzhin yod pa red/des na/ tha snyad 'di'i yong khungs kyi cha nas 'di 'dra'i rnam pa gnyis yod gi 'di gnyis kyi thun mong gi khyad chos mdor bsdus na/slob gso thob myong ba dang / rig gnas pa yin pa/ dgag sgrub kyi 'du shes ldan pa/ spyi tshogs kyi rgyu 'bras blo mig mnga' pa sogs red/de bzhin du deng rabs kyi don snying ldan pa'i‘‘shes yon can’’zer ba'ang ci 'dra zhig red zer na/ sger tshugs kyi thob thang gzhi byas shes bya dang snying stobs la khen nas spyi tshogs la thun mong do khur rab tu che ba dang / de'i khrod nas rang nyid kyi rgyu 'bras blo mig dang spyi tshogs zab zhugs kyi 'du shes mngon par mtshon pa'i rig gnas pa'i tshogs pa zhig red/ gzhan du na/ shes yon can gyis gzhi rkang 'bab sa'i mi tshe'i do khur gyi cha de yang / 'di 'dra'i sna sgo gsum nas mngon dgos par 'dod de/ gcig spyi tshogs(chab srid)kyi do khur/ gnyis/ rig gnas(rin thang) kyi do khur/ gsum/ shes bya(ched las) yi do khur bcas so/ /kho tshos‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa'i thog ma'i rnam pa ni 'di 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin bzhin 'dug yang gcig bshad na/ skad khungs rig — 106 —

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ga re red/pa'i(shratsholha)thad nas kyang ming brda de'i thog ma'i nang don ni de tsam red tsang / da lta so ma gnad don 'di zhib 'jug bya yul du mthong bzhin pa'i nga tsho la mtshon na yang / 'di ni nges par tu shes dgos pa'am rgyus lon byed dgos pa'i ma mtha'i cha rkyen red/ der ma zad thog ma'i gom pa spo sa'i rkang rten yang red/ de ma gtogs lo rgyus kyi srog rgyun ring zhing zhib 'jug gi dpyad 'bras mi dman pa blangs yod pa'i nub gling par mtshon na/ de ni gzhung lugs gtos chen po zhig tu grub zin pas/ mkhas dbang so sos go don 'jog tshul dang rigs dbye dgar lugs la mi mthun pa mang po yod pa ni kho tsho'i da snga'i gnas bab red/de ltar na/ bod rang la shes yon can gang dag yod dam zer na/ngas sngon chad nas 'dri 'dra zhig la 'dang brgyab myong / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang du nga tsho la lo rgyus su gyur zin pa'i shes yon can gyi mgrin tshab tshad ldan du rung ba ga re yod gi yang na mdzub mo nang 'gug gis rtsi rung ba gang dag yod gi de tshang mas shes ni red/ mkhas dbang dge chos dang rang grol gnyis ma gtogs phal cher bgrang rgyu med tsam gda'/ 'on kyang rgya nag la mtshon na/ snga rabs su khang yi'u

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/wedudang li'ang chi khra'odusogs dang / rjes su lu'u zhun dang hu'u hridhidang tsha'e yon phedusogs rab dang rim pa byung zig khong tsho tshang ma'i bsam blo gtong phyogs dang dga' kha 'khyer so mi 'dra na yang mthar thug gi dmigs yul gyi 'bab gzhi gcig tu 'gro ba dang / de 'dra'i tshogs pa'am dpung khag kyang byung myong zig yin yang / bod rang la de 'dra'i mi sna chig rkyang pa dang kher hreng pa las ma byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ga re red ces nam yin yang rang nyid la dris myong / myong ni mi tshad da dung yang de'i phyogs la mu mthud nas 'dang rgyag bzhin yod stabs/ do dgong nga rang gis bsam blo gnad du things pa btang nas dpyad 'bras rdog rdog cig ston pa'am/ don dag de thag gis gcod rgyu zer nas bshad ni min/ 'o na/ de'i phyogs la bsam gzhig btang ba'i khrod nas rang nyid la blo skyed ci 'dra byung ba de slob grogs tshor bshad rgyu yin/nga rang nyid la mtshon na'ang lo na tshod dang sems kyi g.yo phyogs sogs sna gang yin nas khyod tsho dang do mnyam pa/ zla mnyam pa/ rigs gcig tu 'gro bas 'di 'dra zhig e yin snyam bzhin bsam tshul brje res brtsamani chosakhad+nghasmu'u ldasdi/ laspru rmik+koḍāgashā 8shād+dhirgo1927)krung go'i nye rabs kyi bsam blo mkhan dang / rtsom rig mkhan/brtsamahā chosaliṭ+wāju n+nish+lau nā/ rgyarko ṭā t+t+waṃg1 ṇ+ḍaṃrdo3 theshā9lhiṅgespyu ṭā /t+t+waṃ nye rabs kyi bsam blo mkhan dang / rtsom rig mkhan/sgam sdokyel sniṭ+wā sdi/nga dat+t+waṃphroṃltogashā 8shāṭ+wāṃrgo1962)krung rga'i deng rabs kyi mkhas pa dang bsam blo mkhan/ brtsams chos chotsha'iyosnangarī/cho spyorkehūṃchi186ṅgi—1940)krung go'i mang gtso gsar brje nga/ dang / slob gso mkhan/brtsaca/ma /50ṭ+wāṃng dka' sa ga pa' rgyus gas 'dug

nga cho'i‘‘rīs yo ca ’’ re ded/byed 'dod kyi blos bskul nas/ gong du‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa'i skor gyi shes bya thor bu zhig ngo sprod byas zin pa ltar/ de dang rigs bsgre ste bshad par bya/gong nas bshad zin pa ltar/ bod rang la lo rgyus su gyur zin pa'am dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang du/ shes yon can du bgrang rung ba gnyis te/ mkhas dbang dge chos dang rang grol rnam pa gnyis tsam red/ khong rnam pa gnyis ni bod rang gi shes yon can la ngos 'dzin byed spyad kyi lde mig lta bu dang / lcags kyu lta bu/ dar cha lta bu/gang ltar sngon du 'gro ba'i ru sna 'dren mkhan red/ der khong rnam pa gnyis kyis phyogs gang gi thad nas‘‘shes yon can’’gyi khyad chos de mngon 'dug zer na/thog mar mkhas dbang dge chos gleng bar bya/ nga rang nyid kyis rgyus lon byas pa 'chug med na/ mkhas dbang khong nyid kyis g.ya' ma bkra shis 'khyil nas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ de nas dbus su phebs pa'i bar der bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas la thos pa don gnyer gyis rmang gzhi brtan po btsugs par 'dod/ des na shes yon can zhig tu 'gyur rung gi cha de gang nas mngon 'dug zer na/ dbus su bzhugs dus kyi stes dbang dang yang na rgyu tshogs kyi rkyen la 'phrad/lhag tu rgya gar la phebs tshun nas shes yon can gyi khyad chos mang po zhigre — 109 —

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/rang chas su grub 'dug khong tshang gi snyan ngag gsar rtsom yin na chog gi gnas skor zin tho gtam rgyud gser thang yin na chog gi lo rgyus deb dkar yin na chog gi lo tsā legs sbyar bang mdzod yin na chog gi mtshan nyid klu sgrub dgongs rgyan(khong tshang gi yin min bshad rgyu che rung thun mong gi lugs la khong gi ljags rtsom du bgrang) yin na chog gi sgyu rtsal thang ga ri mo yin na chog gi mi tshul bstan bcos 'dod bstan yin na chog gi 'di 'dra'i sna sgo chen po brgyad kyi ngos nas shes yon can gyi khyad chos 'dang gi ci zhig la 'dang song zig zer na/ snyan ngag gi thad nas/ khong tshang gi bar de nas snyan ngag la mngon brjod dang go dka' ba'i rgyan gyis ma bcings par/ yul skad rang bzhin nam mi mang dkyus ma'i skad cha de bkol ba red/ khong gis gsung rgyur/snyan ngag rtsom pa la thog mar yul mi rang bzhin pa'i skad cha la sbyang nas dpyis phyin thog rtsom brgyab na ro bro phun sum tshogs pa dang nyams kyis phyug thub par dgongs pas red/ chabs cig rang nyid kyang dngos su der zhugs nas dper 'god lugs dang tshig gi sdeb sbyor thams cad nas lag len du bstar ba red/ gtam rgyud gser thang la mtshon na yang / rgyal khams gnas skor dang yul skor zin tho'i tshugs ka red/ de yang bod rang gi mkhas dbang snga ma'i mdzad pa'i lam yig ste/ chos kyi dmigs yul gnad du bzung ba can dang bstan bcos la — 110 —

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon ca ’’ re red/bstun ci thub byed pa can ni ma yin par/ dngos yod tshul lugs dang bstun nas bye brag phra mo re re nas mnyam 'jog dang do snang gis rigs lam zhib bur brdar 'dug lo rgyus deb dkar la yang / snga rabs mkhas dbang tshos ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i deb ther te/ 〈dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉dang〈bu ston chos 'byung〉〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉〈deb ther sngon po〉sogs kyis lo rgyus shig brjod yod kyang de yang chos kyi 'byung ba gtso bor bzung nas rgyal khab kyi srid de phal bar bzhag 'dug yang gcig bshad na/ srid des chos la zhabs 'degs zhu bar byas te bar bcug gi tshul du 'gro bar/ dge chos nas srid 'a dkar 'don gyis srid gtso bor bzung nas brtsams gnang mdzad pa red/ gzhan lo tsā legs sbyar bang mdzod la mtshon na/rags lta byas na rgya gar gyi legs sbyar skad de bod skad la yang bskyar bsgyur pa'i‘‘bskyar zlos’’kyi zol yod pa ltar du snang gi yin yang ༈/zhib tu mjal na/ bskyar zlos kyi phyir du bskyar zlos byas pa ni ma yin par/ snga rabs mkhas dbang tshos legs sbyar skad la byang tshul gyis dpe deb kyi mgor‘‘sum rkang sgrig pa'i’’snang tshul de ni 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang rung / zhib tu brtag na skyon cha mang po rnyed par mthong nas dgag sgrub rma med sprad zhor/ de 'dra'i mkhas rtags rdzig po la 'phya dmod dang rigs gzhung gi ngos nas dgag sgrub bskyon 'dug gzham/ — 111 ge

de bya/ba chub 3) kun24 sdo/shugi/mkhas dbang tshos legs sbyar gyi skad tshur bod la bsgyur dus gang gi cha nas go 'dzol byung yod tshul/ gang gi ngos nas lhad skyon byung yod tshul la dag ther dang dgag sgrub gnang 'dug klu sgrub dgongs rgyan lta bu la mtshon na/ dgag rgyu dang sgrub rgyu nyis thad nas sems kyi 'khyer so yod pa ma zad/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyang phun sum tshogs pa red/gzhan rigs lam de yang gra dag spus dag tu 'gro/ sgyu rtsal thang ga'i ngos thad nas/ nyin 'ga'i yar sngon la phyi gling pa bde sbyin bzang mo'i 'chad khridadhi las nga tshos mthong byung / mkhas dbang khong nyid kyi thog ma'i ri mo de sbyang ba tsam yin na yang / rjes kyi ri mo dag la dmigs 'ben dang zhib dpyod kyi cha yod par snang ste/ dper na/ 'jig rten ril mo'i sa khra lta bu red/(de la gong na 'jig rten nam sa'i go la chen po gnyis do mnyam por yod la/ 'gab na chung ba gcig bcas gong 'og thog rtseg tu yod pa ni da bar gyi sa'i go la'i sa khra ril bo de dang a na ma na red/ khong gis skya thig gis bris pa zhig go)sa khra de yang tag tag 'jig rten ril mo yin nam leb leb yin’zhes pa'i rtsod gzhi der dmigs nas bris pa zhig tu snang / rtsod gzhi de ni mkhas dbang snga rabs du ma nas khong gi skabs su'ang zam ma chad par rtsod na/ der gsal kha 'byed ched bris pa yin par ri mo'i 'bri dge ṭādun trīnā 2ram̐drinālo sdongarnya rngi ༈ ༈ swāl3 n+ninā : d+māsnad+ngha ṭāsru me+e sdid+ngha sna bsdo tram̐shā/ bzasdo sdosngu lgobyā ñtsādū sdi trīkākā lbib lhanā sdo rnyed kyānga'adudangoj-i bstan byung / r+shazhe nā shes 'dod na gangs ljangs gzhon nu dra tshigs skru rang pos gleng stegasale tshan la gdags1 / ༵nga don gnad bsdus bad da/

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ de red/lugs dang zhabs mchan 'god rkyen las rnyed thub par 'dod/gzhan rgya gar lam yig gi bar bcug gi mtshon rtags ri mo dang /‘‘nub bod legs bcos skyid sdug’’ da dung sgrol ma'i thang ga chos rgyal srong btsan gyi thang ga sogs gang gi gshis dang bab la bltas shing brtag na/ mi tshul can dang mi gshis can gyi lta ba 'bur du thon 'dug tha na 'dod pa'i bstan bcos la mtshon na yang / 'jig rten gyi 'khor ba skyong bya yin pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa gnyer dgos par yin 'jog byas pa/ bud med kyi rin thang la yin 'jog dang de'i rtsis thang la gong bkur bstan pa/ mdor na/ 'jig rten pa'i dgos mkho de skyung bya zhig ma yin par skong bya zhig yin par dgongs yod gi de dag thams cad kyi rkang rten 'cha' sa'am 'bab gzhi ni 'jig rten mi chos zhes pa yin pas/ de'i ngos nas bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas la dgag pa tsha nan btang yod thog rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi shugs rkyen shin tu che ba'i mdzad rjes bla med bzhag 'dugader brten/ khong la dogs slong gi 'du shes dang snying stobs yod pa ma zad/ dgag sgrub kyi 'du shes dang snying stobs kyang ldan pas/gsar gtod kyi ngo bo rang bzhin gyis grub 'dugade nas mar la ded yong na/ gang la thug yod zer na/ mkhas dbang rang grol la thug yod gi khong ni nga tsho bod kyi shes yon can/ gyi — 113 ge

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/tshab byed mi sna gnyis pa ru bgrang na chog gi snyan ngag gi ngos thad nas bshad na/ bcad pa ma yin pa'i rang mos zer ba 'di'i srol btod mkhan red/ lhug rtsom la yang sngon na med pa'i‘‘skad cha’’bkol bas rtsom rig gi rang mdangs‘‘mi’’dang thag je nyer phyin 'dug pa dang /brtsams sgrung la mtshon na lhag tu'ang mi mang dkyus ma ba'i 'tsho ba'i kha thag dang je nyer btang yod pas bod kyi rtsom rig gis da gzod‘‘mi skad’’bshad byung ba red/ der brten/ rtsom rig gi phyi'i rnam pa ste/'bri stangs dang skad cha'i thad nas gsar gtod byas yod pa ma zad/brjod bya'i nang don gyi thad nas kyang gsar gtod byas 'dug yin yang gsar gtod de dag kyang mkhas dbang dge chos ltar sngon 'gro ji bzhin du tshang ba ma yin par/ ha le ho ler/ ya nga yang nge thol byung gi cha che tsam 'dug snyam/ dper na/ 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉lta bu la mtshon na yang ji ltar mdzad pa la bshad rgyun mang po 'dug(chos skyong gi〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉2 79) de bzhin du〈'bol rtsom zhogs pa'i skya rengs〉la mtshon na yang rgya nag gi rtsom rig gsar par lad zlos kyis bris pa'i sbyang rtsom tsam du zad/ de dag ni sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi cha nas red/lo rgyus kyi cha nas brjod na yang / bsgyur rtsom〈thang yig gsar rnying〉 〉dang dpyad rtsom〈bod gna' rabs kyi bka'i pho nya bgrod tshul〉sogs lo rgyus skor gyi rtsom mang po bris yod rung / lo rgyus kyi ngos nas de la dag — 114 —

nga tsho'i‘‘shes yon can’’ re ded/ther dang dgag sgrub tsha nan byas med par/ kha gsab dang rgyun 'dzin dang dbye zhib tsam du song 'dug snyam/ de bas/ mkhas dbang rang grol la mtshon na/ dogs slong yod par zad kyi/ de yang tshugs thub cig dang rang rkya 'pher ba zhig tu grub yod par ma snang snyam/ de bzhin du gsar gtod de yang yid rton 'pher ba'i brtan brling can zhig ma yin par‘‘stes dbang’’tsam du 'gro snyam/ dgag sgrub kyi cha ni de dag las kyang nyam chung bar mngon par 'dod do/ /de ltar bshad yong na/ mkhas dbang khong rnam pa gnyis ji ltar yong ba red zer na/ mkhas dbang dge chos nyid rgya gar la ma phebs yar sngon du ser mo pa dkyus ma zhig dang grwa btsun phal ba zhig red/der rgya gar la phebs tshun nas rig gnas kyi dpa' rgod du gyur la/'brel 'dris byed sa'i rig gnas de yang phyi gling pa'i rig gnas red/khong ni rig gnas 'dis shan zhugs shing 'dis bskyangs pa can zhig red/ mkhas dbang rang grol la mtshon na/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob chen du ma phebs yar sngon la las byed mi sna spyir btang ba zhig dang rang ga ba zhig red/ slob chen der zhugs tshun nas da gzod rig gnas kyi dpa' rgod du gyur/ der lo rgyus kyi rkyen du ma'i dbang gis 'brel 'dris byed sa'i rig gnas de yang rgya nag pa'i rig gnas las nub gling pa'i rig gnas la 'brel ba med pa ltar tu snang / khong la — 115 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/rig gnas des shan zhugs shing des bskyangs bar 'dod/ des na/khong rnam pa gnyis kyi lag chags sa dang 'tshar longs byung sa'i go rim de bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas kyis bskyangs rung / gzhug nas 'brel 'dris byed sa'i rig gnas ma 'dra ba'i ngang tshul de las/ nga tshos ci zhig shes gi zer na/ dge chos de gsar shugs ha cang che drags pa dang / thal drags pa can du snang / rang grol ni khong dang bsdur na/ gsar shugs che tsam du 'gro yang rnying shugs(ltab)kyang mi dman pa yod tshod ltar red/ 'di ltar‘‘bskyed 'bras’’mi 'dra ba gnyis byung dang zig de bzhin du khong gnyis ni shes yon can du 'gyur rkyen ga re red zer na/ tag tag shes yon can gyi 'gan 'khri la rag las te/ 'gan 'khri ni yang bskyar gnad don can du lta ba'am mthong ba la zer gi 'di ni khong gnyis shes yon can du 'gro byed kyi rgyu mtshan gnad du things pa yin pa ma zad/ gnyis ka'i rtsa ba'i gzhi mthun gyi cha'ang red/ dge chos kyis rin thang ngam gong thang gcod phyogs kyi ngos nas rig gnas de gnad don du mthong ba ste/ snga ma'i mkhas dbang dag la dogs slong dang dgag sgrub kyis gsar gtod byas te/ rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi 'gan 'khri de mngon 'dug rang grol gyis rtsom rig gsar pa'i las 'gul gyi ngos nas mi rigs 'di gnad don du mthong ba ste/ mi rigs kyi snang tshul skyug bro ba la dogs slong d+ngha 116 —

nga tsho'i‘‘rīs yon can’’ga re red/dang ther 'don/ sun 'byin gyis blo 'byed kyi 'gan 'khri mngon 'dug gzhan khong rnam pa gnyis kyi sku tshe'i rnam thar la mjal na/'di 'dra'i nges shes rnyed rgyu yod de/ gnyis ka'i sku tshe de skyo gar gyis yongs su gtams yod gi der rgya nag pa zhus h+phu kon①nas/ shes yon can ni ma gzhi nas skyo gar rang bzhin can yin/ tha na de ni shes yon can rnal ma yin min gyi bden bsher tshad gzhi nyag gcig kyang yin/zer ba'o/ /der ma zad dge chos khong bas mtha' la 'ded mkhan ni phyi gling pa dang bka' shag srid gzhung red/ rang grol khong bas mtha' la 'ded mkhan bod rang gi dge rgan la sogs yon tan pa'i sde red/'di gnyis ni mkhas dbang zung de sdug la sbyor byed kyi phyi rkyen thad kar ba red/'di las nga tshos bod rang gi‘‘shes yon can’’zer ba de ga re yin pa rtogs yong /'di las nga tshos‘‘shes yon can’’gyi rin thang brjod du med pa'am rdzogs rgyu med pa de rtogs yong /'di las nga tshos‘‘shes yon can’’gyi sku tshe'i las dbang khyad par ba de rtogs yong / /rtsamadhichosa3sakyadze+eb/sam(sh+laush+lauk+ṣahūṃsbyikaurmem1:lhasmik+ṣiṃg nālta oṃs kādīlha kyi bsam blo mkhan/ chab srid mkhan//rngaspro/ /sde / //// ———— ༷/gaX///snyen ————

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/da ni/ ‘‘shes yon can’’zer ba de la/ da snga bod rang gis lta stangs ci 'dra zhig 'dzin bzhin yod pa de gleng ba la/ gong nas gsal po byas zin pa ltar/ dge chos kyis rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi cha nas shes yon can la yod 'os pa'i rin thang dang 'gan 'khri rdzogs zin/rang grol gyis rtsom rig gsar pa'i las 'gul la brten nas shes yon can gyi rin thang dang 'gan 'khri dang du blangs 'dug de ltar na/da snga'i bod kyi‘‘shes yon can’’gyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs de ci 'dra zhig red zer na/ ‘‘shes yon can’’zhes 'dogs dus nang du bgrang 'os mi 'os mang po yod rung / gang ltar rgyus lon byed na yang rtsom gyi ngos nas blta dgos pas/ ched du de'i skor la rtsom bris yod pa la mang po mi rig rung / 〈bdag dpe tshogs〉la tshang mas bltas yod gyi red la/de'i nang gi〈dogs slong snying stobs〉su〈yon tan pa dang shes yon can gleng ba〉zhes pa der mtshon na/ rtsom mkhan gyis‘‘yon tan pa’’zhes pa ci lta bu zhig dang‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa ci lta bu zhig yin pa la gsal po dag po byas 'dug yin yang khong gi de ni rang ga ba zhig ma yin par/tshad mtho shos kyi‘‘mdo’’lta bu'i tshul du yod par snang / der‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa la gnas mal gtan 'khel byas yod pa red/ de dang bsdur nas bshad na/ da bar bod rang gi spyi tshogs kyi kha thag dang je nyer phyin yod pa ni/ sku zhabs me lces bris pa'i〈gzur med kyi 'gan da 118 da

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ga re red/'khrid shes yon can gyi 'dam ga gleng ba〉(〈shar dung ri〉'don thengs bco brgyad steng 'khod) zhes pa de red/ zhogs dung lags kyi rtsom de gzhung lugs kyi ngos na yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ me lce lags kyi rtsom de gzhung lugs ma yin par mar zhol la bab nas da snga'i bod rang gi rig gnas pa dang nye bcar gyis thag je thung la bstungs ci thub byas 'dugade bas/ rtsom 'di las nga tshos ci zhig shes thub zer na/ gcig tu nga tsho tshang ma shes yon can yin min de gsal po byas yod pa dang /gnyis su shes yon can gyi ngos 'dzin dang 'gan 'khri de yang da lta ci lta bu zhig yin dgos pa gsal por bstan 'dug dge chos dang rang grol grenyis kyi 'bab gzhi de gong nas bshad zin/ da 'or bshad mi byed/ da snga la mtshon na/ shes yon can gyi 'gan 'khri dang 'dam ga dang gnyer bya ni/ thog mar rang gis rang la 'dri rtog dang / rang gis rang la phyir rtog rang gis rang la kha gtod pa/ de yang bsam pa'i go rtogs yin na chog gi kun spyod yin na chog gi ci dang gang gi phyogs nas de ltar rang rtog gi ngos zin gsal po zhig dgos pa gal bo che la nan tan gyis brjod 'dugad ni‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa 'di'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'phel phyogs ga re red zer na/ nga rang nyid la blta rgya dang thos rgya/ shes bya'i sgrig gzhi/ shes bya'i yon tshad/ bsam gzhig gi nus pa/ phyogs gang — 119 —

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/thad nas ches cher zhan pas 'di 'dra zhig yin rgyu red zer nas rdog rdog cig ston rgyu dka' mod kyang / nga tsho tshang ma rig gnas kyi thos pa 'tshol mkhan zhig yin pa'i cha nas 'ol tshod kyi nyog gtam re 'ga' brjod na/ dge rgan chen mo pa yin na'ang chog ched mkhas pa yin na'ang chog slob gso rig pa mkhan yin na'ang chog gang ltar spyi tshogs kyi las rigs je zhib tu song ba dang bstun nas‘‘pa po ba bo’’yang mang po byung dang 'byung bzhin 'dug 'di tshang ma‘‘shes yon can’’du 'gyur nges yin zer na dka' mod/ 'on kyang de dag las mi sna re 'ga'‘‘shes yon can’’du 'gyur rgyu'i cha rkyen yod pa red/ khong tsho ni da lta shes bya don gnyer bya bzhin pa'i nga tsho lo chung rnams dang bsdur na/shes yon can du 'gyur rung gi cha rkyen ha cang tshad mtho gi ci'i phyir de ltar mtho gi zer na/ khong tsho tshang ma rang rang gi ched las kyi rigs su gyur pa de'i cha nas rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi dang shes bya'i sgrig gzhi/bsam gzhig gi blo nus sogs phun sum tshogs shing gra rgyas po yod gikhong tshos rang nyid kyi chags sa rten sa ste/ shes bya dang mi gzhi la rkang btsugs te spyi tshogs dkyil snying du 'chang bzhin sems khral gyi 'du shes yod pa'i ngos nas 'greng thub rgyu na/ yang na/ khong tsho ni dbang grags nyis 'dzoms yin pas 'dam ga'i 'dem bya ma nor bar 'di'i thad la bsam gzhig 'khor rgyu na/ re ba chen po yod gi bsam/da 120 da

nga tsho'i‘‘shes yon ca ’’ re ded/mdor na/ nga tsho la lo rgyus su gyur zin pa'i‘‘shes yon can’’gyi gras su bgrang rung ba'am 'os pa ni dge chos dang rang grol gnyis ma gtogs med gi lo rgyus su ma gyur par da lta dngos su gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'am 'gyur rung gi mtshams 'di nas‘‘shes yon can’’de ci 'dra zhig yin dgos tshul la/ ngas kyang rang tshod kyis bsam gzhig btang nas rang gi lta tshul brjod pa yin pas de la ma 'grig sa dang / ma 'dang sa/ma 'khyongs sa gang mang yod nges/ do dgong gi gleng slong ba'i gtam 'di nas mtshams 'jog zhol nas tshang mas bgro gleng dang rtsad bsdur byed rgyu nga'i re ba yin/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)dri ba dris lan/ngag dri/ ‘‘shes yon can’’gyi tshad gzhi la ci zhig 'jog bzhin yod zer na/dge chos dang don grub rgyal gnyis bzhag yod/ gal te khong gnyis‘‘shes yon can’’gyi mtshon bya ru bzhag btang na/ khyod kyis de la mtshan nyid gsal thag chod pa zhig ma bzhag thal/ der 'di gnyis las gzhan kha sang de ring gi shes yon can la mtshan nyid ga 'dra zhig dgos/ gzhan kha sang de ring gi shes yon can dang sngon chad kyi mkhas pa gnyis la khrad par ci zhig yod/ sa skya bla mas mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin shes pa yin par 'dod/ /bye brag sbyang ba'i don shes pa/ /de nyid de la mkhas pa yin/ /’’zhes gsungs yod na/ mi 'dra sa dang mi mthun sa ci zhig yod/ mtshan nyid 'jog stangs la khud par e yod/— 121 —

sems la sbyo/ 'pho nyul/lan/ ya/ bka' drin che/ gong nas ngas thog mar‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa'i ming brda de'i mched khungs la gsal bshad thung ngu byed dgos don yang / ci zhig yin zer na/ ming brda de ni rnying pa zhig ma yin par gsar byung zhig yin pas red/ bod rang la mtshon na/der cha rkyen ga 'dra tshang dgos don dang ci 'dra zhig yin pa la/ ‘‘nga tsho'i‘shes yon can’ga re red’’ces pa'i dri ba ltar rang gis rang la 'dri tshig bton nas rgyus lon dang zhib 'jug sngog 'don gyi sta gon nam gra sgrig byed sgang du yod/ de bas/ khos dris pa ltar/ shes yon can zhes pa la da lta cha rkyen ga 'dra tshang dgos sam/ da lta'i shes yon can ga re red ces pa la/ ngas gong nas mkhas dbang dge chos nas rang grol/ de nas da snga'i gnas bab bcas rabs gsum dang rim pa gsum po'i khyad chos nyung bsdus bshad zin na'ang / lhag tu go bde ched mdor dril na/ nga tshos nges par du nges bya ni dge chos kyi rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs dang / rang grol gyi mi mang sad rtogs 'byung dgos par bskul ba'i blo 'byed kyi snying stobs/ da snga ni rang gis rang la tshang rtsis dang rtsis bsher/ gtsang sbra byas te‘‘bdag’’gi 'jon thang dang go gnas gtan 'khel bya dgos par 'dod pa'i‘‘rang nyid nas 'go rtsom pa'i’’snying stobs de'o/ /de bzhin du 'di tshang ma'i chags sa rten sa ni‘‘mi tshul’’zhes pa nyag gcig red/ de bas/ da — 122 —

nga cho'i‘‘rīs yon can’’ re red/snga'i shes yon can gyi tshad gzhi de yang ci 'dra zhig yin pa shes thub/gzhan sngon chad kyi mkhas pa dang da snga'i shes yon can gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ sngon chad kyi mkhas pa yin na'ang chog gi da snga'i shes yon can yin na'ang chog gi thun mong gi cha ni gnyis ka shes bya don gnyer mkhan yin pa dang / rig gnas pa yin pa de red/ yin yang shes bya'i mnga' khongs kyi thad nas mkhas pa ni spyi dang shes yon can ni bye brag la 'jug pa'i he bag yod gi shes yon can gyis 'jig rten gyi mi bu yan gar ba re re nas sems khral gyi 'du shes bla lhag gis 'ching bar/re zhig spyi tshogs las ring du gyes pa ltar snang yang phyir dogs slong dang dag ga sgrub kyis spyi tshogs de 'thus tshang du gtong bar mngon/ mkhas pas ni rig sanas sbyang zin yang phyir rig gnas la zhabs 'degs zhu ba las dngos yod spyi tshogs la mthong chen rang mi byed/ sa paṇa bla ma'i mkhas pa'i go lugs sam go stobs de las nga tshos ci zhig rnyed thub gi zer na/ dogs slong zhes pa de'o/ /des na/ sngon byon mkhas pa so so nas dngos yod spyi tshogs dang 'brel nas/ ‘‘mkhas pa’’lta bus mtshon pa'i tha snyad dang rig gnas snang tshul ya ma brla la dogs slong dang mtha' dpyod kyis zhun mthar brdar yod gyi na/ yod tshad bstan bcos gzhung lugs la bstun pa'i srol rgyun rgyud ngan de ldog tshod du snang yod snyam/ de bas/ de gnyis kyi khyad par gyi 'gag rtsa yang zhabs — 123 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/'degs zhu yul dang rkang rten 'cha' sa'i 'jon thang mngon lugs kyi thad na yod par 'dod/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)ngag dri/ nga cho'i shes yon can la/ dge chos dang rang grol gnyis gleng bzhin 'dug de gnyis la yin pa'i rgyu rkyen du khong rnam pa gnyis kyi brtsams chos kyi thad nas mang po zhig sgrub byed du 'god bzhin bshad kyin 'dug 'o na/shes yon can zhes pa de rig gnas sna chogs pa'i steng nas 'jog dgos ni zhig e red/ yin na/ nga cho bod la de las gzhan pa'i lag rtsal yin na 'dra/ gso rig yin na 'dra/ de'i thad nas shes yon can byung e myong zig(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)lan/ rig gnas la sna mang bas tshan khag gzhan pa nas bod rang la‘‘shes yon can’’byung e myong zer ba la/ bod rang gi lo rgyus khrod kyi mdzangs mi mi bdun dang g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/ sa paṇa sogs bgrang rgyu na ci 'dra yin nam snyam/ de dag gi lo rgyus gsal po yod gyi na nga tshos shes nus mod/ 'on kyang rags rim thor bu tsam las med pas dbye gcod byed dka'/ gang ltar nub gling la mtshon na yang /shes yon can gyi lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim khrod nas mkhas dbang so sos go don 'jog tshul dang mtshan gzhi bgrang tshul/ rigs dbye bgar tshul la phyogs/ mang po 'dug 'on kyang bod rang la mtshon na/ da so ma de'i phyogs la mnyam 'jog gi mig zung 'gul bzhin yod pas/ nya — 124 —

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ga re red/nyung mi bsres pa dang thog ma'i go don dang tshad gzhi la ngos 'dzin gsal po yong ched/ ming brda de'i thog ma'i nang don la gzhigs nas da gzod mkhas dbang de gnyis gleng ba yin/ de ma gtogs/ shes yon can gyi lo rgyus zhes pa zhig rtsom pa'i dbang du btang na/ lo rgyus khrod kyi mi sna grags can dang rig gnas pa re re nas snang med du bskyur mi nyan par/ de dag gi gsung rtsom dang rnam thar la zhib dpyod kyis‘‘mi tshul’’kyi cha nas gsed 'grol bya thub rgyu na bzang snyam/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)yig dri/ mkhas dbang che tan zhabs drung dang a khu dmu dge a lags dor zhe sogs ni shes yon can min nam/ rgya skad kyi:spokāya〉ca zhes pa de bsgrur pa ci yin/lan/ 'o le/ 'di ltar bshad yong na/ phog thug mang po zhig btang yod gi ci'i phyir btang yod gi zer na/ dge chos nas rang grol bar dang lhag tu da snga'i bar du stong cha mang po zhig bzhag yod gibar glags ring bo zhig bskyur dang zig a lags tshe tan zhabs drung tshang / a khu dmu dge tshang / a khu bsam 'grub rgya mtsho tshang a lags dung dkar tshang sogs mang po zhig snang med du bzhag nas/tag tag rang grol nas gleng ba red/ 'di 'dra'i stong cha zhig 'jog dgos don ci yin zer na/ khong tsho tshang ma mkhas dbang e red zer — 125 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/na/ mkhas dbang red/ bla na med pa/ mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin ni red/ lo rgyus kyis bslangs pa'i ku re'i dbang gis khong tshos ni lo ngo bcu'i‘‘rig gsar’’skabs kyi dmyal sdug mnar med de myangs nas yong ba ma zad/ mi rigs dang rig gnas sogs la sna sgo mo kun nas god chag dang gyong gud thebs bzhin pa la yang spyan zung gis gzigs kyin gzigs kyin phebs yong ba red/ de nas lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung srid jus je yag la song bas/ khong tshos‘‘rig gsar’’skabs su nyams nyes tshabs chen byung yod pa'i rang rigs kyi rig gnas de nyams gso dang kha gsab byas/ gzhan rig gnas kyi rjes 'brangs pa mang po zhig bskyangs pas/ rig gnas dar spel dang / rig gnas khyab brdal/ rig gnas rgyun 'dzin gyi ngos na mdzad rjes bla med bzhag yod/ 'di ni nga tshos nges par du bkur bya dang rjes su yi rang gi gnas yin/ yang gcig bshad na/ mkhas dbang la 'gan 'khri yod pa'i cha de'ang 'di'i thad nas bla med du mngon yod 'dod/de bzhin du/ da snga'ang sku bzhugs gnang yod pa'i chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs tshang / 'ba' ba phun tshogs dbang rgyal tshang / nam mkha'i nor bu tshang / mkhar rme'u bsam gtan tshang / a lags dor zhi tshang sogs rgan gras tsho dang / gzhan dar ma dang gzhon rabs pa'i gras su'ang rang rang gi rig tshan de la byang chub pa'i mkhas pa'ang rab — 126 —

nga cho'i‘‘shes yon can’’ re red/tu mang ste/ ched mkhas pa dang / dge rgan chen mo pa/ lo tsā pa/slob gso rig pa ba/ rtsom sgrig pa/ gsar 'god pa/ rtsom mkhan/sgyu rtsal pa sogs mang ngo / / 'di kun po rang rang gi las ka'i gnyer phyogs kyi rig tshan gyi dbang gis de la shin tu mkhas par 'dug der phun dbang gis gtam 'di 'dra zhig gsung myong ste/ ‘‘nga la mtshon na/bod rig pa mi shes rung / mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan dga' zhig yin/’’zhes pa ltar ro/ /zhib tu shes 'dod na/ sku zhabs me lce'i〈gzur med kyi 'gan 'khri〉la blta bar bya/ de na gsal kha byas 'dug 'o na/khong tsho la ci zhig chad song ba red zer na/ shes yon can la nges par du 'dzoms dgos pa'i gcig gyur gzhi mthun gyi thob rtags te/ sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi/ rigs rtog gi tshor skyen/ drang bden gyi 'du shes/spyi tshogs dgag sgrub kyi spobs pa bcas las mngon pa'i snying stobs kyi zil ngar dben pas red/ de las kyang je gsal la btang na/ rig gnas dang mi rigs de gnad don can du ma mthong ba dang blta ma thub pa'am/ yang na mthong yod kyang bshad pa'i snying stobs med pas lan stumim/‘‘shes yon can’’zhes pa de ni rgya skad kyiṣ+ṭha/ya〉cha zhes pa de tshur bsgyur pa ngo ma red/ de la dogs pa med gi yin yang de ltar bsgyur pa ci yin zer na/ sku zhabs zhogs dung gi〈dogs slong snying stobs〉na ge 127 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/gsal po dag po byas yod gi da ngas 'or bshad mi byed/ de las kyang khos bshad pa ltar/ ming brda rnying pa mang ba zhig la phyir srog gsar pa zhugs su 'jug dgos/ zer ba bzhin mdor dril na skad cha de kho na'i steng nas shes thub/ gzhan ming brda de tshur bsgyur pa la yang khong rang nyid kho na'i rang snang gang shar dang 'ol tshod bsam tshod ma yin te/ 〈bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo〉dang〈rgya bod shan sbyar tshig mdzod〉na de ltar bsgyur 'dug gal te mig la ma ran pa dang 'gyur skyon du bsam pa 'dra yin na/ 'di ltar bshad du yod de/ gcig nas bsgyur yig tshad ldan dang bstun pa/ gnyis su go log tu mi 'gro bar myur mor khyab brdal thub pa/ gsum du ming brda gzhan pas mtshon pa'i rig gnas de la phog thug mi gtong phyir ro/ /ngag dri/ shes yon can gyi go don dang tshad gzhi ga 'dra red/ de la cha rkyen med song che byis pa lo lnga drug can yang shes yon can red/ rgyu mtshan ni kho la'ang rang gi chod kyi shes bya yod la bsam pa'i go rtogs shig kyang yod pas red/(nyan po'i thal mo deb sgra)lan/ shes yon can gyi go don dang tshad gzhi ga 'dra la 'jog zer bar/ spyir go don zhig 'jog pa'i tshad la thon yod dus/ mi sna de la rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi dang shes bya yi sgrig gzhi/ bsam gzhig gi nus pa/ bsam pa'i go rtogs sogs phyogs mang po nas tshad nges can la — 128 —

nga tsho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ re ded/thon dgos gi nga rang nyid la de dag gang gi thad nas kyang bla lhag gis zhan/ yin yang / 'di 'dra zhig gleng dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zer na/ ngas gong nas bshad zin ltar/ bod rang gis da so ma shes yon can nyid zhib 'jug bya gzhir bzung nas sngog 'don byed bzhin yod pas/ go don zhig 'jog na/ cha rkyen zhig bgrang na/tshad gzhi zhig bzo na/ tshod tshod la mi nus par/ ngas rabs gsum dang rim pa gsum du dbye nas de'i lo rgyus brgyud rim la zhib bsher dang phyir blta yi tshul du gleng ba yin/ de nas tshad gzhi'i thad nas/sku zhabs zhogs dung gis sgra yangs 'jug gi gsum dang dog 'jug gi lnga bcas kyi sgo nas gleng yod nga/ red/ da snga tshad thig de 'dra zhig 'dang 'gro zer nas bshad dka' gi 'dang yod zer nas kyang bshad dka' gi gang ltar/ nga tsho tshang mas tshad thig de lta bu la thon par re snyeg dang phugs 'dun bcings dgos gi tshad der thon mi thon gzhan zhig red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)ngag dri/ khrod kyis da ci gong nas shes yon can gyi mtshan nyid zer na'ang chog go don zer na'ang chog de 'jog dus thog mar gang la bzhag dang thal zer na/ phyi gling pa'i mtshan nyid bzhag thal/ yu ru su dang h+pha ran si bzhag thal/ ngas bltas na/ bod rang la shes yon can zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di thad kar du med pa ma gtogs/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa phal cher de dang cha 'dra ba red/ de ge 129 ge

thesdesbubabasdo zugi 3) shun21 sdonazugi/gtso bo ngas gang la dmigs nas bshad ni yin zer na/ mtshan gzhi zhig bzhag na/ dper na sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan lta bu red/ khyod kyis da ci go don nags bsdus bshad dus/ cha rkyen gsum bshad dang thal/ gcig spyi chogs la do khur byed pa/ gnyis/ dgag sgrub kyi cha yod pa/ /gsum/ gsar gtod kyi cha yod pa'o/ /sa paṇa la phal cher de gsum po tshang gi gal te khrod kyis spyi chogs la do khur byed kyin med zer na/ bod khri skor bcu gsum la dmar po khrag gi mtsho bskyil du ma bzhag par zhi bde'i lam la 'gro bar byas pa ni phal cher spyi tshogs kyi mi mang la do khur byas ni yin rgyu red pa/ gal te khyod kyis dgag sgrub kyi cha med gi zer na/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi ngos nas khong gis phyi rol mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo dgag nas nang pa'i chos 'og tu bcug pa dang / de'i phan chad nas khrod kyis gsar gtod kyi cha med gi zer na/ rig gnas chung ba lnga bo'i rnam gzhag 'di sa paṇa yan chad la phal chen med gi yod na yang / dpe'i sgo nas bshad na/ mdzub gu lnga bo nang gi mdzub gu gcig tshang med pa lta bu red/de las gtso bo snang tshul ci zhig mthong thub gi zer na/ nga cho'i 'du shes kyi ngos na/phyi gling pa'i de ded zer na/ gsar pa zhig dang / bod rang gi ngos nas cig gleng na/ 'dra med pa ltar du chags 'dug gal te de ltar bzhag pa min zer na/ parnyi ta zhes pa la phal cher cha rkyen de dag yongs su tshang ba red/(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)lan/ bka' drin shin tu che/ nga tshos 'di ltar gcig gis gcig gi mi 'dang sa kha gsab dang zhan cha dkar 'don byed pa dang /— 130 —

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ re red/'dang ba la de las lhag pa'i kha snon gyi lta tshul brjod na/ nga tshor phyogs gang thad nas blo skyed re 'byung nges/ yang gcig bshad na/'di ni bgro gleng gi dmigs bya dang re snyeg red/ rang rang gi blta yul dang 'brel 'dris byed sa la tshad bkag nges can yod pas/ zhan cha mi nyung ba re 'byung nges/ de bzhin du nga rang nyid la yang zhan cha yod pa bshad ma dgos pa red/ gong nas khos bshad pa ltar/ paṇ+ḍi ta la shes yon can gyi cha rkyen dag tshang gi tshang ni mi tshad lung dang rigs pas sgrub dang zig des na/ shes yon can zhes pa ni don du dgos med don gzhan gyi lhag ma zhig ma yin nam zhes pa zhig dang /gzhan bod rang la paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i tha snyad yod bzhin du nub gling pa'i de bsgyur zhing spyod dgos don ga re red ces pa'i phugs bstan zhig yod gi 'o ya/ de ltar bshad na/ bar 'di na 'gal zla zhig yod gi'agal zla de yang rang ga ba zhig ma yin par ha cang gi chen po zhig red/paṇ+ḍi ta la shes yon can gyi cha rkyen tshang bzhin du de ltar bsgyur 'dren byed dgos don dang / bod rang la de'i thad kyi ming brda yo/da bzhin du gzhan gyi de khyer yong nas spyod dgos don sogs gnad don mang po zhig bar med du thon dang zig yin yang nga tsho'i bag chags spyir btang ba zhig gi ngos nas phyir paṇ+ḍi ta la 'dang brgyab na/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa la cha rkyen shin tu mthon po zhig dgos gi rig gnas sna lnga bo — 131 ge

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/de la mkhas song na/ da gzod paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i cho lo bstsol pa red/de bas sa paṇa la yang de ltar cho lo gnang ba ma gtogs sna gcig la mkhas pa'i cha nas bzhag pa ma red/ shes yon can zer ba ni yin gcig min gnyis rig gnas pa zhig yin dgos rung / cha yongs su nas rig gnas gang la yang mkhas shing / gang gi thad nas kyang bshad thub pa de 'dra zhig yin dgos pa'i nges pa med gi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rig gnas sna gcig shes/ shes pa'i ngang nas mi mang la gdung sems dang sems khur gyis spyi tshogs la dgag sgrub byed pa'i rgyu 'bras blo mig gi cha can no/ /rig gnas kyi ngos thad nas de gnyis la spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par yod par 'dod/ drang mor bshad na/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i tha snyad de yang bod rang gi ming brda zhig ma red/ gzhan paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i go don dang tshad gzhi ni gna' snga mo nas gtan la phab zin pa dang grub zin pa tsam du ma zad/ bod mi'i bag chags kyi ngos la gshags zin pa red/ dper na/ dge chos lta bu la cho lo de rtsod med du bstsal na chog pa yin gyi/ mkhas dbang rang grol la e chog gam/ de las kyang da lta'i dus 'dir de ltar sbyar na 'os 'tsham e yin nam/ de'i rkyen gang la thug yod dam/ tag tag bod rang gi srol rgyun gyi rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas min gyi cha e red/ yin na/srol rgyun rig gnas kyi thad nas phyi logs phyi logs de snga logs snga — 132 —

ra cho'i‘ sa yon can’’ re red/logs su mi 'gro ba'i rkyen yang de red/ de bas/ shes yon can zhes pa ched du bsgyur 'dren gyis bkol spyod byed don yang / gcig tu go log tu mi 'gro ba dang / gnyis su khyab sgrog byed bde ba/ gsum du tha snyad 'thus je tshang la gtong ba/ bzhi ru phog thug mi bzo ba'o/ /rnam pa gzhan gyi sgo nas kha je gsal la btang na/ dus rabs dang mthun pa'i gtam smra dgos zhes pa dang skad cha bshad dgos zhes pa'ang mdor gtugs na der thug yod snyam/ der phyi gling pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan we thi rjan si tenarjogyis 'di ltar bshad yod de/ ‘‘ming tshig cig gi nang don ngo ma de tag tag skad cha'i khor yug gam gnas bab bye brag pa'i khrod nas da gzod mngon thub’’ces pa'o/ /(nyan po'i thal mo rdob sgra)slob grogs ka pa/ do dgong gi‘‘nga cho'i‘shes yon can’ga de red’’dang 'brel nas slob grogs mang po zhig gis rang rang gi lta tshul brjod bzhin 'dugalo rgyus su gyur zin pa'i shes yon can dang lo rgyus su ma gyun pa'i shes yon can yin na chog gi slob grogs tshos do dgong mi sna gang mang la dbye ba byed stangs kyi thog na gnad don ci zhig yod gi zen na/ nga'i go ba len tshul zhig la/ gtam bshad pas bshad bzhin pa ni mi tshul rig gnas srog shing du bzung ba'i mi sna rkyang nyid rilha pa spyizlonardza ṭ+wāṃdz+rī gardosna/ tshisnya sdir+sha7 patha malharno/rduthakhukauni /rda tram̐~Xshādzhaikau k+to ram̐lha /gli 8shādru shān+diyi preshā rno/ khru rib byinā shāṭ+wān 〈mtshan nyad rag pakrā 'ab 'jug/〉spugs 'dug da 133 da

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/rkyang red 'dod gi slob grogs chos gleng bzhin pa ni chos lugs rig gnas srog shing du bzung ba'i mi sna red snyam/ de bas mi sna 'di dag gi lo rgyus 'phel rim dang phyogs gang thad nas go ba len tshul gtan nas mi 'dra gi de'i rgyu mtshan gyis deng sang shes yon can zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di sbyar na 'grig gi 'dod/ nga'i bsam tshul de 'dra yin/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)ngag dri/ shes yon can zhes pa'i thad nas gsar gtod kyi cha dang /dogs slong gi cha/ dgag sgrub kyi cha sogs bshad dang thal/ nga rang gis bsam na/ dgag sgrub kyi cha 'di gtso bo zhig yin pa red/ gong nas khrod kyis dge chos dang rang grol gnyis kyi 'dra sa ni dogs slong dang gsar gtod kyi cha dang mi 'dra sa ni dgag sgrub kyi cha red zer/ gzhan dge chos kyis phyi gling pa'i rig gnas la 'brel 'dris byas cha nas dgag sgrub kyi bsam blo 'khrungs pa red zer/'o na/ bod rang la yin min gtan la 'bab byed kyi lung dang rigs pa'i gtan chigs kyi rig pa yod bzhin du ci'i phyir phyi rgyal gyi bsam blo de dang du blangs pa red/bod rang gi rig gnas las bsam blo de lag tu ma chud par phyi rgyal nas lag tu chud song na/ phyi rgyal gyi rig gnas gang zhig yin pa gsal por bshad rogs/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdob sgra)lan/ bod rang la mtshan nyid rig pa dang tshad ma rig pa'i ngos de na dgag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag de 'dra'i cha tshang zhing 'thus legs pa dang /tshags dam pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rig tshan sgul mi thub pa zhig yod bzhin du/ dge chos nas nub gling gi bsam blo de dang len byed rkyen ga re — 134 —
