nga tsho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ga re red/red zer/ dge chos kyis tshad ma'i gzhung la thos pa don gnyer byed dus/ khong gi blo rig shin tu rno ba de tshang mas go myong yod ni red/tag tag nub gling gi de dang len byed rkyen yang / gong nas slob grogs shig gis bshad dang thal/ mi tshul zer ba de red/ mthar gtugs na/ gnyis ka'i 'bab gzhi ma 'dra bas red/ phyi gling pa'i dgag sgrub de mi tshul gyi cha dang / bod rang gi tshad ma'i dgag sgrub de rig pa mnyes byed yin zer rung / don du chos lugs rtogs byed kyi lag cha red/ de 'dra zhig red/ de ma gtogs khong gis nub gling pa'i mi tshul skor gyi brtsams chos gang la mjal bar da snga'i bar du nyid kyi gsung rtsom dang rnam thar gang na'ang bshad du med snyam/(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)ngag dri/ khyod kyis gong nas paṇ+ḍi ta dang shes yon can gnyis mi gcig gi zer/ paṇ+ḍi ta ni rig gnas sna lnga la mkhas pa'i cha nas 'jog gi shes yon can ni rig gnas sna gcig la mkhas pa dang de'i thog dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs dang / dogs slong gi snying stobs/ mi mang la sha tsha ba sogs cha du ma zhig nas 'jog gi de yin na/ phun chogs dbang rgyal gyis zla ba'i go la steng na gsher gzugs yod par bsgrubs pa la/ rig gnas chig rkyang ba zhig gi ngos nas tsham/ rig gis sgrub mi thub pa bsgrubs dang zig 'di la cha rkyen ci zhig tshang gi zer na/zla ba'i go la steng na gsher gzugs yod par dogs slong byas yod gi sngon chad — 135 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/kyi gsher gzugs mi ldan zhes pa'i lta ba la dgag nas rang gis rigs dpyad kyis yod par bsgrubs yod gi 'di shes yon can la bgrang na e 'grig gam/ da dung khyod kyis shes yon can zer ba de mi chul rig gnas kyi steng na 'jog god gilha chos rig gnas kyi steng na 'jog gi med gi nga'i bsam tshul yin na/ bod kyi rig gnas zer dus/ mi tshul kho na ma yin par lha chos kyang 'dus pas/ lha chos rig gnas kyi steng nas kyang shes yon can bzhag na 'grig gi bsam/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdob sgra)lan/ 'o ya/ 'di la mtshon na/ ngas gdeng tshod yod pa'i sgo nas shes yon can gyi gras su ma bzhag la/ tag tag khong tshang gis rang gis rang la gnas mal gtan 'khel byas yod pa lta bu'i‘‘skad cha tsam po ba’’des 'thus par byas yod/ nga'i dbye gcod 'di 'grig na chog gi ma 'grig na chog gi gang ltar nga tshos khong gi sku tshe la rgyus lon byas pa mi 'dang ste/ 〈rtsod sgrub rig pa〉dang〈zla ba'i go la'i steng na gsher gzugs yod med〉kyi ljags rtsom re zung las med/ de ltar bshad yong na/ shes yon can gyi mi tshe de skyo gar can zhig yin dgos gi skyo gar de'i khrod nas kho rang bag la zha nas 'khos chung du mi 'gyur bar/ de'i khrod nas rang nyid la ngos zin yang dag bgyis nas rang gi shes yon dang rang gi 'gan 'khri'i 'jon thang la yin 'jog gis rang nyid las brgal ba'i‘‘bdag’’cig rnyed yod par 'dod/ yin — 136 —

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ga ge red/yang / 'di ltar bshad pa'i khrod nas 'dang zhig brgyab na/ phun dbang 'di la khyad par can gyi dmigs bsal zhig yod par bsam/na ning gi spyi zla bcu par khong gis rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin la springs pa'i 'phrin yig de red/ de ltar rang gi shes yon dang blo rig la brten nas dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi phyogs gang la'ang sman pa'i gtam brjod gnang ba yin na/ rngo mi thogs pa ci yang med de/ dbang grags nyis 'dzoms yin pas so/ / gzhan da dung shes yon can du'ang mi 'gyur grang / lar mkhas dbang zhig yin na/ rig gnas shes bya de dang len byed rgyu kho na ma red/ da dung de phyir 'don yang bya dgos/ 'di ni mkhas dbang zhig gi bshol du med pa'i 'gan 'khri red la/ rig gnas la do khur byed tshul gyi mngon stangs shig kyang red/shes yon can zhes pa 'di yang gong nas bshad pa ltar/ skad cha'i gnas bab nges can la bstun nas bshad pa yin gyi/ de ma gtogs nub gling par mtshon na'ang / de'i yar mtha' la khungs snyeg bya bzhin yod de/ 'gro ba mi la mtshon na/ mi ma yin pa las mi ru gyur/ de nas lha mo pra gsum byung / de nas chos lugs pa byung b.rani/kho tshos 'di ltar ngos 'dzin byed bzhin 'dug lha mo pra gsum ni shes yon can la 'gyur rung gi rnam pa dang chos lugs pa ni gyur zin pa'i thog ma'i rnam pa la 'jog ci'i phyir zhe na/ de kun po shes bya don — 137 —

sems la ji) 'a21 nyul/gnyer mkhan yin pas red/ 'on kyang deng rabs kyi don snying dang ldan pa'i mi tshul kyi shes yon can du mi 'jog pa red/ gal te/ shes yon can gyi lo rgyus shig 'bri ba'i dbang du btang na/ khong tsho ni gtan nas btang snyoms su bskyur mi 'os te/ shes yon can ni rig gnas dang 'brel la/ rig gnas de yang yi ge la 'brel bas/ shes yon can gyi ya mtha' yi ge'i byung ba la thug yod pa red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)ngag dri/ spyir na/ spyi chogs kyi rgyab ljongs yin na'ang 'dra/ khor yug yin na'ang 'dra/ gnas bab ma 'dra ba'i dbang gis shes yon can la tshad thig 'dzin stangs yang mi 'dra bar 'dod/ phyi gling pas de ltar lab kyi yod na/bod nang gis kyang de ltar lab na 'grig ni zhig e yin nam/ dper na/ nub gling pas smad g.yogs(lkocha)gon bzhin yod par mdo dbus mtho sgang nas smad g.yogs gon na e chog gi 'u cho mi rigs 'di'i rig gnas su mi tshul bsam blo la lha chos bsam blo mi 'dres zer na/ ngas bltas na bshad dka' mo red/ (dgod sgra)lan/ mi tshul la lha chos 'dres yod med kyi thad nas dge chos lags kyis 'di ltar gsungs yod ni red/ ci ltar dngos po'i gshis la nye gyur na/ /de ltar mkhas pa'i ngag ni lkugs par 'gyur/ /des na/'di cog tse red/ kan rkub stegs red ces mdzub mo bker nas bshad sa 'gro ni zhig yin ni ma red/ gang la'ang gting mthar thug pa — 138 —

nga cho'i‘‘ sa yon can’’ re red/zhig btsal du med/ tag tag shes par bya ba'i gnas tshang ma don spyi dang 'du shes kyi ngos na yod pas red/ yang gcig bshad na/shugs che chung dang nus pa 'don stangs kyi thad nas dbye bar 'dod/lha chos kyi gnyer bya gtso ba ni tshe phyi ma'am 'jig rten pha rol zhig red/mi tshul gyi gnyer bya ni tshe phyi ma ma yin pa'i 'jig rten 'di red/ lha chos kyis mi bu lag char bsam yod/ mi tshul gyis mi bu dkyil snying du 'dod yod/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdob sgra)slob grogs kha pa/ shes yon can zhes pa'i thad la gong nas mang po bshad dang thal/ gtso bo tha snyad de'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan gzhi 'jog tshul gyi thad nas rtsod pa mang po 'bud bzhin 'dug khrod rang gi 'dod pa'i dbang gis dge chos dang rang grol gnyis bzhag zig de dang bstun nas slob grogs gzhan gyis phun dbang la sogs mang po drangs thal/ des na/ nga'i 'dod pa'i dbang gis srol rgyun gyi shes yon can dang deng rabs kyi shes yon can zhes mang po zhig bzhag chog gi 'dod/ srol rgyun gyi dbang du btang na/ sa paṇa bzhag chog gi/ deng rabs kyi dbang du btang na/ a lags dung dkar lta bu rded/ khong gi chos srid zung 'brel gyi skor dang dkar chag rig pa/ slob gso rig pa/ de'i gzhug gi〈dung dkar tshig mdzod〉sogs la snga na med pa'i gsar gtod kyi cha mang po zhig yod gid dung dgag sgrub kyi cha nas/ ‘‘rig gsar’’gyi snga gzhug tu rgya nag pas bod rang gi brda sprod kyi rnam gzhag la do snang ma byas par gang 'dod du sbyar na/ khong tshang gis der dgag sgrub tsha nan btang ba red/ de bas rig gnas kyi ched du zer — 139 —

sems la 3) 'apo nyul/na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs kyi ched du zer na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar rig gnas kyi zhabs 'degs zhu yul mi rigs yin pas/ nyams pa slar gso dang / ma nyams gong spel la mdzad rjes bla med bzhag 'dug gal te/ khrod kyis shes yon can gyi tshad gzhi zhig 'jog rgyu yin zer na/ gna' deng gi mkhas pa yod tshad la rgyus lon zhig byed dgos gi dper na/ 'athrang bu'i‘‘bsam blo pa chen po bcu’’zhes pa lta bu red/ de bzhin du/ mkhas pa la spyi bye gnyis kyi mkhas pa yod na/shes yon can la yang de ltar gnyis su dbye na chog par 'dod/ sku zhabs zhogs dung la sogs pas yon tan pa dang shes yon can gnyis kyi thad du mang po gleng nas dbye ba bkar yod gi de dbye ba bkar chog chog red/ yin yang / shes yon can dang mkhas pa gnyis ka so sor dbye dka' gi phal cher don 'dra gi de dang mthun par parnyi ta zhes pa yang rgya gar gyi skad yin pa ma gtogs/ bod skad du bsgrur na mkhas pa red/ de gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs tsam red/de bas/ mkhas pa dang shes yon can zhes pa yang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs red/ de'i man chad nas khrod kyis lha chos kyi gnyer bya gtso bo thar ba red zer/'o na/ lha chos de la skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum bshad yod ga skyes bu chung ngu'i nang du 'khor ba bshad kyi 'dug 'khor ba ji ltar skyong dgos chul bshad kyi 'dug de las rim pa gong ma gong mar 'phags nas skyes bu chen po la thon dus da gzod thar ba bshad kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ chung ngu'i dus na med/ de bas/mi chul nang na gtso bo lha chos yod gi mdor na/ shes yon can la bgrang rgyu'i tshad gzhi de yang cung dka' khag che gi bsam/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)da 140 da

nga cho'i‘ sa yon can’’ re red/slob grogs ga pa/ do dgong gi 'di rang mos gleng stegs red/ de bas rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar bshad na chog gi nga'i bsam tshul yin na/ 'di gnyis kha kher byas pa shin tu 'grig par 'dod/ gong gi gzhan dag shes yon can gyi gras su mi bgrang ba rgyu mtshan ci'i thog nas shes thub zer na/ de snga sku zhabs zhogs dung sogs kyis bshad myong la/ da thengs gtam bshad pas kyang bshad kyin 'dug gtso bo tha snyad de la srog gsar pa zhugs pa de'i thad nas 'dang rgyag dgos gi thog mar gom pa spo sa yang tha snyad la srog gsar pa zhugs pa de red/ khyod cho tshang mas ci zhig zer bzhin yod zen na / paṇ+ḍi ta dang mkhas pa sogs tshang ma de dang 'dra gi zer/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang mkhas pa sogs rig pa'i gnas la ji ltar mkhas na yang khong cho'i klad pa'i nang na ci zhig yod gi zer na/sangs rgyas zer ba de red/ 'o na/ ngas ci'i phyir ming brda 'di la srog gsar pa zhugs yod pa red zer na/ 'di'i nang nas‘‘nga mi yin’’dang‘‘nga mi ji ltar bca' rgyu yin’’pa de ded/ der ma zad kho chos‘‘mi’’zhes pa'i mthar thug gi dmigs bya yang rnyed byung ba red/ de bas nga cho'i gom pa spo chul mi 'grog gi bsam/ ( nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs nga pa/ lha chos dang mi tshul so sor rang rang gi shes yon cam yod par 'dod/ (dgod sgra) rang nyid la tha snyad yod bzhin du gzhan gyi de bkol dgos don e yod/ rang la a myes yod bzhin du gzhan gyi a myes de mkho don e yod/ phyi rgyal gyi mkhas pa zhig gis gsungs yod ga ‘‘khyod kyi lta chul der nga rang nyid mi 'thad rung / khyod kyis lta tshul 'don chog pa'i dbang cha der nga rang — 1‘11 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/gi gces pa'i srog gis kyang srung skyob bya nges’’zer ba ltar/ do dgong nga rang gi lta tshul tsam bton pa yin/ (nyan po'i thal mo deb sgra)shin tu bzang gi nga rang nyid la mtshon na yang / da thengs kyi gza' 'khor 'di'i nang rang gis gra sgrig tsam byas/ 'dang rgyag khul byas/ der kha byang 'dogs lugs kyi thad nas skrag snang ha cang chen po zhig skyes bzhin btags pa yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes yon can zhes gleng tshe/ 'gal zla mang po zhig 'byung rgyu red snyam pa'i tshor snang byin thal/ de ltar byin pas ngas phyir 'khor nas‘‘nga tsho'i ‘shes yon can’ ga re red’’ces pa'i 'dri tshig cig gi zol du kha byang la bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi don rtsa yang de yin/ dus mtshungs su phog thug kyang mang po zhig bzo rgyu red/ bshad bzhin pa'i sgang der mi 'dang sa mang po zhig yod gyi red/ 'dang rgyag phyogs kyi thad nas kyang slob grogs tsho dang mi mthun pa gang mang yod gyi red/ 'o ya/ de 'dra zhig gi ngang nas/ khyod tsho la bsam phyogs ci 'dra zhig yod snyam nas phyogs gnyis ka la 'dang rgyag rgyu'i bar glags shig bskyur pa'i khrod nas kha byang 'di lta bu bkod pa yin/ da do dgong nga rang gis spobs pa chen po zhig gi ngang nas 'khyongs ma 'khyongs kyis nyog bshad mang po bshad song /des na/ ‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’tshogs pas nga rang nyid la go skabs 'di 'dra'i dkon po zhig byin pa la bka' drin zhu/ chabs cig slob — 142 —

grogs tshos kyang rang rang gi dus tshod gser lta bu 'phro brlag tu btang nas do dgong 'dir mnyam 'dzoms byung ba la bka' drin shin tu che/de las kyang slob grogs tshos rang rang gi lta tshul brjod nas do dgong gi gleng stegs 'di bgro gleng 'khrug cha dod po zhig chags thub pa byung ba la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu/

sems la rgya 'pho nyul/nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho sna zin spu zin/6 29nyin/spyi lo2006lo'i zla6pa'i tshes29nyin gyi phyi dro'i dus tshod bzhi dang phyed ka'i steng nga tsho gna' mkhar zi ling nas stod nyi ma lha sar thad gtong yod pa'i rlangs 'khor la bsdad de grong khyer dang kha bral/rlangs 'khor de ni steng 'og yod pa'i mal khri can yin par khyon 'grul mi nyer drug dang kha lo pa gnyis bcas 'dug der bod mi skya ser gnyis ka dang mi rigs gzhan pa'ang 'dug nang du bdag dang yul phyogs gcig pa'i mjal skor pa rgan rgon bza' zla dgung lo drug cu yan zin pa zung las gzhan tshang ma dar ma dang gzhon pa red/ der rgan rgon zung dang khong gnyis khrid mkhan gyi grwa pa dang nga tsho kha brda yar mar sna dgu byas pa na/ mtshams shig nas rgan rgon gnyis gnyid lcog rgyag bzhin yod par kha brda yang rim gyis yal/ go skabs de dang bstun nas kho bo rlangs 'khor gyi mdun thad la song nas tsog ste rlangs 'khor gyi mdun shel chen mo las phyi rol la bltas pa yin/ lam gyi g.yas g.yon du zhing gi rnang ma'ang mi mthong bar ske tshe'i me tog ser gyi ler mngon la bag spro ba'i sems byung yang cig char 'byin/ da ni ri bo nyi — 144 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zi tho zin zin/zlar thon zin la sngo ljang ljang gi ri lung bar med du brkyangs yod/der 'byams klas pa'i rtswa thang mngon med du yod par zhib tu bltas na nye 'gram gyi rtswa sa la lcags ra bskor yod thog ljang mdog gis yug gcig tu bres pa ma yin par sngo ma skyar snang / gzhan mtshams mtshams su ske tshe'i zhing rgya chen po mthong du yod/ gnam ngo sprin nag gis g.yogs 'dug la sa rub par yang kha thag je nyer song ste mtsho sngon po'i rab kha la thon/ nye 'gram du ched du gnas skor ljongs rgyu pa'am spro gseng par gra sgrig byas pa'i ras gur chung ngu ri mos spa ba mang po yod par mi mang po mi snang bar kher gnyis re 'dug de nas mtsho 'gram ded nas yar song ba na ja yun tsam la char ba babs nas je 'khyag la song / rgyang ring la bltas na mtsho mtha' dang gnam mtha' 'dres nas skya nag tu mngon la nye 'khor du nor lug tsho khyu dang khyu byas nas 'dugagal te gnam ngo g.ya' dag cing nyi mas nub ri'i phag nas phyir gzigs kyi 'od zer spro bzhin mtshams sprin gyi dar gos thags su bkra ba yin na/mtsho mo dang de'i nye 'gram gyi nor lug gi mdzes nyams de ji ltar rtog bzo byed ang / da ni sa yongs su nas rub zin la rgyang mig mi chod/da dung char ba zam zim zhig kyang 'bab bzhin yod par rlangs 'khor yang 'gro mtshams bzhag ste nga tshos za khang zhig tu za ma zos/— 145 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/6 30nyin/mtshan bzhud ring mo de'i dbang gis yod tshad dal cag ger song /la thang a chad med par mdun nas mdun du skyod bzhin pa ni rlangs 'khor red/ nam je gsal la song ba dang bstun nas ngas shes tshor byung dus na gor mo grong khyer brtol nas grong mthar slebs 'dugalung khog khod yangs shig tu 'dzul par sa skya bo dang ri skya bor yod la nyi 'od ri rtser phog nang snga mo'i dus tshod bdun dang phyed ka'i steng na gor mo'i bye gzhung du thon la mdo dbus lcags lam gyi zur sne zhig 'phred du rdza khog tu bsrings 'dug der g.yag rnga chu bo dang 'phrad la nyi 'od yang lung mthil du 'phros nas lam 'gram na tsher skya sngo ldem thar thor 'dug da lta khu nu zam pa(mtsho ngos las smi3400mtshams na yod)brgal te gram chu ded nas song bar na chu thang la thon 'phral gangs ri yang mig lam du mngon la rgyang ring na 'gying nger gnas/ de nas gangs kyis g.yogs pa'i ri 'dab las gzur te khod yangs thang chen brgyud a chen gangs rgyab kyi gtsod brnyan dang mi brnyan(rgyas bzang bsod nams dar rgyas)gyi rdo ring bslangs yod sar thon/ gnas de nas rjes dran gyi par rgyag 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag tu 'phyo yang / bya thabs zad pas mig bltas tsam byas rjes dran gso than thun gyis 'thus par byas/ 'byams klas pa'i dben gnas 'dir na khug mang la rtswa rtsi tog ljang ser du snang /— 146 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/mtshams 'di nas gnam ngo rub par chu dmar zam pa mthong la gram gzhung nyid sa dmar du 'dug de nas yar song na m+mug pa la sgang(smi5200)grong rdal yod la kha ba kar kor yod pa'i rtswa thang na nor lug dag gis rtswa chu la rol zhing / char yang babs par nye logs su na 'dam dang mtshe'u mang po 'khyil yod pa mthong du mchis/ gzhan dar lcog brtsengs yod pa'i 'brog ru yang gzhi chags 'dug dmar chu zam pa(smi4500)brgal te lung khog dog mo zhig tu thon tshe na gzhon a skyo ba zhig gis rkyang phyag 'tshal nas 'gro bar 'phrad/ skabs shig nas nyi 'od mngon la dar cig la char ba zam zim babs pas/ mi rtag 'gyur ldog che ba'i rnam 'gyur rgod po de gnam rgan mas yang yang 'khrab bzhin brag smug na yod pa'i dmag gi grong rdal brtol/ phyi dro'i dus tshod bzhi tsam na gdang lar(smi5231)thon par gnas der sa rtags gsal ba'i rdo ring bslangs 'dug 'di nas bzung ste dbus kyi sa thog yin par g.yon ngos su gangs shel dang 'dra ba myos bum ltar brjid/ der rgan rgon gnyis dang bcas pa'i 'grul mi 'ga' la mgo yom byung nas skyug pa ldang bzhin yod par rgan rgon gnyis kyis bshad rgyur/ gal te rang gi pha yul nas sa rdul tog tsam bzung yod rgyu na/ sna khar 'khyer te bsnun na phan thogs 'byung mod/ pha yul nas chas dus brjed song ba red ces gsungs/ gang ltar kyang da lta a mdo rdzong(smi4800)du thon pa dang — 147 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/za khang las za ma zos rjes yang bskyar 'grul bzhud byas par/ mkhar gyang sa dmar gru bzhir brdungs pa'i khang khyim mang po mthong la nor lug lhas rar bskyil 'dug de nas dgong mo'i dus tshod dgu'i steng nag chu(smi4500)la thon/ kha ba mthug po babs yod la mi tshos dgun lwa gyon 'dug nub mthar glog dmar lta bu'i 'od zhags 'khrug ba'i/na yod pa dang dgung dbyings su zla ba tshes ris mngon/ nam gung gi dus tshod gnyis kyi steng lha sa'i rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs su thon/ 'grul mi tshang ma bya 'phur ba ltar rang rang gi phyogs su song bar shul du yod pa ni nga tsho dang rgan rgon grwa pa bcas red/ der nga tshos khong tsho gla 'khor la 'dug tu bcug nas lam 'jug bzang po byas rjes da gzod nga tsho gla 'khor la bsdad nas dmigs sar bskyod/ lha sa 'di yang grong khyer gzhan dang 'dra bar nam gung gi tshe na'ang rlangs 'khor mang po'i 'dur rgyug lang long du 'dug skabs der nga tsho'i gla 'khor de po ta la'i mdun thad nas bskyod par/ ngas de'i dra ma brgyud nas po ta lar mig zung tsam g.yos na/ po ta la/ dal cag ger/ lhing 'jags se/gsal la mi gsal gyis brjid nyams kyis bzhugs/ lar kho bos nyin dkar zhig la rgyang ring po nas ser 'od lam lam du 'phro ba'i rgya phibs rgyal mtshan gyis brgyan pa'i po ta la thog mar mthong 'dod kyi 'dun pa ji 'dra che ang /— 148 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/lam thag spyi le1944(zi ling nas lha sa bar)lam gla/ sgor3507 1nyin/bod mi zhig stod nyi ma lha sar thon pa yin na thog mar nges par du‘‘lha sa'i jo bo’’la mjal nges/ 'di ni btsan po gang gi sku ring dang bla dpon skyes chen su zhig gis dang / tshul ji ltar srol tshugs pa dang dar ba'i rgyu mtshan mthong tshor stug por spro rgyu med rung / gang ltar dad pa gang rung zhig gi ngo bo las 'phros te srol gyi rgyun la chags nas dus yun ring mo zhig 'gyangs yod/ bag chags mthu btsan de'i dbang gis nga tsho yang de ring snga dro dus tshod bcu'i g.yas g.yo/na du gtsug lag khang gi mdun du thon/ der kha btags re nyos te glo sgo nas nang la song zhing mjal pa tsho 'tshang kha shig shig tu yod par gral sgrig nas dus tshod gnyis tsam 'gyangs pa na gzod jo bo la thog mar dngos mjal thub pa byung /lar gtsug lag ces pa ni rig gnas thams cad kyi spyi la 'jug pa'i don dang sde snod chos dpe'i don yod par/ gtsug lag khang zhes pa la/ mkhas dbang dung dkar mchog nas/ rtsis dang rig gnas chung ba'i dpe cha la gtsug lag brer ba dang / yang na gtsug ni chos — 149 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/dang / lag ces pa sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum bzhugs sa de la zer zhes dang / 〈dag yig gsar bsgrigs〉 su/gtsug lag ste rig pa'i gnas la brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byed sa'i gnas kyi ming / chos 'chad sa'i khang ba'i ming ste 'du khang yang zer zhes dang / yang 〈tshig mdzod brda dag kun gsal me long〉las/dpe mdzod khang dang / mchod khang ste sku gsung thugs rten bsham yul zhes 'byung bar bod btsan po'i dus skabs su/ thog mar nang pa sangs rgyas kyi rten dang brten pa'i bzhugs sa'i lha khang tsam dang / (srong btsan sgam po'i dus) bar du sku rten mang po bzhengs skrun dang chos dpe rgya mtsho bsgyur 'dren dang bcas par nang chos spel gnas/ (khri srong lde btsan gyi dus) rjes su ban de dang bcas par mchod gzhis yod pa'i sde tshogs gtos chen zhig tu grub/ (khri lde gtsug btsan gyi dus) yang thog ma'i dus su gzhan yong btsun mo'i dgongs 'dun ltar btsan po'i bkas bzhengs su bcug pa'i rig gnas dang len gyi snang tshul yan gar ba zhig dang /bar du bla btsan po'i thugs dgongs ltar bzhengs pa'i phyi yong rig gnas shig gi rkang tshugs pa'i dan rtags shig rjes su blon chen po dang blon byas rjes can gyis kyang bzhengs par btub pa'i mchod gzhis kyang 'dzoms la spyi tshogs kyi go thang dang dbang grags mthon por 'phar ba'i grub cha gal chen zhig go/— 150 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/lha sa gtsug lag khang / 'di la jo khang dang mtshan rgyas par ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang / de las kyang mtshan cha tshang la ra sa dga' bzhi 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang zhes par/ ra sa ni 'o thang gi mtsho la ra mar sa bkal nas bsubs pas de ltar byung la/ khri ral pa can gyi skabs tsam nas ra sa de lha sa zhes par bsgyur par grags/dga' bzhi ni sgo bzhi dkyil 'khor ris su byas pas bla ma dga'/ ka ba phur ba ris su byas pas sngags pa dga'/ rtsig pa g.yung drung ris su byas pas bon po dga'/ lcam gdung re'u mig ris su byas pas bod 'bangs dga' zhes zer pa ltar thogs/ gzhan yang rtsig rmang gi dbyibs ni 'byung 'gyur rab byung gi don du 'dul ba'i lugs dri gtsang khang dang bcas pa byang phyogs so bdun mtshon pa'i re'u mig so bdun mdzad/ skye bo spyi'i don du chos gang byed lam gyi sgros tshang bar dgos pa'i brdar phyi gru bzhir mdzad/ bon po'i don du dang chos nyid mi 'gyur ba mtshon phyir zur bzhi g.yung drung ris su mdzad/ sngags pa'i don dang 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa mtshon phyir dbus su ngag gi dbang phyug drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshad du mdzad pa bzhi'o/ /da lta'i gnas skor ljongs rgyu'i las rigs 'di shin tu dar che bas sne shan pa ci rigs su yod la gnas yig gi dpe cha yang mang po byung 'dug de dag thams cad gnas skor pa tsho'i dgos mkho skong ched — 151 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/yin pa ni zhabs 'degs zhu yul thad kar ba red la/ de'i pha rol na lo rgyus kyi don bya mang po la shes rtogs dang rgyus lon dang phyir dran dang dran 'dzin dang bkur gzos kyi slad du'o/ /yin yang lo rgyus la ra mgo lug sug gi yin min go ldog na su zhig gi skyon du 'gro ang / rgya yig gi lam nas bris pa'i gnas skor ngo sprod skor gyi dpe cha re 'garadur sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang ni rgya mo bzas bzhengs par bshad pa'i ma dag rgyun 'byams mang po 'dug da ltar mjal du yod pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di'i rgya khyon la smi gru bzhi ma khri2 5yod pa dang / 'og khang du khyon lha khang che chung mi 'dra ba bco brgyad mchis/ gtsug lag khang 'dis chos dad mang tshogs kyi lus kyi spu long rab tu g.yo zhing dang ba cig char du 'dren byed yul du gyur pa ni seng ldeng sgo'i drang thad la 'khel pa'i gtsang khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol ba'i jo bo shākya mu ne+e'i sku brnyan 'di nyid red/ 'di la rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen mos cod pan gtsug rgyan bsgron la rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mos de las kyang rgya cher mdzad pas da lta'i snang brnyan 'di lags/gtsug lag khang la mchod mjal zhus tshar te seng ldeng sgo mo brgyud nas phyir thon skabs/ mjal ba mang pos kha phyir 'khor bzhin rdo leb skrun 8/ spya2dītā3rmi ṭ+wā ngh+rurjo snra 8'e ngosnyu rnyisna nākū n+ni rnyi snikhri gāsgyug zlog pasdo ༈ngaswārī sdi thrudūsdo r+bha k+ṣa baji sgying ba lhadā lda smisdo s+ho ra la ji bradī zlo spra la dang ra thang mcha la gtsug lag khang bgangs par bshad 'dug

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/zhig gi steng rkang pa mnyam gshib kyis lag pa'i thal mo dang gar sbyar nas bsngo ba smon lam 'debs par 'phrad la/ de ni jo bo dang thad ka thad sor yin pa dang gcig g.yas su thugs smon lha khang yod pa dang gnyis/ steng du chos rgyal yab yum gyi lha khang yod pa dang gsum/'og tu rin po che'i gter sbas yod pa dang bzhi bcas kyis smon lam btab tshad 'grub ces zer ba'o/ /gzhan sgo mtha' phyi nang gi rdo gcal dang khyams ra'i ka bar rdo 'dzul ba lcags shan dkris pa mang por yang gtam rgyud sna tshogs bshad du yod/de nas gtsug lag khang gi glo sgo nas phyir thon na/ mig lam du mngon pa ni g.yas g.yon gyi tshong sgrom la bshams pa'i tshong pa dag gi tshong rdzas red/ skor lam du tshong zog ci rigs su snang ste/ kha btags dang / rlung rta/ snam bu/ 'dogs rgyan gyi rigs/ gon pa'i rigs/ gna' rdzas kyi rigs/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad/ mchod rdzas kyi rigs sogs sil 'tshong pa dang tshong khang gi rnam pa gang dgar mchis/gtsug lag khang la skor ba byed kyin dal bur bar skor brgyud na nub ngos su snang rtse shag yod la/ mdun du bsang rkong zhig kyang yo/da par de ni tag tag bod rang gi nye rabs kyi rig pa'i dpa' bo dge chos mchog bzhugs sa'i btson khang red/ kho bo ni thengs 'gar der ched du blta ru song yang sgo phye yod pa'i glags dang ma 'phrad pas yid sems/ — 153 —

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/rab tu gdung / gang ltar kyang kho bor btson khang 'di'i snang brnyan ji ltar yod par blo bzo byed pa'i sems byung til 'bru tsam yang med mod/go thos su mkhas dbang mchog gi sku brnyan dang bcas par bzhugs pa la skyo shas bar med du sbyin skad/ de nas mkhar gyang gi zur kha byang shar mtshams su‘‘dge 'dun chos 'phel mdzes ris sgyu rtsal 'grem ston khang’’yod cing / de ni ched du gnas skor ljongs rgyu pa'i gzigs bya'i yul du phul ba yin par nyis thog can du 'dug la/ nang du song na lhag tu'ang sgyu rtsal gyi bro ba'i rnam pa gzhan zhig sbyin nges/ bar skor gyi lam na mjal ba che 'bring chung gsum dang / rgan gzhon dar gsum/skye pho mo ci rigs/ mdo dbus khams gsum gyi mgron po/ rgya sog he gsum/ phyi gling pa sogs rang rang gi sems 'dun zhig gi phyir du 'khor gyin 'dug7 3nyin/de ring cung snga mor langs te zhogs zas la rol rjes grong khyer gyi nub ngos nas spyi le bcu tsam gyi sa na yod pa'i dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon par mchod mjal du song / mtshan rgyas par bkra shis dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon zhes zhu/ nga tsho ma gal dang shing bra mas khengs pa'i dgon 'dab kyi sdong gseng brgyud nas dgon mdun gyi 'dun sar thon la khad der kha btags dang mchod mar dang rlung rta dang shing par — 154 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/'tshong mkhan khag cig 'dug gyen du 'dzegs te 'du khang dang gtsang khang / gtsug lag khang / grwa tshang khag gi mi tshan khang tshan kun la mchod mjal zhus shing / sku gsung thugs kyi rten skal mtha' dag dang khang ba phub lugs/ ka gdung bzo lugs/ logs ris gyan thang la sogs par rang nus lcogs tshod kyis zhal mjal zhib lta byas pa yin/ bdag ya mtshar ba ni tshogs chen 'du khang gi ka ngos dag yin te/ dbu rmog khrab gsum dang / mda' gzhu mdung gri la sogs mang po bkal yod par nga tshos 'dra par bskyon pa na dkor gnyer nga tsho'i mdun du slebs/ der khong gis nga tsho bod pa yin par shes nas cang mi zer/ yin rgyu ni gal te phyi gling pa dang rgya nag pas par rgyag 'dod tshe lha khang de'i dkor gnyer la re re nas sgor nyi shu dang bcu re sprod dgos pas red/ tshogs chen 'du khang la dkar gsal de 'dra mi ldan pas cung nag 'thom mer yod la/ ka stod na yod pa'i 'khor gsum de tshor yang mjal ba tshos de 'dra do snang byed kyin mi 'dug gzhan 'du khang de'i nyis thog tu bka' 'gyur lha khang yod par glegs shing la ba sos mtha' shan byas shing de la me tog dang yi ge'i rnam pa brkos dkrol phra rgyas ci rigs su 'dug 'bras spungs dgon 'di ni bod yu/la gyi dpe rnying dang bstan bcos deb ther ches mang po bzhugs sa'i gnas shig yin par bod rig pa'i rigs gzhung don gnyer tsho'i ngag na chu mig — 155 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/brdol ba ltar gleng bzhin yod la don du yang de ltar du snang /zhal mjal rags tsam byas rjes kho bo'i yid ngor dran 'gyur rab rib tu 'phyur pa ni/ lha khang 'du khang gi lha rten sku brnyan tshogs ma yin par/ dgon pa'i bzo bkod dang chags dbyibs/ da dung nye 'brel na rdo pha bong ci rigs su mthong ba la rje tsong kha pa'i gtso byas lha'i sku brnyan mang po bkod yod pa dag red/ dgon pa 'dir bslebs rjes kho bor ni gna' bo'i btsan rdzong gi mkhar grong zhig tu slebs pa'i snang ba bcos min tu sbyin la/ rdo'i 'jig rten du slebs pa'i yid tshor yang 'gog med du 'phyo/rlangs 'khor la bsdad de phyir 'gro bar rtsom pa'i tshe/ byis pa lo brgyad yas mas kyi gyon pa ral po can skor zhig gis slong mo byed pa mthong / kho bos kyang de mur mjal dar la gra sgrig byas pa'i sil sgor dag kyang ci yin 'di yin med par kho tshor sbyin dgos song / der kho bos byis pa de dag slob grwar 'gro gi yod med la sems pa phyogs nas bsam yan gyi klong du kho tsho dang kha thag je ring la phyin/7 4nyin/de ring grong khyer gyi byang ngos nas spyi le lnga drug tsam gyi mtshams na yod pa'i se ra dgon par mchod mjal du song / mchod mar(tsha dem — 156 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/gang la sgor10)dang kha btags nyos te dgon gling du song ba na dpal ldan 'bras spungs las chags sa bde mo snyoms par 'dug na ning do tshigs kyi phyi rkyen du ma'i dbang gis da ltar mchod mjal zhu sa mang po mi 'dug pas dus la 'gor 'gyangs mang po med pa red/ dgon pa'i 'du khang dang lha khang gi rtsig pa mthon po dag la zhib tu mjal na/ kho bor btsan rdzong la dpe blangs pa 'dra ba'i tshor snang sbyin la dra mig re re ni so lta'i so khung re re dang 'dra bar rim bzhin mdzes rgyan gyi zol du gyur par snyam/ dgon mtha' na shing bra ma dang ma gal/ thod dkar/mkhan pa sogs skyes shing sdong ra bskor 'dug rgyab ri ni brag rdo dang rdo pha bong gis khengs 'dug dgon pa dang thag mi ring ba'i spyi le gcig lhag tsam gyi sa na ming du grags pa'i se ra dur khrod yod pa dang /de ni gru gzings kyi dbyibs dang mtshungs pa'i rdo pha bong chen po zhi/ga yin par/ steng du snum zhag 'khyil ler yod pa'i rdo log cig dang thag zhags shig bzhag 'duga'ajam mgon bla mas ma 'ongs par gnas 'dir dbu ma la mkhas pa'i sde chen po zhig chags par 'ong zhes lung bstan shod srol ltar/ da ltar yang chos rtsod kyi rgyun srol bzang po zam ma chad par gnas shing phyi dro'i mtshams na chos rar rtsod gleng gi yo lang rab tu rgyas/ go thos/ gzhan zhig la se ra dgon pa 'dir phyogs yongs kyi grwa pa dag las a — 157 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/mdo reb gong gi grwa pa mang zhing / de dag grwa skor dam bca' dang chos grwa'i brgal brtag gang gi skabs su'ang mtshan snyan rgyas thog khong tsho'i khrod du dge bshes kyang mang po 'dug skad/7 5nyin/ra mo che/ ra sa gtsug lag khang gi byang ngos kyi spyi le gcig lhag gi mtshams na 'dug da lta'i nga tsho'i mjal ngor snang ba 'di ni rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs su nyams gso byas pa de'i bzo dbyibs kyi bkod pa yin pa dang / bod gna' bo'i dgon pa'i bzo bkod kyi rnam pa lhur blangs 'dug dus phyi'i‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen mo'i’’god chag skabs su/ nang rten gtso bo jo bo mi skyod rdo rje'i sku brnyan der gtor skyon tshabs chen phog ste sku stod sku smad gnyis su bzos/rjes su kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i thugs khur gzigs skyong 'og tu/ jo bo'i sku stod 'khrul bral nyid pe cin nye 'dabs kyi bzo grwa zhig nas btsal rnyed byung ba lha sar gdan drangs te sku'i stod smad lhan 'dzoms byung ba la da lta'i mjal rgyu yod pa 'di nyid lags/mthong snang than thun/(1)mdang dgong dus tshod bcu gnyis yas mas nas char ba shag shag tu babs la 'bab shod shin tu che/ lha sa khul 'dir mtshon na da 158 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zi tho zi zi /nyin mor char ba 'bab tshad nyung zhing 'bab yun thung mod mtshan mo ni de las ldog zlar gyur 'dug nyin mo ni mi tshang ma bya ba'i brel 'tshub kyi dus yin pas char ba nyung na bzang la/ mtshan mo ni mi tshang ma ngal gso'i dus yin pas char ci 'dra babs na'ang blo bde bag phebs kyis gnyid la rol chog pas lha sa'i gnam gshis 'di ha cang ngo mtshar du snang / mdang dgong drag char babs te nang snga mor 'bab mtshams chad rung sngar bzhin gnam ngo rub 'dug pas nyi zer mthong mi thub/lha sar yong nas nyi ma lnga lhag 'gor rung nang snga mo'i mtshams sprin dang nyi 'od lam lam gyi 'dzum zer mthong ma myong / nam rgyun dus tshod brgyad yas mas su mal las ldang ste song na/ srang lam dang rgya lam du 'phrad pa ni skor ba la 'gro ba'i mi tshogs red/ rkang mgyogs lag brel gyis gcig rjes gcig gis snyeg gin bstar la brgyus pa'i khong tsho/nang snga mo nas de ltar chas/ der dbus pa 'dug la gtsang pa yo/da/a mdo pa 'dug la khams pa 'dug gzhis mi dang phyogs yongs mjal bas grub pa'i sde tshogs rang dbang pa 'di tshos ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dmigs pa rtse gcig gi slad de ltar 'dur rgyug la brel/ kha nas ma ṇi dang / lag tu ma ṇi/ sems nas sems can sgom pa'i khong tshos chos ldan lha ldan gyi zhing khams 'di grub/ de dag las mang che ba rgan rgon bgres po red/ khong tsho la mtshon na de ltar byed du rung la yin 'os pa — 159 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/zhig kyang red/ de ni gcig tu chos dad mang tshogs kyi gshis lugs red/ gnyis su kha ton dge sbyor gyi ngang nas sdig spong dge sgrub kyi tshogs bsags red/ gsum du rang sems rnam dag gis phyi mar nyer bsdogs gya nom pa bskrun ched do/ /de dang chabs cig byis pa dag slob grwar skyel zhor skor ba la 'gro mkhan yang mang po 'dug(2)lha sa grong khyer ni 'dzam gling gi sgal tshigs na 'gying zhing rta bdun dbang bo dang ches nye ba'i nyi ma'i grong khyer gcig pu yin/ de ni dwangs gtsang dang / khyad mtshar/ gsang 'phrul bcas kyi gnas mchog cig yin par/ spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas las thon pa'i dza drag gi dus rabs 'dir de yang brdab gsig gang mang gi sum mdo na gnas pas/ tshan rtsal las thon pa'i dngos zog khra khra ci rigs dang / tshong khang mgron khang la sogs kyi deng rabs khang rtseg rdzig pos sa stong ma lus tsam du rgya je che dang khod je dog 'du 'dzi je che yo lang je rgyas la btang bas rig gnas sna mang po'i ming brda tha snyad yang rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ltar thon dang 'don bzhin mchis/ der rang gi skad dang yi ge'i lam nas gsar byung dngos po la ming gdags rgyu ni dge mtshan brjod mi langs/ des na lo tsā yig sgyur gyi las rigs 'di shin tu gal chen du mthong ste/ legs na gser zam red/ ngan na mdzo sbrel g.yang lhung red/ de lta bu'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas kho bos grong — 160 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zi tho zi zi /khyer 'di'i sgo byang dag las 'gyur yig cung legs gras 'ga' khol du phyung na/glolo la tshong grong / alo la dra grong / lkotsho la rgya khog tshi/shāskru la rdza khog skya.oṃṭha la tshong gnyer khang / r+ha༈(khral skam 'khru khang / 6lhocha la byug rdzas/ tram̐waṃ4ljal nyams bzo/ ༅ṣ+ṭhal chedatshong / kā1༈oṃl mngags bzo/ khaṣ+ṭhal 'grems brda/ khriglo4smoṣ+ṭharnyeskru la dngul smar rang len 'phrul chas/ zakhye la rang 'dems tshong khang / lothoyiza la rdotha kung si lta bu'o/ /〈bod kyi brda chad spyi bsgrags〉zhes pa'i spyi ang dgu paraḍaṣ+ṭha la khyab brda dngaza.oṃ la stabs bde khrom ra zhes bsgyur thog yig cha de'i 'go yi gsal bshad la 'di ltar bkod 'dug ste/ gsham gyi brda chad 'di dag mtsho sngo/na zhing chen bod kyi brda chad tshad ldan zhus bsher gtan 'bebs u yon lhan khang gis2003lo'i zla10par zhus bsher gtan 'bebs bgyis te khyab bsgrags byas pas/ zhing chen nang khul gyi 'brel yod las khungs so sos nges par du 'di ltar bkol spyod bya dgos pa las/ gang 'dod ltar mi bca' bar zhu zhes rnga/'o/ /des na bod kyi zhing ljongs lnga bo thun mong nas 'di ltar gcig gyur gyis spyi bsgrags byas te tshad ldan du bkol na/ 'gyur mang po dang dag thon min gyi dka' rnyog thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis zhu 'gro/— 161 sdi

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/(3)mdang dgong yang char ba babs byung bas de ring 'phyi tsam nas langs te sgor rdog thon byung ba na thang rlon par 'dug gnam ngo da dung rub 'dug la 'gro lam du lag la ma ṇi thogs pa'i rgan rgon tshor sngar bzhin 'phrad/ lam bar gyi khang mig re re'i sgo byang la blta bzhin song ba na/ ming mi thogs pa'i gnas skor tshong khang zhig tu dpe sgrom du dpe cha mang po bshams 'dug nang du 'dzul nas bltas tshe yod tshad gnas skor lam yig la mkho ba'i lta klog gi dpe cha rkyang du 'dugader〈ma skyes a ma〉zhes pa'i dpe deb cig yod par/ bdag gi mig dbang cig car du drangs song / de la bltas na bde zhing 'thob bya mang ba dang / sems shugs dang klad shugs dus tshod bcas gang la'ang bde lhod gron chung bya thub pa'i thun min gyi khyad chos shig ldan te/yi gewaṃri morgo'adra par sa khra —lam thigawaṃ zin tho bcas gzhi gcig tu sbrel pa'i tshon ldan gyi rgya dpe ha cang don po can zhig red/der grong khyer lha sa'i mtshan gyi thogs don dang nang don/ sa dbyibs/phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi rtags dang mtshan ma/ lha khang gna' shul grags can/ rang byung gnas ri 'gangs chen/ yul srol goms gshis sogs nyung ngur ngo sprod byas 'dug7 7nyin/yun ring la nyar ba'i sems ngogs kyi po ta la/ lo rgyus kyi hrag — 162 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/bar na 'gying ba'i po ta la/ po ta la'i khang mig re re dang dra mig re re/yang na brtsegs rim gyi them skas re re/ kho bos ji ltar rtog bzo byas yod ang / ngas da lta khyed kyi mdun sgo brgyud nas sde srid kyi zhol rdo ring nang ma la zhib lta byas rjes/ rtswa phran thar thor rdo bar na skyes pa'i them skas rdog pas mnon bzhin pho brang khyed dang je nye nas je nyer yod/po ta la zhes pa legs sbyar saṃ ṭi ta'i skad yin la don du ri bo gru 'dzin te spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams yin zhes zer/ da lam rang re'i spyan sngar mchis pa'i rtse pho brang po ta la'i mtho tshad la smi 117 19dang rgya khyon la smi gru bzhi khri13yod pa'i brtsegs rim bcu gsum gyis grub pa'i brjid chags yid 'ong gi bdag nyid do/ /pho brang du mjal tshar te ltag rgyab nas sgo phyir thon pa na/ phar phyogs kyi brag ri la smug pas btum 'dug zhing gru bzhi'i lo tog sngo ljang mer 'dug gzhan nyams gso la brel bzhin pa'i gzhon nu pho mo mang pos ar las byed bzhin ar gzhas snyan mo zhig gtong ba ni/ ji 'dra'i lhod bags dang spro snang gis brtas yod ang / de ni rig pa grim grim dang sha sgrim sgrim la gnas mjal zhus shing yid la ci yang mi 'char ba'am dran pa 'khrug por mchis pa'i kho bo la mtshon na ji 'dra'i ngal gso'i longs spyod 'dzoms po rang red ang / po ta la'i phyi nang gi bkod pa ngo mtshar ba dang khyad 'phags la ha cang thag nye bos gnas — 163 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/mjal zhus rung / da dung po ta la nyid tshul ci lta bur snang brnyan gson po can du gtong bar kho bos skad cha rus rkang can zhig rnyed ma byung bas rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mo'i mgrin ngag g.yar po zhu ba la/mdzes sdug lha dbang khang bzang rjes 'gro zhing / / rngam brjid laṅka'i grong gi spun zlar byas/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'phel bas lcang lo can/ /bde skyid dga' ston spel phyir gru 'dzin dngos/ /mi bsrun glags lta'i mun stug mthar bskrod par/ /sra brtan lcags ras khor yug kun bskor ba/ /sde bzhi'i legs tshogs 'byung ba'i sgo 'phar gyi/ /lcog rnams rgyal chen bzhi yi mkhar la 'gran/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi nyer btud skye bo'i 'grul/ /chad med rgyu ba'i rin chen them skas tshogs/ /lhun po lta bur mtho ba brag ri ngos/ /byed pos pir gyis bris pa bzhin du mdzes/ /shel dkar brtsegs steng pad rag kha bad brgyan/ /sgo 'gram dbang sngon byu ru'i ka bas bteg/ gdung sogs rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i/ /pho brang 'di ko rnam rgyal khang bzang bzhin/ /'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs las grub rgyal mtshan gyi/ /'od 'bar 'jig rten ma lus gsal byas pas/ / rta bdun dbang bo skyengs te thun mtshams ma'i/ /stegs las mchongs te byang gling mkha' la bros/ /mes pos gdong bzhir sprul nas phyogs kun tu/ / bltas kyang pho brang gang 'di'i dpe zla'i 'os/ /ma rnyed ngal bas zag bcas bde ba'i ro'i/ /mi bzad gnyid la — 164 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zi zi /bskal pa'i bar du g.yur/ /7 8nyin/nangs snga mor langs te gtsug lag khang 'dun sa'i rlangs 'khor sa tshigs nas bsam yas su thad gtong byed pa'i rlangs 'khor la bsdad de grong khyer gyi lho nub mtshams su bskyod/ rgyab phyogs su ri rtse dang thang mtshams kun tu nyi 'od ser gyi ler 'phro bzhin 'dug g.yas phyogs kyi dbu rtse ri khug na 'bras spungs dgon ni dkar yol 'brug ris ma la 'bras dkar spungs pa ltar brjid chags ltems mer 'khyil/ jo khang dang bral nas spyi le lnga tsam gyi rgya lam g.yas g.yon na deng rabs kyi lugs su byas pa'i thog so can gyi sgo ra chen po dang ldan pa'i ru sgar mang pos grong mtha' bskor 'dug lam bar du ming mi thogs pa'i grong gseb re 'ga' snang la/ yod tshad kyi khang khyim sgo ra dang ldan pa'i nyis thog can du 'dug thog so'i ltag rgyab kyi mkhar zur gnyis na spo tho spen tog la dar lcog bslangs yod par rang re'i yul gyi khang khyim la bslangs pa'i dar lcog lta bu ma yin par sdong bo'i ra lag can red/khang ba'i bzo dbyibs ni yum bu bla mkhar dang a na ma na red/ sgo klad la dbyibs gru bzhi nar mo bcos pa'i zhabs che steng chung gi brtsegs rim gsum du yod pa dang khang mig gi kha phyogs lho dang sgo'i kha phyogs — 165 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/shar du gtad 'dug de dag mig lam la shin tu mdzes shing yid gar 'ong ba'o/ /g.yon na skyid chu 'od phrig phrig tu bzhur zhing g.yas su rdo chen por yod pa'i brag ri mdzes pa zam ma chad par gnas/ mtshams mtshams su zhing gru bzhi la 'bru snye rgyas zin pa mang por 'phrad kyang gzugs ha cang chung / ske tshe la ser sha bral nas ljang skya dang nas la dkar sha dod nas mgo bo dud yod par rnga ran pa'i brda ston bzhin mchis/ da lta nga tsho chu shur zam chen gyi phar sne na yod pa'i dong chen du 'dzul zin la/ de ni bskal la ri bo brtol pa'i rdza khung zhig yin par de'i phar nang du da dung zam chen zhig snang bar tag tag tshu rol skyid chu dang pha rol yar klung gtsang po yin pas dong gcig la zam pa gnyis zhes kyang 'bod srol 'dug gong dkar rdzong la thon pa na lam 'gram gyi sdod dmangs khang khyim ni rdo rtsig gi nyis thog can du snang zhing /gling bzhir dar lcog yod par mdun gnyis dmu thag gis sbrel yod pa can yang mthong rgyu 'dug gzhan nas zhing bregs zin pa dang ske tshe ser gyi ler dang lcang sdong chen po mthong lam du mngon/ yin yang /yid phangs pa zhig la g.yas ngos su ri klung bye mar 'gyur bzhin yod la g.yon ngos kyi gtsang po yang dwangs gsal sngo ljang du med par rnyog mar bzhur gyin 'dug de nas gra nang rdzong khongs su slebs pa dang g.yas g.yon tshang ma bye thang can du 'gyur bzhin pa ha cang tshabs che rtsed — 166 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zi zin/thang grong rdal brtol nas rtsed thang zam chen brgyud na g.yas g.yon gtsang po'i nye 'gram du shing 'om bu'i me tog sngon por snang thog lcang ma dang sbyar sdong yang 'dug der yar klung gtsang po g.yon ngos na bzhur gyin 'dug la nye 'gram du bye mas khebs yod pa dang lcang sdong mang po btsugs 'dug g.yas su tsher skya dang bye mas g.yogs pa'i ri 'ba' 'bur mang po yod pa mthong bas tshod tshod la sems pa skya shur shur du gyur 'gro/ de ltar gtsang 'gram ded nas mdun nas mdun du skyod pa na mdun ljongs tshang ma skya ther ther gyi bye thang du snang / 'o/ltos dang / da lta has po ri'i 'dabs rol du slebs byung /bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi mtshan rgyas par 'bod na dpal bsam yas lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes grags/ da lta'i lho kha khul gra nang rdzong khongs yar klung gtsang po'i byang ngos kyi ri 'dabs na gnas/ bsam yas dgon pa'i nang du sa sa mal dang rdo rdo mal lta bu'i zhib mjal byas na nyams gso byas ma tshar bar zhig ral tu yod pa'i lha khang dang logs ris mer bsregs pa'i skyon cha can yang mang po mthong rgyu 'dugabasam yas su glog 'then med pa dang / yod pa de'ang ha cang mi gsal la de ni rang sa nas bton pa'i chu glog yin zer/ kha par gyi brda rtags kyang mi bzang bas kha par gtong khag po 'dug yin yang /— 167 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/da lta bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi lcags ri'i phyi skor la rdo gcal 'ding bzhin yod pa dang mnyam du mdun thad na deng rabs kyi khang rtseg du ma gsar bzhengs byed kyi 'dug 'di ni ma 'ongs par ci 'dra zhig yin nam/ drang mor bshad na/ rgya khang rgya lugs de bsam yas gtsug lag khang lta bu'i nye 'khor dang gnas mchog 'di'i gzhi dkyil du shin tu mi mdza' bar snang ngo / /lam thag spyi le230 (lha sa nas bsam yas bar)lam gla/ sgor387 9nyin/nga tsho bsam yas nas rtsed thang la thon dus nyin gung gi dus yol nas phyi dro bslebs yod par/ mgron khang tho 'god byas te rgyab khug lci mo der bzhag rjes/ spyi spyod rlangs 'khor la bsdad de spyi le brgyad tsam gyi sa na yod pa'i yum bu bla sgang gi phyogs su bskyod/ tsha lam lam gyi nyi 'od/ sngo yug yu/ga gi lo tog ljang ldem ldem gyi sdong bo'i khrod nas da lta ri 'dabs kyi rlangs 'khor 'bab tshigs la thon zin/ der kyag kyog gi rkang lam brgyud nas bla mkhar la gnas mjal zhus pa yin/ de ni thog so gnyis can du 'dug cing lha khang gi sku brnyan la gnya' khri ni la thod dkar po'i steng dmar po can/ phyag zung bum pa bsnams pa'i — 168 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/tshugs kar bzhugs/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan ni la thod dkar po'i steng dmar po can/ phyag la 'khor lo bsnams pa/ srong btsan ni la thod dkar po dbu sku can/ khri srong lde btsan ni gtsug tor dang phyag la 'khor lo bsnams pa/ khri ral ba can ni la thod dkar po dang phyag la 'khor lo bsnams pa/ thon mi ni la thod dkar po steng dmar po can/ phyag la po ti bsnams pa/ blon mgar stong btsan ni la thod dkar po steng dmar po can/ smra ra dkar po/ phyag la sba shing 'khar ba thogs pa/ gzhan logs ris la/ brla mkhar dang bod mi mdog sngon gyi lwa ba gyon zhing skra ring can dang / da dung nor g.yag sogs 'dug gosa'i chags dbyibs 'dem lugs kyi dbang gis mkhar 'di'i rgyab shar la gtad cing sgo nub la bstan 'dug mkhar mdun las rgyang ring la bltas na/ mdun ljongs kyi zhing sa dang lung pa dag lag mthil du blangs pa ltar yod/ de nas phyir ri zhol du babs nas rgyang thag nges can yod sa nas phyir blta byed na/ mtho zhing brjid la krong nger 'gying ba'i mkhar rdzong gnam du zug pa zhig tu mthong /7 10nyin/rtsed thang nas 'phyongs rgyas su thad gtong byed pa'i rlangs 'khor la bsdad de mdun nas mdun tu skyod/ lung khog yangs mo zhig gi — 169 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/mda' nas phu la 'dzul bar khang khyim tshang ma thog so can du 'dug la khang pa'i zur gnyis kyi spo thor dar lcog bslangs yod mod/ 'on kyang spen kha'i mdog ha lam nag por byas 'dug da lta ar 'dam gyi bod rgyal zam pa brgal te 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi shar lho'i mtshams na yod pa'i btsan po'i bang sor mjal tu song / rgyang ring nas bltas na sa tho chen por snang ba'i bang so dag da lta mig mdun na nyams chag dang bcas te bzhugs/ srong btsan bang so ni sa rdo 'dres mar yod la mtha' skor la dmu thag 'then 'dug cing / tsher skya dang zwa dang ming mi thogs pa'i shing rigs gte chung can mang po nye 'gram kun tu skyes 'dug bang so'i dur lam ni phyogs gang du gtad yod pa thad kar du shes dka'/ de nas phar phyogs su gzigs na 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi rgyab ri'i gdong ka la lcags ri lta bu'i gyang gog ring mo zhig snang bar/pur srung pa rmo bos gsungs pa ltar na/ 'phying ba stag rtse'i mkhar shul yin par smra/btsan po khri lde srong btsan gyi bang so de sngo zhing ldem pa'i zhing dkyil na 'dug mtha' skor gyi ring tshad la smi180dang mtho tshad la smi14 7'dug de'i nye 'gram na khang pa zhig yod par nang du song na rdo ring zhig yod de/ 'ol tshod kyis rags rtsis byas na/ mtho tshad la smi bdun tsam dang zheng la mtho gsum/ mdun ngos mtho drug tsam yod ge 170 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zi tho zi zin/par mdun ngos su bod yig yod kyang gsal por mi mthong / rdo ring de ni rus sbal gyi sgal dkyil du bzhengs shing zhabs kyi g.yas g.yon na sprin pa lang long gi khrod g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'khyil ba lta bu'i ri mo brkos 'dug rdo ring 'di la skyon zhugs med par kha tshang bor yod pa dang /rtse tog dang char khebs dang ngos gzhung dang rdo gdan rus sbal bcas kyis grub pa zhig red/ srung skyob byas pa yang ha cang bzang po 'dugang tshos mig mdun gyi bang so'i tshogs la gzigs na/ sa dbyibs tshugs ka tsam gyis bang so yin pa'i de'u 'bur brgyad lhag tsam bgrangs nus/ phyi tshul nas tshang ma dbyibs zlum po lta bur snang ba'i gcig rgyab gcig dang gcig 'gram gcig gis skyor ba lta bu'i rgyab ri la bsnyes/ 'dug 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉nang khyon bsdoms bang so nyer gcig dang mthong lam du yod pa bcu drug bkod 'dugabang so yod do cog gi spyi'i shar nub kyi ring tshad la smi2076dang / lho byang gi zheng tshad la smi1407dang / rgya khyon la ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma smi305'dug gzhan bang so'i nye 'gram na/ khri srong lde btsan gyi mdzad rjes rdo ring ste bod yig thig phreng so bzhi yo/da pa can dang / khri lde srong btsan gyi bang so rdo ring ste bod yig thig phreng nga dgu yod pa can gnyis yod par dpe cha gzhan las mthong ba'i zam kha'i nye 'gram du yod pa ni khri srong lde btsan gyi de yin par nges/ des na1982lo'i〈bod — 171 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/ljongs zhib 'jug〉deb gnyis pa'i steng gi〈khri srong lde btsan rdo ring brkos yig tshod 'grel byas pa〉zhes par 'byung ba'i stag rtse zam sna'i rdo ring de 'dir 'dugagazhan da lta'i 'phyongs rgyas rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sgo chen nang gi g.yas phyogs na rdo ring zhig 'dug par/ mtho tshad smi gnyis lhag las da dung phyir bton yag byas med rung che chung tshang ma bang so mdun gyi rdo ring dang phal cher 'dra bor 'dug mdun ngos kyi bod yig mi gsal zhing rgyab ngos na yig ris kyang mi 'dug logs 'gram gnyis la sprin dang g.yu 'brug lta bu'i ri mo zhig gsal/da lta'i 'phyongs rgyas rdzong la rgya srang gcig ste srong btsan lam ma gtogs med pas thog so tshang ma de'i g.yas g.yon na gral du bstar 'dug thang stong nang ma khang dang 'phying ba stag rtse bod zas za khang dag ni ji 'dra'i 'du 'dzi lang long dang bral ba la ang / yod tshad stong 'jags se/ dal cag ger/ khu sim mer 'dug der tsha lam lam gyi nyi zer 'og tu nga tshos gung zas de chang ser dang mnyam tu rol rjes gyes phyag phul te phyin/ yin yang / kho bo'i yid sems de da dung 'phyongs rgyas gzhung na lus yod pa 'dra ste/ sngon rgyal dbang lnga ba'i skabs su pho brang po ta la bzhengs dus 'phyongs rgyas phyogs nas 'ul mi bsdus te las kar bcug pa na/ de'i gras su zla ba sgrol ma zhes pa'i bu — 172 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/mo sku lus ha cang mdzes pa dang skad ngag bde bo 'dzoms thog ngal rtsol glu gzhas rtsom par mkhas pa zhig yod par/ thengs shig rgyal dbang tshang gis kho mos ar gzhas gtong ba gsan nas thugs rab tu mgu ste/'phyongs rgyas kyi 'ul mi tsho phyir pha yul du log bcug nas las ka gnyer ma dgos par grags/ de bas kho bos 'phyongs rgyas zla ba sgrol ma'i snang brnyan 'ol tshod kyis dran slong bya dgos song / der tshangs mgur las/lha sa mi tshogs mthug pa/ /'phyongs rgyas mi spus dag pa/ nga la dgos pa'i chung 'dris/ /'phyongs rgyas gzhung na yod do/ /zhes pa de ngag la gyer bzhin rlangs 'khor gyi dra ma'i phyi rol du snang ba'i yul ljongs kyi bkod pa mdzes nyams dag skad cig skad cig la rgyab tu bskyur te rtsed thang phyogs su log7 12nyin/pho brang po ta la nas nub ngos su spyi le gsum tsam song na nor bu gling ga 'dug gling ga 'di ni tā la'i bla ma'i dbyar kha'i bzhugs gnas dang spro gseng gtong sa yin pas rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu ming grags shin tu che/ da lta khams gseng dang mchod mjal zhu sa zung ldan gyi zhing khams shig red/ g.yu'i phra tshom bres pa dang mtshungs pa'i skyed tshal der sdong rigs sna tshogs dang rdzing bu/ rtswa ra/ bya bye'u 'ba' — 173 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/'bu sogs ci dgar yod pas gling ga gtong mkhan tshor yid bde'i snang ba bcos min du sbyin/ dad ldan mchod mjal tshor mtshon na/ gling ga de ni bskal bzang pho brang dang spyan bsal pho brang / rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang bcas kyis grub pa'i dag zhing zhig red/ bshad rgyun du/gna' bo'i dus su da lta'i nor gling chags yul de ni shing gla ba la sogs pa'i nags tshal stug por dkrigs pa'i dbus su dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu phran lhung lhung du 'bab pa dang 'dab chags sna tshogs skad snyan 'byin zhing / ri dwags dang gcan gzan yang thar thor du gnas pa'i rang byung gi gnas dben zhing nyams dga' ba zhig yin pa la gna' dus su gla ba tshal du 'bod/ rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa nas twa la sku phreng rim byon rnams dbyar dus gnas der dbu gur phub nas chab zhugs spro gseng la phebs pa'i srol chags pa red/de ltar yab mes dag gis bskrun pa'i gling ga gzhal yas khang mnyam por yod pa'i gnas mchog ngo mtshar ba snying du sdug pa 'di lta bu la mjal na nga tshor dga' spro smra mi shes pa skyes zhor yid 'gyur sna tshogs su brdol nges/ yin yang / yid sems 'gal bar gnas pa ni/nor gling sgo chen gyi spa se la sgor gsum dang bskal bzang pho brang la sgor gnyis/ rtag brtan pho brang la sgor gsum bcas blu dgos pa de red/lar deng skabs gnas skor las rigs ha cang dar sgo che ba'i dus 'dir — 174 ge

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zin tho zin zin/rang rigs la spa se btsong ba 'di mi mdza' bar snang / dad ldan bod pa tshor mtshon na/ ma bcos rang bzhin gyis mjal dar(lha dang mchod khang la 'bul rgyu'i dngul sgor) ni lha sku re rer 'bul nges pas de ni lhag ma rkyang du 'dug phyi gling pa dang rgya mi la spa se nyo ru 'jug min ji ltar yang kho bos bshad dka'/ yin yang rang rigs la gu yangs btang na 'os snyam/ de ni sgor mo zho gang tsam yang gtong mi phod pa'i ser snas 'ching ba ma yin par/ gzhan lugs gzhan bsgo 'di rang lugs rang thon la mi 'os shing lhag mar 'gro ba'i 'gan khur lci mo zhig red bsam pa'o/ /7 14nyin/de ring nga tsho thog mar se rar song la de nas pha bong khar 'gro 'dod byung ste/ se ra dgon gyi lcags ri'i phyi rol na rdo las byed kyin pa'i rdo bzo rnams kyis bshad pa ltar nga tsho chu bzang ri khrod kyi phar nang der song / shing tsher ma ga sa gang du skyes pa'i dbus su rkang lam phra mo zhig kyag kyog gis yar 'then yod cing / pha bong kha yang da lta nga tsho dang thag je nye nas je nyer song / phre bong kha'i mtshan gzhan la sku mkhar ma ru dang / pha bong kha byang chub shing gi gnas zhes zhu/ de ni lha sa grong khyer gyi byang ngos su spyi le brgyad tsam 'das pa'i dbu gdugs ri'i lho ngos ri 'dabs su gnas/— 175 ge

sems la gyi 'apo nyul/pha bong kha'i bzo bkod ni lho ngos sgor dbyibs dang / byang ngos gru bzhir yod pa/ sgo byang blta la rdo skas ldan pa sogs gna' rabs 'dzugs skrun gyi dmigs bsal khyad chos ngo mtshar dang ldan pa 'bur du dod 'dug pha bong kha 'di ni bod rje srong btsan sku mtshams bzhugs gnas dang / thon mis bod yig gsar gtod mdzad gnas/ chos sgyur lo tsā'i gnas dang po/ bod rje blon tshos yi ge slob 'go tshugs gnas/ pur rgyal skabs thog rtseg dgu thog gi ar las 'dzugs skrun spel yul dang po yin pa sogs khyad chos brjod kyis mi langs so/ /7 16nyin/nangs snga mor yar langs te gtsug lag khang gi thang chen mdun gyi dga' ldan dgon la thad gtong byed pa'i rlangs 'khor la bsdad de mdun du skyod pa na lha sa grong khyer gyi shar phyogs su 'gro bzhin 'dugader lam 'gram du sngo ljang gi sdong bo dang rnga la nye ba'i gro nas sogs kyis legs par brgyan 'dug gzhan lam 'gram du grong tsho 'ga' zhig snang bar/ rtsed thang phyogs su 'gro dus lta bu'i khang khyim legs po gsar rgyag lta bu ma yin par ha cang nyams chag dang sa skya bo'i mkhar gyang du snang / lhag tu 'brog ri bo'i 'dabs kyi grong gseb de ni mkhar gyang zhig ral du snang zhing skyo sdug gi nyams kyis khengs 'dug— 176 —

nyi ma lha sa 'grims pa'i zi tho zi zi /da lta rlangs 'khor gyi 'gros kyang je dal red la/ ri bo de'i steng 'dzeg par khugs pa ha cang mang /dgon pa 'di'i mtshan rgyas par 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes zhu/ dgon pa'i mtshan gyi mdun la 'brog ri bo zhes 'byung ba la sa der 'brog sa zhes 'bod cing ri 'dabs kyi grong tsho chung ngu der deng sang sa ma 'brog ces zer/ chags gnas ni stag rtse rdzong khongs dbang bskur ri'i ldebs btsun mo sdings kyi mdun ngos 'gog pa ri'i steng red/ spyi lo1409lo ste rje tsong kha pa dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum par btab/ nga tshos lha khang 'du khang dang khang tshan mi tshan re rer mchod mjal rags trem zhus rjes dgon pa'i za khang du gung ja la rol/ da dung rlangs 'khor phyir 'gro rag bar tu dus tshod gnyis lhag yod pas nga tsho mdun ri la 'dzegs/ ri mgor dar lcog bslangs yod la phyogs bzhir bltas na/ rgyang ring gi pho brang po ta la mthong thub cing kya kyur bzhur ba'i skyid chu ni ji 'dra'i yid gar 'ong ba la ang /da dung ri bo mang po gcig rgyab gcig brtsegs kyi tshul du yod pa ni mu khyud kyi zol du 'dug de nas phyir dgon pa'i phyogs su gzigs na/dga' ldan ni 'ja' gzhu lta bu'i ri khugs na rgyab byang gtad dang kha shar 'khor gyis bres su chags 'dug dgon pa'i mkhar gog kyang mang po mthong yul du snang la da lta nyams gso byed bzhin 'dug skyes — 177 —

sems la gyi 'pho nyul/ma skor zhig gis rgyab la shing leb bzhag ste rtsig rdo 'khur nas ar gzhas gtong bzhin yod par gnas skor pa tshos za zur gang rung nas par la bskyon par brel/ kho bo'i sems su lar nyams pa sor chud byed pa ni dga' 'os pa'i don bya rmad byung zhig red mod/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas 'dang brgyab na/ yod tshad thams cad nyams gso byed don yang chung snyam/ lo rgyus kyis bslangs pa'i ku re'i skyo gar de dag slar mi 'byung ched god chag ngo ma 'ga' zhig sor bzhag gis lo rgyus kyi khrod du nyar tshags bgyis na bzang bsam/ de ma gtogs da lta nga tshos spyan lam du bzung thub kyi/ rjes rabs phyis 'byung tshos ci yang mthong mi thub/ de yang tag tag par ris dang yig ris su phab pa'i phyi mo 'dra bshus las shes rtogs dang rgyus lon byed pa las thad ka thad so'i dngos po ngos bstan bya mi thub pas so/ /tshags par zhig tu 'jar pan pas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs kyi god chag ci rigs sor bzhag gis nyar yod skad/ de ltar na/ nga tshos kyang dge skyon gang gi phyogs ris bral ba'i lo rgyus la ngos zin yang dag rnyed ched/ya nga dang snying rje bral ba'i lo rgyus kyi ku re gang mang la dran pa gso ched/dpe mtshon snang brnyan ngo ma zhig bskyur na dge snyam/ri mgo de nas mar thur la bltas na/ khugs pa ga tsam yod pa mi nges pa'i kyag kyog gi lam bu de ji 'dra'i yi gar 'ong ba la ang /— 178 —
